stage.name: 梯度与方向导数实战：寻找最快路径
stage.language: 使用中文教学，保持学术严谨性且表达通俗易懂。对于微积分术语（如梯度、方向导数、等高线）使用中文标准译名，公式保持标准数学符号书写，确保零基础学生能理解抽象概念。

agents.name: 小慧
agents.persona: 微积分助教，数学系研究生，性格温和耐心，擅长用画图和类比帮助学生攻克抽象难点。喜欢用苏格拉底式追问引导学生自己发现答案，对操作型实验环节尤为熟练。

agents.name: 林教授
agents.persona: 资深微积分教授，拥有20年教学经验，善于用生活化的比喻将抽象概念讲得通俗易懂。教学中注重逻辑推导和几何直觉的结合，对学生的常见误区有敏锐的预判，总能在关键节点抛出启发式问题。

agents.name: 大毛
agents.persona: 跨专业选修生，编程背景但对数学概念有些畏难，喜欢用游戏化方式学习。对误解修复挑战和迷宫策略游戏格外投入，常从直觉出发做选择，犯错后在高互动反馈中快速修正理解。

agents.name: 思思
agents.persona: 数学系大一新生，对微积分有较强理论功底但常陷入符号化思维，忽视几何直觉。喜欢反思性学习，遇到误解修复挑战时会认真记录错误原因，偶尔陷入过度思考而犹豫不决。

agents.name: 阿杰
agents.persona: 大二工科生，数学基础中等，擅长空间思维和动手操作，但容易混淆梯度与方向导数的概念。学习风格偏向实验先行、理论后补，喜欢通过拖动滑块和3D视角获得直观理解，常冒出意料之外的疑问。

scenes.title: 前测：梯度、方向导数与等高线学习准备诊断

questions.question: 函数 f(x, y) 在点 (x0, y0) 处关于 x 的偏导数 f_x(x0, y0) 表示什么？

options.label: 曲面在任意方向上的变化率
沿 x 轴方向固定 y=y0 时，函数在 x0 处的瞬时变化率
函数在整个定义域上的平均值
函数在点 (x0, y0) 处沿最陡方向的变化率

questions.analysis: 偏导数 f_x(x0, y0) 的定义是固定 y=y0，仅让 x 变化时函数的变化率，即沿着平行于 x 轴方向的斜率。选项 A 描述的是方向导数的概念，选项 C 是平均值，选项 D 是梯度方向的变化率（方向导数的最大值）。

questions.question: 在地形图的等高线图中，若等高线在某处非常密集，这说明了什么？

options.label: 该处海拔很低
该处地形非常平缓
该处地形非常陡峭
该处是山峰的最高点

questions.analysis: 等高线密集表示在较短的水平距离内，海拔高度变化很大，因此地形陡峭。稀疏的等高线才代表平缓的地形。海拔高低由等高线上的数值决定，与疏密无关；山峰最高点通常被最内圈的闭合等高线包围。

questions.question: 以下关于方向变化率的说法，哪些是正确的？（多选）

options.label: 从点 A 到点 B 的平均变化率等于 (B点高度 - A点高度) / A到B的直线距离
在同一点，沿任何方向的变化率大小都相同
方向导数描述的是函数在一点沿特定方向的变化快慢
沿等高线切线方向的方向导数，其值一定为0

questions.analysis: A 正确，这是平均变化率的定义。B 错误，在一点沿不同方向变化率通常不同，例如在山坡上，上山方向变化快，沿切线方向变化慢。C 正确，这正是方向导数的定义。D 正确，沿等高线切线方向高度不变，因此方向导数为0。

questions.question: 站在山坡上的一点，你朝某个方向迈出一步后，发现自己的海拔完全没有变化。你迈步的方向最有可能是什么方向？

options.label: 指向山顶的方向
垂直指向天空的方向
沿着等高线的切线方向
指向山脚的方向

questions.analysis: 海拔不变意味着函数值不变，在山坡上这对应于沿着与等高线相切的方向移动。因为等高线上的所有点都有相同的海拔。指向山顶海拔升高，指向山脚海拔降低，指向天空则跳出了二元函数的定义域（地面）。

questions.question: 想象你正站在一个光滑的山坡上，准备倒一桶水。请从直觉上解释：水会朝哪个方向流走？并说明这个方向和我们之前讨论的“偏导数”、“方向导数”、“等高线”等概念可能有什么联系。
questions.commentPrompt:
评分标准: 
(1) 准确指出水会流向最陡峭的下山方向（即变化率最大的下降方向）- 40%
(2) 能够正确建立与“方向导数”最大值的联系（水寻找方向导数取负最大值的方向）- 30%
(3) 能说明水流方向与等高线的关系（水流方向垂直于等高线）- 30%
questions.analysis: 参考要点：水总是沿着最陡峭的路径向下流，即负梯度方向。这个方向是所有可能方向中方向导数最小（负得最多）的方向。从等高线图上看，水流方向垂直于等高线，因为这是高度下降最快的路径。这与我们之前只讨论的沿x轴或y轴的偏导数不同，水流方向综合考虑了各个方向的变化率。

actions.text: 同学们好！欢迎来到今天的微积分探究课。在正式进入‘梯度’和‘方向导数’这些核心概念之前，我们先做一个小小的前测。
这份测试不是为了打分，而是想了解一下大家对‘偏导数’的基本感觉，以及对地形图上‘等高线’的认识。这样我就能更有针对性地调整接下来的讲解和实验。
题目里有一些是概念回顾，也有一些是结合直觉的思考题。大家答题的时候不用紧张，如果遇到不太确定的选项，凭你的第一感觉和常识去选就好。
准备好了吗？深呼吸一下，我们这就开始。

elements.content: 梯度向量
从偏导数到最速上升方向
目标：能将偏导数组合成指向最陡上升方向的向量
修正误解：梯度是一个向量，包含方向和大小，而非普通数值
梯度定义式：各分量分别为函数对各变量的偏导数

elements.html: ∇f=(∂x∂f​,∂y∂f​)

elements.content: 梯度方向是函数值增加最快的方向，其大小等于方向导数的最大值。
最速上升方向

actions.text: 刚才我们简单提了一口气，准备好了。现在，咱们就正式进入今天第一个核心概念：梯度向量。看到这三个字，你脑子里蹦出的第一个念头是什么？是不是觉得又是哪个数学家发明出来折磨人的新名词？
我们先明确一下这页的目标。很简单，也很关键：我们要把之前学的偏导数，像拼乐高一样，组合成一个指向最陡上升方向的向量。记住这个感觉，我们要找的是一条‘最速上升通道’。
在正式看公式前，我必须先帮你修正一个最常见的误解。很多人，包括我自己当年学的时候，总觉得梯度就是一个数，因为它是由偏导数算出来的嘛。大错特错！梯度是一个向量，它有方向，也有大小。这个大小，就是坡度最陡的那个值。
好，眼见为实。看这个定义式。倒三角符号读作nabla，我们就把这个向量叫做函数f的梯度。你看它的各个分量，恰好就是函数对x、对y，如果有更多变量，就对每一个变量的偏导数。这就是我说的‘组合’的含义，它不是简单相加，而是构成了一个有方向的量。
所以，这句话请你一定要在心里默念一遍：梯度方向，就是函数值增加最快的方向；它的大小，就等于那个最快的方向导数。想象你站在山坡上，梯度向量指向的就是你往上爬、感觉最费力、坡度最陡的那个方向。
总结一下，我们和‘最速上升方向’这个朋友打了个照面。它不是一个模糊的感觉，而是一个可以被偏导数精确计算出来的向量。这个概念的威力，我们会在下一张图里，通过实验亲手感受一下。

.btn-row{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn{flex:1;min-width:44px;min-height:44px;border:none;border-radius:8px;font-size:.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;transition:all .2s}
.btn-primary{background:#6366f1;color:#fff}

.preset-btn:hover{background:#334155;border-color:#6366f1}

.info-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.78rem;padding:3px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #1e293b}
.info-row:last-child{border:none}
.info-key{color:#94a3b8}
.info-val{font-family:'Courier New',monospace;font-weight:700}
.highlight{color:#22d3ee;text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(34,211,238,.4)}
.status-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;font-size:.75rem;margin-bottom:10px}
.status-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0}
.status-dot.idle{background:#64748b}
.status-dot.running{background:#22c55e;box-shadow:0 0 6px #22c55e;animation:pulse-dot 1s infinite}
.status-dot.paused{background:#f59e0b}
.status-dot.ended{background:#ef4444}
@keyframes pulse-dot{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.4}}
.formula{background:#0f172a;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:6px;padding:8px 10px;margin-bottom:10px;font-size:.8rem;color:#94a3b8;line-height:1.6;text-align:center}
.formula em{color:#fbbf24;font-style:normal}
.formula b{color:#67e8f8}
.toggle-btn{display:block;width:100%;min-height:44px;background:#334155;border:1px solid #475569;color:#a5b4fc;border-radius:6px;font-size:.8rem;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:8px;touch-action:manipulation}
@media(min-width:768px){.toggle-btn{display:none}}
</style>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const katexOptions = {
        delimiters: [
            {left: '\\[', right: '\\]', display: true},
            {left: '\\(', right: '\\)', display: false},
            {left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true},
            {left: '$', right: '$', display: false}
        ],
        throwOnError: false,
        strict: false,
        trust: true
    };

    let renderTimeout;
    function safeRender() {
        if (renderTimeout) clearTimeout(renderTimeout);
        renderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);
        }, 100);
    }

    renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        let shouldRender = false;
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            if (mutation.target &&
                mutation.target.className &&
                typeof mutation.target.className === 'string' &&
                mutation.target.className.includes('katex')) {
                return;
            }
            shouldRender = true;
        });

        if (shouldRender) {
            safeRender();
        }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true
    });

    setInterval(() => {
        const text = document.body.innerText;
        if (text.includes('\\(') || text.includes('$$')) {
            safeRender();
        }
    }, 2000);
});
</script>

<div class="app">
  <div class="header">
    <h1>🎯 梯度向量可视化</h1>
    <p>调节偏导数分量，观察梯度向量指向最陡上升方向</p>
  </div>
  <div class="main">
    <div class="canvas-wrap">
      <canvas id="canvas"></canvas>
    </div>
    <div class="controls" id="controls-panel">
      <button class="toggle-btn" onclick="toggleControls()">☰ 收起/展开控制面板</button>
      <div id="controls-content">
        <div class="status-bar" id="status-bar">
          <span class="status-dot idle" id="status-dot"></span>
          <span id="status-text">就绪 — 调节参数后点击启动</span>
        </div>
        <div class="formula">
          <em>梯度</em> ∇f = <b>(∂f/∂x, ∂f/∂y)</b><br>
          模长 |∇f| = √((∂f/∂x)² + (∂f/∂y)²)
        </div>
        <div class="section">
          <div class="section-title">📐 偏导数控制</div>
          <div class="slider-group">
            <div class="slider-label">
              <span>x方向斜率 ∂f/∂x</span>
              <span class="val" id="partial_x-display">2.00</span>
            </div>
            <input type="range" id="partial_x-slider" data-var="partial_x" min="-5" max="5" step="0.1" value="2" aria-label="x方向偏导数">
          </div>
          <div class="slider-group">
            <div class="slider-label">
              <span>y方向斜率 ∂f/∂y</span>
              <span class="val" id="partial_y-display">1.00</span>
            </div>
            <input type="range" id="partial_y-slider" data-var="partial_y" min="-5" max="5" step="0.1" value="1" aria-label="y方向偏导数">
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="section">
          <div class="section-title">📊 实时数据</div>
          <div class="info-panel">
            <div class="info-row">
              <span class="info-key">梯度 ∇f</span>
              <span class="info-val" id="gradient-display">(2.00, 1.00)</span>
            </div>
            <div class="info-row">
              <span class="info-key">模长 |∇f|</span>
              <span class="info-val highlight" id="gradient_magnitude-display">2.24</span>
            </div>
            <div class="info-row">
              <span class="info-key">方向角 θ</span>
              <span class="info-val" id="angle-display">26.6°</span>
            </div>
            <div class="info-row">
              <span class="info-key">陡峭程度</span>
              <span class="info-val" id="steepness_indicator-display">中等</span>
            </div>

<script type="application/json" id="widget-config">
{
  "type": "simulation",
  "concept": "gradient_vector",
  "description": "通过调节x和y方向的偏导数，观察梯度向量如何始终指向曲面最陡的上升方向。仿真中粒子沿梯度方向运动，直观展示梯度上升法。",
  "variables": [
    {"name": "partial_x", "label": "x方向斜率 ∂f/∂x", "min": -5, "max": 5, "default": 2, "unit": ""},
    {"name": "partial_y", "label": "y方向斜率 ∂f/∂y", "min": -5, "max": 5, "default": 1, "unit": ""},
    {"name": "gradient_magnitude", "label": "梯度模长 |∇f|", "min": 0, "max": 10, "default": 2.24, "unit": ""},
    {"name": "steepness_indicator", "label": "陡峭程度", "min": 0, "max": 1, "default": 0.5, "unit": ""}
  ],
  "presets": [
    {"name": "x方向最陡", "variables": {"partial_x": 5, "partial_y": 0.5}},
    {"name": "y方向最陡", "variables": {"partial_x": 0.3, "partial_y": 5}},
    {"name": "均衡梯度", "variables": {"partial_x": 2, "partial_y": 2}},
    {"name": "反向梯度", "variables": {"partial_x": -3, "partial_y": 2}},
    {"name": "临界点", "variables": {"partial_x": 0, "partial_y": 0}}
  ]
}
</script>

<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const DPR = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;

let W, H;
function resizeCanvas() {
  const wrap = canvas.parentElement;
  W = wrap.clientWidth;
  H = wrap.clientHeight;
  canvas.width = W * DPR;
  canvas.height = H * DPR;
  canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
  canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
  ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);
resizeCanvas();

// State
let state = {
  running: false,
  ended: false,
  paused: false,
  particleX: 0,
  particleY: 0,
  trail: [],
  time: 0,
  speed: 0.008
};

let partialX = 2, partialY = 1;

// Surface function: f(x,y) = a*x + b*y + sin(x)*cos(y) for visual interest
function surfaceZ(x, y) {
  return partialX * x + partialY * y + 0.3 * Math.sin(x * 2.5) * Math.cos(y * 2.5);
}

function computeGradient(x, y) {
  const eps = 0.01;
  const dx = (surfaceZ(x + eps, y) - surfaceZ(x - eps, y)) / (2 * eps);
  const dy = (surfaceZ(x, y + eps) - surfaceZ(x, y - eps)) / (2 * eps);
  return { x: dx, y: dy };
}

function gradientMagnitude(gx, gy) {
  return Math.sqrt(gx * gx + gy * gy);
}

// Color for height
function heightColor(z) {
  const t = (z + 10) / 20;
  const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
  if (clamped < 0.25) {
    const s = clamped / 0.25;
    return `rgb(${Math.floor(30 + s * 20)},${Math.floor(60 + s * 40)},${Math.floor(120 + s * 60)})`;
  } else if (clamped < 0.5) {
    const s = (clamped - 0.25) / 0.25;
    return `rgb(${Math.floor(50 + s * 50)},${Math.floor(100 + s * 60)},${Math.floor(180 - s * 40)})`;
  } else if (clamped < 0.75) {
    const s = (clamped - 0.5) / 0.25;
    return `rgb(${Math.floor(100 + s * 100)},${Math.floor(160 - s * 40)},${Math.floor(140 - s * 80)})`;
  } else {
    const s = (clamped - 0.75) / 0.25;
    return `rgb(${Math.floor(200 + s * 55)},${Math.floor(120 - s * 60)},${Math.floor(60 - s * 30)})`;
  }
}

// Coordinate mapping
function worldToScreen(wx, wy) {
  const scale = Math.min(W, H) * 0.18;
  const cx = W / 2;
  const cy = H / 2;
  return { x: cx + wx * scale, y: cy - wy * scale };
}

function screenToWorld(sx, sy) {
  const scale = Math.min(W, H) * 0.18;
  const cx = W / 2;
  const cy = H / 2;
  return { x: (sx - cx) / scale, y: -(sy - cy) / scale };
}

function drawGrid() {
  const scale = Math.min(W, H) * 0.18;
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(100,116,139,0.3)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
  for (let i = -5; i <= 5; i++) {
    const p1 = worldToScreen(i, -5);
    const p2 = worldToScreen(i, 5);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(p1.x, p1.y); ctx.lineTo(p2.x, p2.y); ctx.stroke();
    const p3 = worldToScreen(-5, i);
    const p4 = worldToScreen(5, i);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(p3.x, p3.y); ctx.lineTo(p4.x, p4.y); ctx.stroke();
  }
  // Axes
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(148,163,184,0.6)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  const ox = worldToScreen(0, 0);
  const ax = worldToScreen(5.5, 0);
  const ay = worldToScreen(0, 5.5);
  const bx = worldToScreen(-5.5, 0);
  const by = worldToScreen(0, -5.5);
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(bx.x, bx.y); ctx.lineTo(ax.x, ax.y); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(by.x, by.y); ctx.lineTo(ay.x, ay.y); ctx.stroke();
  // Labels
  ctx.fillStyle = '#94a3b8';
  ctx.font = '11px sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('x', ax.x + 4, ax.y + 14);
  ctx.fillText('y', ay.x + 4, ay.y - 4);
  ctx.fillText('0', ox.x - 12, ox.y + 12);
}

function drawSurface() {
  const res = 3;
  const scale = Math.min(W, H) * 0.18;
  const gridSize = Math.min(Math.floor(W / res), Math.floor(H / res));
  for (let py = 0; py < gridSize; py += res) {
    for (let px = 0; px < gridSize; px += res) {
      const w = screenToWorld(px, py);
      const z = surfaceZ(w.x, w.y);
      ctx.fillStyle = heightColor(z);
      ctx.fillRect(px, py, res, res);
    }
  }
}

function drawContourLines() {
  const levels = [-4, -2, 0, 2, 4];
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  levels.forEach(level => {
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    let started = false;
    for (let py = 0; py <= H; py += 2) {
      for (let px = 0; px <= W; px += 2) {
        const w = screenToWorld(px, py);
        const z = surfaceZ(w.x, w.y);
        if (Math.abs(z - level) < 0.15) {
          if (!started) { ctx.moveTo(px, py); started = true; }
          else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
        }
      }
      if (started) { ctx.stroke(); ctx.beginPath(); started = false; }
    }
  });
}

function drawArrow(x1, y1, x2, y2, color, lineWidth, headLen) {
  const dx = x2 - x1, dy = y2 - y1;
  const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
  headLen = headLen || 10;
  ctx.strokeStyle = color;
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.lineWidth = lineWidth || 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
  ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x2, y2);
  ctx.lineTo(x2 - headLen * Math.cos(angle - 0.4), y2 - headLen * Math.sin(angle - 0.4));
  ctx.lineTo(x2 - headLen * Math.cos(angle + 0.4), y2 - headLen * Math.sin(angle + 0.4));
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawGradientArrow(wx, wy) {
  const g = computeGradient(wx, wy);
  const s1 = worldToScreen(wx, wy);
  const mag = gradientMagnitude(g.x, g.y);
  if (mag < 0.01) return;
  const arrowScale = 1.5;
  const endX = wx + g.x * arrowScale / mag;
  const endY = wy + g.y * arrowScale / mag;
  const s2 = worldToScreen(endX, endY);
  // Glow
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = '#22d3ee';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
  drawArrow(s1.x, s1.y, s2.x, s2.y, '#22d3ee', 3, 12);
  ctx.restore();
  // Component arrows
  ctx.save();
  ctx.setLineDash([3, 3]);
  const sx = worldToScreen(wx + g.x * arrowScale / mag, wy);
  const sy = worldToScreen(wx, wy + g.y * arrowScale / mag);
  drawArrow(s1.x, s1.y, sx.x, sx.y, 'rgba(251,191,36,0.6)', 1.5, 6);
  drawArrow(s1.x, s1.y, sy.x, sy.y, 'rgba(251,191,36,0.6)', 1.5, 6);
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  ctx.restore();
  // Component labels
  ctx.font = 'bold 11px monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24';
  ctx.fillText('∂x', (s1.x + sx.x) / 2 + 8, (s1.y + sx.y) / 2);
  ctx.fillText('∂y', (s1.x + sy.x) / 2 + 8, (s1.y + sy.y) / 2 - 6);
}

function drawParticle() {
  const s = worldToScreen(state.particleX, state.particleY);
  const z = surfaceZ(state.particleX, state.particleY);
  const mag = gradientMagnitude(partialX, partialY);
  const glowSize = 8 + mag * 2;
  // Outer glow
  const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(s.x, s.y, 0, s.x, s.y, glowSize);
  grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(239,68,68,0.8)');
  grad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(239,68,68,0.3)');
  grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(239,68,68,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, glowSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // Inner dot
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f87171';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.stroke();
  // Z value label
  ctx.font = 'bold 11px monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24';
  ctx.fillText('z=' + z.toFixed(2), s.x + 12, s.y - 10);
}

function drawTrail() {
  if (state.trail.length < 2) return;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  for (let i = 1; i < state.trail.length; i++) {
    const t = i / state.trail.length;
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(251,191,36,${t * 0.7})`;
    const p1 = worldToScreen(state.trail[i - 1].x, state.trail[i - 1].y);
    const p2 = worldToScreen(state.trail[i].x, state.trail[i].y);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(p1.x, p1.y);
    ctx.lineTo(p2.x, p2.y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawHUD() {
  const mag = gradientMagnitude(partialX, partialY);
  const angle = Math.atan2(partialY, partialX) * 180 / Math.PI;
  // Top-left info
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(15,23,42,0.85)';
  const bx = 10, by = 10, bw = 190, bh = 105;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(bx, by, bw, bh, 8);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#334155';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.font = '12px monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#a5b4fc';
  ctx.fillText('∇f = (' + partialX.toFixed(2) + ', ' + partialY.toFixed(2) + ')', bx + 10, by + 22);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#67e8f8';
  ctx.fillText('|∇f| = ' + mag.toFixed(2), bx + 10, by + 40);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24';
  ctx.fillText('θ = ' + angle.toFixed(1) + '°', bx + 10, by + 58);
  const steep = getSteepness(mag);
  ctx.fillStyle = steep.color;
  ctx.fillText('陡峭程度: ' + steep.text, bx + 10, by + 76);
  if (state.running) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#22c55e';
    ctx.fillText('⏵ 粒子沿梯度上升中...', bx + 10, by + 94);
  } else if (state.paused) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f59e0b';
    ctx.fillText('⏸ 已暂停', bx + 10, by + 94);
  } else if (state.ended) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ef4444';
    ctx.fillText('■ 粒子已到达边界', bx + 10, by + 94);
  }
  // Legend bottom-right
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(15,23,42,0.85)';
  const lx = W - 170, ly = H - 60, lw = 160, lh = 50;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(lx, ly, lw, lh, 8);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#334155';
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.font = '11px sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#22d3ee';
  ctx.fillText('━━ 梯度向量 ∇f', lx + 10, ly + 18);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24';
  ctx.fillText('┈┈ 分量 (∂x, ∂y)', lx + 10, ly + 35);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f87171';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(lx + 10, ly + 48, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#cbd5e1';
  ctx.fillText('粒子位置', lx + 18, ly + 51);
}

function getSteepness(mag) {
  if (mag < 0.5) return { text: '平缓', color: '#4ade80' };
  if (mag < 2) return { text: '中等', color: '#fbbf24' };
  if (mag < 4) return { text: '较陡', color: '#f97316' };
  return { text: '极陡', color: '#ef4444' };
}

function draw() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
  // Background
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  drawSurface();
  drawGrid();
  drawContourLines();
  if (state.running || state.paused || state.ended) {
    drawTrail();
  }
  drawGradientArrow(state.particleX, state.particleY);
  drawParticle();
  drawHUD();
}

function updateSimulation() {
  if (!state.running) return;
  const g = computeGradient(state.particleX, state.particleY);
  const mag = gradientMagnitude(g.x, g.y);
  if (mag < 0.001) {
    state.running = false;
    state.ended = true;
    updateStatus('ended', '已达到临界点（梯度为零）');
    updateButton('重新开始');
    draw();
    return;
  }
  const stepSize = state.speed * mag;
  state.particleX += (g.x / mag) * stepSize;
  state.particleY += (g.y / mag) * stepSize;
  state.trail.push({ x: state.particleX, y: state.particleY });
  if (state.trail.length > 500) state.trail.shift();
  state.time += 1;
  // Check bounds
  if (Math.abs(state.particleX) > 5 || Math.abs(state.particleY) > 5) {
    state.running = false;
    state.ended = true;
    updateStatus('ended', '粒子已到达边界');
    updateButton('重新开始');
    draw();
    return;
  }
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(updateSimulation);
}

function updateInfoPanel() {
  const mag = gradientMagnitude(partialX, partialY);
  const angle = Math.atan2(partialY, partialX) * 180 / Math.PI;
  const steep = getSteepness(mag);
  document.getElementById('gradient-display').textContent = '(' + partialX.toFixed(2) + ', ' + partialY.toFixed(2) + ')';
  document.getElementById('gradient_magnitude-display').textContent = mag.toFixed(2);
  document.getElementById('angle-display').textContent = angle.toFixed(1) + '°';
  document.getElementById('steepness_indicator-display').textContent = steep.text;
  document.getElementById('steepness_indicator-display').style.color = steep.color;
}

function updateStatus(statusClass, text) {
  document.getElementById('status-dot').className = 'status-dot ' + statusClass;
  document.getElementById('status-text').textContent = text;
}

function updateButton(text) {
  document.getElementById('start-btn').textContent = text;
}

function startSimulation() {
  if (state.ended) {
    resetSimulation();
  }
  state.running = true;
  state.paused = false;
  state.ended = false;
  updateStatus('running', '运行中 — 粒子沿梯度上升');
  updateButton('⏸ 暂停');
  updateSimulation();
}

function pauseSimulation() {
  state.running = false;
  state.paused = true;
  updateStatus('paused', '已暂停');
  updateButton('▶ 继续');
  draw();
}

function handleMainButton() {
  if (state.ended) {
    resetSimulation();
    startSimulation();
  } else if (state.running) {
    pauseSimulation();
  } else if (state.paused) {
    state.running = true;
    state.paused = false;
    updateStatus('running', '运行中 — 粒子沿梯度上升');
    updateButton('⏸ 暂停');
    updateSimulation();
  } else {
    startSimulation();
  }
}

function resetSimulation() {
  state.running = false;
  state.ended = false;
  state.paused = false;
  state.particleX = 0;
  state.particleY = 0;
  state.trail = [];
  state.time = 0;
  updateStatus('idle', '就绪 — 调节参数后点击启动');
  updateButton('▶ 启动');
  draw();
}

document.getElementById('start-btn').addEventListener('click', handleMainButton);
document.getElementById('reset-btn').addEventListener('click', resetSimulation);

// Sliders
function setupSlider(id) {
  const slider = document.getElementById(id + '-slider');
  if (!slider) return;
  slider.addEventListener('input', function() {
    const val = parseFloat(this.value);
    if (id === 'partial_x') {
      partialX = val;
      document.getElementById('partial_x-display').textContent = val.toFixed(2);
    } else if (id === 'partial_y') {
      partialY = val;
      document.getElementById('partial_y-display').textContent = val.toFixed(2);
    }
    updateInfoPanel();
    if (!state.running) draw();
  });
}
setupSlider('partial_x');
setupSlider('partial_y');

// Presets
function applyPreset(name) {
  const presets = {
    steep_x: { partial_x: 5, partial_y: 0.5 },
    steep_y: { partial_x: 0.3, partial_y: 5 },
    balanced: { partial_x: 2, partial_y: 2 },
    opposite: { partial_x: -3, partial_y: 2 },
    zero: { partial_x: 0, partial_y: 0 }
  };
  const p = presets[name];
  if (!p) return;
  partialX = p.partial_x;
  partialY = p.partial_y;
  document.getElementById('partial_x-slider').value = partialX;
  document.getElementById('partial_y-slider').value = partialY;
  document.getElementById('partial_x-display').textContent = partialX.toFixed(2);
  document.getElementById('partial_y-display').textContent = partialY.toFixed(2);
  updateInfoPanel();
  resetSimulation();
}

// Toggle controls on mobile
let controlsVisible = true;
function toggleControls() {
  const content = document.getElementById('controls-content');
  controlsVisible = !controlsVisible;
  content.style.display = controlsVisible ? 'block' : 'none';
}

// Keyboard shortcuts
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.code === 'Space') {
    e.preventDefault();
    handleMainButton();
  } else if (e.code === 'KeyR') {
    e.preventDefault();
    resetSimulation();
  }
});

// Canvas interaction - click to place particle
canvas.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const sx = e.clientX - rect.left;
  const sy = e.clientY - rect.top;
  const w = screenToWorld(sx, sy);
  if (Math.abs(w.x) <= 5 && Math.abs(w.y) <= 5) {
    if (!state.running) {
      state.particleX = w.x;
      state.particleY = w.y;
      state.trail = [];
      draw();
    }
  }
});

// Touch support
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
  if (e.touches.length === 1) {
    const touch = e.touches[0];
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const sx = touch.clientX - rect.left;
    const sy = touch.clientY - rect.top;
    const w = screenToWorld(sx, sy);
    if (Math.abs(w.x) <= 5 && Math.abs(w.y) <= 5 && !state.running) {
      state.particleX = w.x;
      state.particleY = w.y;
      state.trail = [];
      draw();
    }
  }
}, { passive: true });

// Resize observer for canvas container
const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
  resizeCanvas();
  if (!state.running) draw();
});
resizeObserver.observe(canvas.parentElement);

// postMessage listener
window.addEventListener('message', function(event) {
  const { type, target, state: msgState, content } = event.data || {};
  switch (type) {
    case 'SET_WIDGET_STATE':
      if (msgState) {
        Object.entries(msgState).forEach(([key, value]) => {
          const slider = document.getElementById(key + '-slider') || document.querySelector('[data-var="' + key + '"]');
          if (slider) {
            slider.value = value;
            slider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
          }
        });
      }
      break;
    case 'HIGHLIGHT_ELEMENT':
      const highlightEl = document.querySelector(target);
      if (highlightEl) {
        highlightEl.style.outline = '3px solid rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.8)';
        highlightEl.style.outlineOffset = '4px';
        highlightEl.style.animation = 'pulse-highlight 2s infinite';
        setTimeout(() => {
          highlightEl.style.outline = '';
          highlightEl.style.animation = '';
        }, 3000);
      }
      break;
    case 'ANNOTATE_ELEMENT':
      const annotateEl = document.querySelector(target);
      if (annotateEl && content) {
        const rect = annotateEl.getBoundingClientRect();
        const tooltip = document.createElement('div');
        tooltip.className = 'teacher-annotation';
        tooltip.style.cssText = 'position:fixed; top:' + (rect.top - 40) + 'px; left:' + rect.left + 'px; background:rgba(139,92,246,0.95); color:white; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:8px; font-size:14px; z-index:1000; animation:fadeIn 0.3s;';
        tooltip.textContent = content;
        document.body.appendChild(tooltip);
        setTimeout(() => tooltip.remove(), 4000);
      }
      break;
    case 'REVEAL_ELEMENT':
      const revealEl = document.querySelector(target);
      if (revealEl) {
        revealEl.style.display = '';
        revealEl.style.opacity = '1';
      }
      break;
  }
});

// Add animation CSS
const style = document.createElement('style');
style.textContent = '@keyframes pulse-highlight { 0%, 100% { outline-color: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.8); } 50% { outline-color: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.4); } } @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }';
document.head.appendChild(style);

// Initial draw
updateInfoPanel();
draw();
</script>

widgetConfig.description: 通过调节x和y方向的偏导数，观察梯度向量如何始终指向曲面最陡的上升方向。仿真中粒子沿梯度方向运动，直观展示梯度上升法。

actions.text: 刚才我们定义了梯度是一个向量。现在，我们来亲手『造』一个梯度出来。这个实验里，你可以分别拖动代表 x 方向斜率 ∂f/∂x 和 y 方向斜率 ∂f/∂y 的滑块，它们组成了梯度的两个分量。

actions.content: 控制梯度在 x 方向的分量，试试拖动它
控制梯度在 y 方向的分量，试试拖动它

actions.text: 注意看中间的蓝色箭头，它就是由这两个分量合成的梯度向量。当你改变任何一个分量时，箭头会自动调整方向和长度。

actions.content: 加载预设『x方向最陡』：主要斜率集中在 x 方向

actions.text: 看，现在 x 方向的斜率设得很大，y 方向几乎平坦。梯度箭头几乎完全指向了 x 轴方向，也就是这个地形最陡上升的方位。我们可以再换一个预设感受一下。

actions.content: 加载预设『反向梯度』，让 x 方向斜率为负

actions.text: 这次 x 方向变负了，意味着沿 x 轴正向是下坡，所以箭头转向了 x 的反方向，同时叠加 y 方向的上坡分量。它总是指向局部最陡的上升方位。接下来，请你自己动手拖动滑块，验证一下：无论你怎么调，这个蓝色箭头会不会背叛『最陡上升』这个使命？

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>梯度向量：关系图</title>
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
body{background:#0d1117;color:#e6edf3;font-family:"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",system-ui,sans-serif;overflow:hidden;height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
#top-bar{background:#161b22;border-bottom:1px solid #30363d;padding:8px 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;z-index:100;flex-shrink:0}
#top-bar h1{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;color:#f0f6fc}
#top-bar .subtitle{font-size:12px;color:#8b949e}
#main{display:flex;flex:1;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
#diagram-wrap{flex:1;overflow:hidden;position:relative;background:#0d1117}
#diagram-wrap svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
#sidebar{width:300px;background:#161b22;border-left:1px solid #30363d;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:transform .3s ease;z-index:50;position:relative;flex-shrink:0}
#sidebar.collapsed{transform:translateX(100%)}
#sidebar-toggle{position:absolute;right:300px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:60;background:#161b22;border:1px solid #30363d;border-right:none;color:#e6edf3;width:24px;height:64px;border-radius:8px 0 0 8px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:14px;transition:right .3s ease}
#sidebar.collapsed+#sidebar-toggle,#sidebar-toggle.sidebar-collapsed{right:0}
#sidebar-toggle:hover{background:#21262d}
.sidebar-header{padding:16px;border-bottom:1px solid #30363d;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.sidebar-header h2{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:#f0f6fc}
.sidebar-header .icon{font-size:20px}
#node-detail{padding:16px;flex:1;overflow-y:auto}
#node-detail .detail-icon{font-size:36px;margin-bottom:8px}
#node-detail .detail-label{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;color:#f0f6fc;margin-bottom:4px}
#node-detail .detail-id{font-size:11px;color:#484f58;margin-bottom:12px;font-family:monospace}
#node-detail .detail-desc{font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;color:#c9d1d9}
#node-detail .detail-desc p{margin-bottom:8px}
#node-detail .detail-formula{background:#0d1117;border:1px solid #30363d;border-radius:6px;padding:10px 14px;margin:10px 0;font-family:"Cambria Math","Latin Modern Math",Georgia,serif;font-size:15px;color:#79c0ff;text-align:center;letter-spacing:0.5px}
#node-detail .misconception{background:#1a1025;border:1px solid #6e40c9;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;margin-top:12px}
#node-detail .misconception .mc-title{color:#bc8cff;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:6px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
#node-detail .misconception .mc-text{color:#c9d1d9;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6}
#step-controls{padding:12px 16px;border-top:1px solid #30363d;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-shrink:0}
#step-controls button{padding:6px 14px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid #30363d;background:#21262d;color:#e6edf3;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;font-family:inherit;transition:background .15s}
#step-controls button:hover:not(:disabled){background:#30363d}
#step-controls button:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}
#step-controls button.primary{background:#1f6feb;border-color:#1f6feb}
#step-controls button.primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:#388bfd}
#step-info{font-size:12px;color:#8b949e;margin-left:auto}
#legend{position:absolute;bottom:12px;left:12px;background:rgba(22,27,34,.9);border:1px solid #30363d;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;z-index:10}
#legend .legend-title{font-size:11px;color:#8b949e;margin-bottom:6px}
#legend .legend-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:11px;color:#c9d1d9;margin-bottom:3px}
#legend .legend-line{width:20px;height:2px;background:#484f58;border-radius:1px}
#legend .legend-line.highlight{background:#79c0ff}
#legend .legend-line.misconception{background:#bc8cff;border-style:dashed}
.node-group{cursor:pointer}
.node-rect{rx:12;ry:12;fill:#ffffff;stroke:#e6edf3;stroke-width:2;transition:stroke .2s,filter .2s}
.node-group:hover .node-rect{stroke:#79c0ff;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(121,192,255,.4))}
.node-group.active .node-rect{stroke:#f0883e;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(240,136,62,.5))}
.node-group.hidden .node-rect{fill:#21262d;stroke:#30363d;filter:none}
.node-group.hidden:hover .node-rect{stroke:#30363d;filter:none}
.node-icon{font-size:20px;user-select:none;pointer-events:none}
.node-label{font-size:13px;fill:#0d1117;font-weight:600;text-anchor:middle;user-select:none;pointer-events:none}
.node-group.hidden .node-label{fill:#484f58}
.edge-path{fill:none;stroke:#484f58;stroke-width:2;marker-end:url(#arrow);transition:stroke .4s,opacity .4s}
.edge-path.highlight{stroke:#79c0ff}
.edge-path.misconception{stroke:#bc8cff;stroke-dasharray:6 3}
.edge-label{font-size:11px;fill:#8b949e;text-anchor:middle;user-select:none;pointer-events:none;transition:fill .4s}
.edge-label.highlight{fill:#79c0ff}
.misconception-badge{opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s}
.misconception-badge.visible{opacity:1}
.reveal-anim{animation:nodeAppear .5s ease-out}
@keyframes nodeAppear{0%{opacity:0;transform:scale(.85)}100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}}
@media(max-width:768px){
  #sidebar{position:absolute;right:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:280px;transform:translateX(100%)}
  #sidebar.mobile-open{transform:translateX(0)}
  #sidebar-toggle{right:0!important;position:absolute}
  #sidebar-toggle.open{right:280px}
  #top-bar .subtitle{display:none}
  #legend{display:none}
}
</style>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const katexOptions = {
        delimiters: [
            {left: '\\[', right: '\\]', display: true},
            {left: '\\(', right: '\\)', display: false},
            {left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true},
            {left: '$', right: '$', display: false}
        ],
        throwOnError: false,
        strict: false,
        trust: true
    };

    let renderTimeout;
    function safeRender() {
        if (renderTimeout) clearTimeout(renderTimeout);
        renderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);
        }, 100);
    }

    renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        let shouldRender = false;
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            if (mutation.target &&
                mutation.target.className &&
                typeof mutation.target.className === 'string' &&
                mutation.target.className.includes('katex')) {
                return;
            }
            shouldRender = true;
        });

        if (shouldRender) {
            safeRender();
        }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true
    });

    setInterval(() => {
        const text = document.body.innerText;
        if (text.includes('\\(') || text.includes('$$')) {
            safeRender();
        }
    }, 2000);
});
</script>

<script>
const NODE_W = 190, NODE_H = 72, ARROW_OFF = 10;
let config, currentStep = 0, revealedNodes = new Set();

function init() {
  config = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('widget-config').textContent);
  buildNodes();
  buildEdges();
  revealStep(0);
}

function buildNodes() {
  const layer = document.getElementById('nodes-layer');
  config.nodes.forEach(n => {
    const g = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'g');
    g.setAttribute('class', 'node-group hidden');
    g.setAttribute('id', n.id);
    g.setAttribute('data-x', n.x);
    g.setAttribute('data-y', n.y);
    g.onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); selectNode(n.id); };

    const r = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'rect');
    r.setAttribute('x', n.x - NODE_W/2);
    r.setAttribute('y', n.y - NODE_H/2);
    r.setAttribute('width', NODE_W);
    r.setAttribute('height', NODE_H);
    r.setAttribute('class', 'node-rect');
    g.appendChild(r);

    const icon = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
    icon.setAttribute('x', n.x - NODE_W/2 + 18);
    icon.setAttribute('y', n.y + 6);
    icon.setAttribute('class', 'node-icon');
    icon.textContent = n.icon;
    g.appendChild(icon);

    const label = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
    label.setAttribute('x', n.x + 8);
    label.setAttribute('y', n.y + 5);
    label.setAttribute('class', 'node-label');
    label.textContent = n.label;
    g.appendChild(label);

    layer.appendChild(g);
  });
}

function getNodeCenter(id) {
  const n = config.nodes.find(x => x.id === id);
  return { x: n.x, y: n.y };
}

function getEdgePath(fromId, toId) {
  const f = getNodeCenter(fromId), t = getNodeCenter(toId);
  const dx = t.x - f.x, dy = t.y - f.y;
  let sx, sy, ex, ey;

  if (Math.abs(dy) >= Math.abs(dx)) {
    sx = f.x;
    sy = dy > 0 ? f.y + NODE_H/2 : f.y - NODE_H/2;
    ex = t.x;
    ey = dy > 0 ? t.y - NODE_H/2 - ARROW_OFF : t.y + NODE_H/2 + ARROW_OFF;
  } else {
    sx = dx > 0 ? f.x + NODE_W/2 : f.x - NODE_W/2;
    sy = f.y;
    ex = dx > 0 ? t.x - NODE_W/2 - ARROW_OFF : t.x + NODE_W/2 + ARROW_OFF;
    ey = t.y;
  }

  // Add slight curve for aesthetics on diagonal-ish connections
  if (Math.abs(dx) > 40 && Math.abs(dy) > 40) {
    const mx = (sx + ex) / 2, my = (sy + ey) / 2;
    const offset = 15;
    const perpX = -(ey - sy) / Math.sqrt((ey-sy)**2 + (ex-sx)**2) * offset;
    const perpY = (ex - sx) / Math.sqrt((ey-sy)**2 + (ex-sx)**2) * offset;
    return `M ${sx} ${sy} Q ${mx + perpX} ${my + perpY} ${ex} ${ey}`;
  }
  return `M ${sx} ${sy} L ${ex} ${ey}`;
}

function buildEdges() {
  const edgeLayer = document.getElementById('edges-layer');
  const labelLayer = document.getElementById('edge-labels-layer');
  const mcLayer = document.getElementById('misconception-layers');

  config.edges.forEach((e, i) => {
    const pathD = getEdgePath(e.from, e.to);
    const isMc = e.misconception;

    // Edge path
    const path = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'path');
    path.setAttribute('d', pathD);
    path.setAttribute('class', 'edge-path hidden');
    path.setAttribute('id', 'edge-' + i);
    path.setAttribute('data-from', e.from);
    path.setAttribute('data-to', e.to);
    if (isMc) path.setAttribute('data-misconception', 'true');
    edgeLayer.appendChild(path);

    // Edge label
    const midX = (getNodeCenter(e.from).x + getNodeCenter(e.to).x) / 2;
    const midY = (getNodeCenter(e.from).y + getNodeCenter(e.to).y) / 2 - 10;
    const text = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
    text.setAttribute('x', midX);
    text.setAttribute('y', midY);
    text.setAttribute('class', 'edge-label hidden');
    text.setAttribute('id', 'elabel-' + i);
    text.textContent = e.label;
    labelLayer.appendChild(text);

    // Misconception badge
    if (isMc) {
      const badgeG = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'g');
      badgeG.setAttribute('class', 'misconception-badge');
      badgeG.setAttribute('id', 'mc-badge-' + i);
      badgeG.setAttribute('transform', `translate(${getNodeCenter(e.to).x + NODE_W/2 + 12}, ${getNodeCenter(e.to).y - NODE_H/2 - 5})`);

      const badgeRect = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'rect');
      badgeRect.setAttribute('x', 0);
      badgeRect.setAttribute('y', 0);
      badgeRect.setAttribute('width', 130);
      badgeRect.setAttribute('height', 28);
      badgeRect.setAttribute('rx', 6);
      badgeRect.setAttribute('fill', '#2d1b4e');
      badgeRect.setAttribute('stroke', '#bc8cff');
      badgeRect.setAttribute('stroke-width', 1);
      badgeG.appendChild(badgeRect);

      const badgeText = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
      badgeText.setAttribute('x', 65);
      badgeText.setAttribute('y', 18);
      badgeText.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');
      badgeText.setAttribute('fill', '#bc8cff');
      badgeText.setAttribute('font-size', '10');
      badgeText.setAttribute('font-weight', '600');
      badgeText.textContent = '⚠️ 此处易误解';
      badgeG.appendChild(badgeText);

      mcLayer.appendChild(badgeG);
    }
  });
}

function getConnectedEdges(nodeId) {
  return config.edges.filter(e => e.from === nodeId || e.to === nodeId);
}

function revealStep(step) {
  if (step < 0 || step >= config.revealOrder.length) return;
  currentStep = step;
  const nodeId = config.revealOrder[step];
  revealedNodes.add(nodeId);

  // Show node
  const nodeEl = document.getElementById(nodeId);
  nodeEl.classList.remove('hidden');
  nodeEl.classList.add('reveal-anim');
  setTimeout(() => nodeEl.classList.remove('reveal-anim'), 500);

  // Show connected edges
  getConnectedEdges(nodeId).forEach((e, idx) => {
    const edgeIdx = config.edges.indexOf(e);
    const pathEl = document.getElementById('edge-' + edgeIdx);
    const labelEl = document.getElementById('elabel-' + edgeIdx);

    const fromRevealed = revealedNodes.has(e.from);
    const toRevealed = revealedNodes.has(e.to);

    if (fromRevealed && toRevealed) {
      pathEl.classList.remove('hidden');
      pathEl.classList.add('highlight');
      labelEl.classList.remove('hidden');
      labelEl.classList.add('highlight');
      if (e.misconception) {
        pathEl.classList.add('misconception');
        pathEl.setAttribute('marker-end', 'url(#arrow-misconception)');
      } else {
        pathEl.setAttribute('marker-end', 'url(#arrow-highlight)');
      }
    } else {
      pathEl.classList.remove('hidden');
      labelEl.classList.remove('hidden');
      if (e.misconception) {
        pathEl.classList.add('misconception');
        pathEl.setAttribute('marker-end', 'url(#arrow-misconception)');
      }
    }

    // Show misconception badge
    if (e.misconception && fromRevealed && toRevealed) {
      const badge = document.getElementById('mc-badge-' + edgeIdx);
      if (badge) badge.classList.add('visible');
    }
  });

  // Update sidebar
  showNodeDetail(nodeId);
  updateStepControls();
}

function showNodeDetail(nodeId) {
  const node = config.nodes.find(n => n.id === nodeId);
  if (!node) return;
  const panel = document.getElementById('node-detail');

  let html = `<div class="detail-icon">${node.icon}</div>`;
  html += `<div class="detail-label">${node.label}</div>`;
  html += `<div class="detail-id">节点: ${node.id}</div>`;
  html += `<div class="detail-desc">${node.details.replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</div>`;
  if (node.formula) {
    html += `<div class="detail-formula">${node.formula}</div>`;
  }
  if (node.misconception) {
    html += `<div class="misconception">`;
    html += `<div class="mc-title">🚨 常见误解</div>`;
    html += `<div class="mc-text">${node.misconception.replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</div>`;
    html += `</div>`;
  }

  panel.innerHTML = html;
}

function updateStepControls() {
  document.getElementById('btn-prev').disabled = currentStep === 0;
  document.getElementById('btn-next').disabled = currentStep === config.revealOrder.length - 1;
  document.getElementById('step-info').textContent = `${currentStep + 1} / ${config.revealOrder.length}`;
}

function selectNode(nodeId) {
  // Highlight selected
  document.querySelectorAll('.node-group').forEach(g => g.classList.remove('active'));
  const el = document.getElementById(nodeId);
  if (!el.classList.contains('hidden')) {
    el.classList.add('active');
    showNodeDetail(nodeId);
  }
}

function nextStep() {
  if (currentStep < config.revealOrder.length - 1) {
    revealStep(currentStep + 1);
  }
}

function prevStep() {
  if (currentStep > 0) {
    const nodeId = config.revealOrder[currentStep];
    revealedNodes.delete(nodeId);

    // Check if this node is still needed by later steps
    let stillNeeded = false;
    for (let i = currentStep - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const earlierNodeId = config.revealOrder[i];
      if (revealedNodes.has(earlierNodeId)) {
        const edges = getConnectedEdges(nodeId);
        for (const e of edges) {
          if ((e.from === earlierNodeId || e.to === earlierNodeId) && revealedNodes.has(e.from === nodeId ? e.to : e.from)) {
            stillNeeded = true;
          }
        }
      }
      if (stillNeeded) break;
    }

    // Reset all and re-reveal up to currentStep - 1
    resetVisuals();
    for (let i = 0; i <= currentStep - 1; i++) {
      revealStep(i);
    }
  }
}

function resetVisuals() {
  revealedNodes.clear();
  currentStep = 0;
  document.querySelectorAll('.node-group').forEach(g => {
    g.classList.add('hidden');
    g.classList.remove('active', 'reveal-anim');
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.edge-path').forEach(p => {
    p.classList.add('hidden');
    p.classList.remove('highlight', 'misconception');
    p.removeAttribute('marker-end');
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.edge-label').forEach(l => {
    l.classList.add('hidden');
    l.classList.remove('highlight');
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.misconception-badge').forEach(b => {
    b.classList.remove('visible');
  });
}

function resetAll() {
  resetVisuals();
  document.getElementById('node-detail').innerHTML = '<p style="color:#484f58;font-size:13px;text-align:center;margin-top:40px">点击图中的节点，或逐步揭示以查看详情</p>';
  updateStepControls();
  revealStep(0);
}

function toggleSidebar() {
  const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
  const toggle = document.getElementById('sidebar-toggle');
  const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 768;

  if (isMobile) {
    sidebar.classList.toggle('mobile-open');
    toggle.classList.toggle('open');
    toggle.textContent = sidebar.classList.contains('mobile-open') ? '◀' : '▶';
  } else {
    sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
    toggle.textContent = sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed') ? '▶' : '◀';
  }
}

// Keyboard navigation
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowDown') { e.preventDefault(); nextStep(); }
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') { e.preventDefault(); prevStep(); }
});

// Touch swipe support
let touchStartX = 0, touchStartY = 0;
document.getElementById('diagram-wrap').addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
  touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
  touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
}, { passive: true });
document.getElementById('diagram-wrap').addEventListener('touchend', e => {
  const dx = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - touchStartX;
  const dy = e.changedTouches[0].clientY - touchStartY;
  if (Math.abs(dx) > 50 && Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) {
    if (dx < 0) nextStep(); else prevStep();
  }
}, { passive: true });

// Close sidebar on outside click (mobile)
document.getElementById('diagram-wrap').addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (window.innerWidth <= 768) {
    const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
    if (sidebar.classList.contains('mobile-open')) {
      toggleSidebar();
    }
  }
});

init();
</script>
</body>
</html>

nodes.label: 函数 f(x, y)
nodes.details:
一切始于此——二元函数 f(x, y) 描述了一个曲面。例如温度场、海拔高度等。

在任意一点 (x₀, y₀)，函数都有一个确定的值 f(x₀, y₀)，代表该点的"高度"。

nodes.label: ∂f/∂x（x方向偏导）
nodes.details:
固定 y，只看 x 的变化。偏导数 ∂f/∂x 表示沿 x 轴正方向的变化率。

想象你在山丘上，只沿东西方向走一步，高度上升多少？这就是 x 方向的偏导。

nodes.label: ∂f/∂y（y方向偏导）
nodes.details:
固定 x，只看 y 的变化。偏导数 ∂f/∂y 表示沿 y 轴正方向的变化率。

同样在山丘上，只沿南北方向走一步，高度上升多少？这就是 y 方向的偏导。

nodes.label: 梯度向量 ∇f
nodes.details: 梯度不是标量！它是由两个偏导数组成的向量： ∇f = (∂f/∂x, ∂f/∂y) 这个向量同时包含了大小和方向信息。它的大小表示最陡上升的速率，方向表示最陡上升的方向。
nodes.misconception: ⚠️ 常见误解：梯度是一个标量值。 纠正：梯度是一个向量！它由偏导数作为分量构成，具有方向和大小。∇f 的模 |∇f| 才是标量（最陡上升速率）。

nodes.label: 最陡上升方向
nodes.details:
梯度向量 ∇f 指向函数值增长最快的方向——即最陡上升方向。

就像在山丘上，梯度告诉你在当前点往哪个方向走能最快爬到山顶。与等高线垂直，从低值指向高值。

actions.text: 刚才我们通过拖动实验，感受了梯度向量在平面上如何动态「指路」。现在让我们后退半步，把这个概念的结构重新梳理一遍——梯度为什么是向量？它的「分量」到底从哪里来的？

actions.content: 点击这个节点，看看我们的出发点。

actions.text: 请先点击最上面的「函数 f(x,y)」节点。记住，一切变化都源自这个二元函数。想象它是一片连绵起伏的山地，有高有低，而我们正站在其中某一个点上。

actions.content: 展示x方向的偏导节点。

actions.text: 当我们只考虑东西走向的变化时，就得到了 x 方向的偏导数——这是梯度的第一个分量。单独看，它只是一个标量：告诉你往东走一步，山势上升多快。

actions.content: 展示y方向的偏导节点。

actions.text: 同样，锁定东西方向、只看南北变化，就得到 y 方向的偏导数。这也是一个标量，只能告诉你往北走的陡峭程度。两者各管各的，不能单独告诉你「哪个方向综合起来最陡」。

actions.content: 现在揭示核心节点：梯度向量。注意它的向量性质。

actions.text: 关键的一步来了——把这两个分量组合到一起，我们就得到了梯度。注意，它不再是标量，而是一个向量！两个偏导数是它的坐标，它的「合力」同时决定了方向与大小。这正是最容易被忽略的地方：很多人以为梯度只是一个数值，但它其实有「箭头」，能把两个独立的变化率拧成一股指向最陡上坡的力量。

actions.content: 展示最陡上升方向节点，观察它与梯度向量的连接。

actions.text: 最后，这个梯度向量把它箭头的方向「传递」给了最陡上升方向。所以当我们说「沿梯度方向爬山最快」，本质上就是因为刚才那两个分量合成的向量，天然地指向了局部变化最剧烈、上升最迅猛的方位。大家可以点击最后这两个节点连线上的标注，它特意提醒了常见的误解——梯度是向量，不是单一数字。

    box-shadow: 0 6px 30px rgba(21, 101, 192, 0.7);

  .start-btn:active {
    transform: translateY(0);
  }

  /* Achievement popup */
  .achievement-popup {
    position: fixed;
    top: 80px;
    right: 20px;

    color: #3e2723;
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 16px 20px;
    z-index: 150;
    transform: translateX(120%);
    transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);

    box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.4);

  .achievement-popup.show {

  .achievement-popup .ach-title {
    font-weight: bold;
    font-size: 14px;
    margin-bottom: 4px;

  .achievement-popup .ach-desc {
    font-size: 12px;

  #level-complete {

    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7);

    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    z-index: 180;
  }

  #level-complete.show {
    display: flex;
  }

  .level-complete-card {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a237e, #283593);
    border: 2px solid #64b5f6;
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 32px 40px;
    text-align: center;
    max-width: 400px;
    width: 90%;

  .level-complete-card h2 {
    font-size: 28px;

  .level-complete-card .stars {

    margin: 12px 0;

    font-size: 14px;
    color: #b0bec5;
    margin: 4px 0;

    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1565c0, #42a5f5);
    color: #fff;
    border: none;
    padding: 12px 36px;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: bold;
    border-radius: 10px;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin-top: 16px;
    transition: all 0.2s;
  }

  .level-complete-card .next-btn:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(21, 101, 192, 0.5);

  #pause-overlay {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7);

    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    z-index: 170;

    display: flex;

    text-align: center;

    font-size: 28px;
    color: #64b5f6;

    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1565c0, #42a5f5);
    color: #fff;
    border: none;
    padding: 12px 36px;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: bold;
    border-radius: 10px;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin: 6px;
    transition: all 0.2s;
  }

  .pause-card button:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
  }

  /* Timer bar */
  #timer-bar-container {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 155px;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    height: 4px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    z-index: 11;
  }

  #timer-bar {
    height: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #4caf50, #8bc34a);
    transition: width 0.1s linear;

  }

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const katexOptions = {
        delimiters: [
            {left: '\\[', right: '\\]', display: true},
            {left: '\\(', right: '\\)', display: false},
            {left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true},
            {left: '$', right: '$', display: false}
        ],
        throwOnError: false,
        strict: false,
        trust: true
    };

    let renderTimeout;
    function safeRender() {
        if (renderTimeout) clearTimeout(renderTimeout);
        renderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);
        }, 100);
    }

    renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        let shouldRender = false;
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            if (mutation.target &&
                mutation.target.className &&
                typeof mutation.target.className === 'string' &&
                mutation.target.className.includes('katex')) {
                return;
            }
            shouldRender = true;
        });

        if (shouldRender) {
            safeRender();
        }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true
    });

    setInterval(() => {
        const text = document.body.innerText;
        if (text.includes('\\(') || text.includes('$$')) {
            safeRender();
        }
    }, 2000);
});
</script>

        }
      ],
      distractors: [
        { type: "scalar", value: 0, display: "0" },

  ];

  // ============ ACHIEVEMENTS ============
  const ACHIEVEMENTS = [
    { id: "first_correct", name: "🎯 初露锋芒", desc: "第一次正确放置梯度向量", check: () => completedPoints >= 1 },
    { id: "perfect_level1", name: "🏆 完美通关", desc: "不犯错误完成第一关", check: () => currentLevel >= 2 && streak >= 3 },
    { id: "streak3", name: "🔥 连续命中", desc: "连续正确放置3次", check: () => streak >= 3 },
    { id: "streak5", name: "⚡ 势如破竹", desc: "连续正确放置5次", check: () => streak >= 5 },
    { id: "caught_scalar", name: "👁️ 火眼金睛", desc: "识破标量陷阱并正确放置", check: () => totalScore >= 30 },
    { id: "all_levels", name: "👑 梯度大师", desc: "完成所有关卡", check: () => currentLevel > 5 },
    { id: "speed_demon", name: "💨 速度之王", desc: "在15秒内完成一关", check: () => levelTimer < 15 && completedPoints >= 3 }
  ];

  // ============ UTILITY FUNCTIONS ============
  function shuffle(arr) {
    const a = [...arr];
    for (let i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      [a[i], a[j]] = [a[j], a[i]];
    }
    return a;
  }

  function resizeCanvas() {
    const wrapper = document.getElementById('canvas-wrapper');
    canvas.width = wrapper.clientWidth;
    canvas.height = wrapper.clientHeight;
    pCanvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    pCanvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  }

  function canvasCoords(x, y) {
    return {
      x: x * canvas.width,
      y: y * canvas.height
    };
  }

  // ============ DRAWING FUNCTIONS ============
  function drawSurface() {
    const w = canvas.width;
    const h = canvas.height;

    // Background gradient
    const bgGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(w*0.5, h*0.5, 0, w*0.5, h*0.5, w*0.6);
    bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1a237e');
    bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0d1b3e');
    ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

    // Draw contour lines
    drawContourLines();

    // Draw grid
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(100, 150, 255, 0.08)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let i = 0; i <= 20; i++) {
      const gx = (i / 20) * w;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(gx, 0);
      ctx.lineTo(gx, h);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    for (let i = 0; i <= 20; i++) {
      const gy = (i / 20) * h;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, gy);
      ctx.lineTo(w, gy);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function drawContourLines() {
    const w = canvas.width;
    const h = canvas.height;
    const cx = w * 0.5;
    const cy = h * 0.5;

    // Draw concentric contour-like lines
    ctx.save();
    for (let r = 40; r < Math.max(w, h) * 0.55; r += 35) {
      const intensity = 0.06 + (r / Math.max(w, h)) * 0.12;
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(100, 180, 255, ${intensity})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      // Slightly distorted circles for more natural look
      for (let a = 0; a <= Math.PI * 2; a += 0.05) {
        const distort = 1 + 0.08 * Math.sin(3 * a) + 0.06 * Math.cos(5 * a);
        const rx = r * distort;
        const ry = r * (1 + 0.05 * Math.sin(2 * a));
        const px = cx + rx * Math.cos(a);
        const py = cy + ry * Math.sin(a);
        if (a === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py);
        else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
      }
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Draw contour labels
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(100, 180, 255, 0.25)';
    ctx.font = '12px sans-serif';
    for (let r = 40; r < Math.max(w, h) * 0.55; r += 35) {
      const val = Math.round(r / 7);
      const px = cx + r - 10;
      const py = cy - 8;
      ctx.fillText('h=' + val, px, py);
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawSamplePoints() {
    if (!levelData) return;

    const w = canvas.width;
    const h = canvas.height;

    levelData.points.forEach((pt, idx) => {
      const pos = canvasCoords(pt.x, pt.y);
      const isCompleted = placedVectors.some(v => v.pointIndex === idx);

      if (isCompleted) {
        // Draw completed point with gradient vector
        const placed = placedVectors.find(v => v.pointIndex === idx);
        if (placed) {
          drawGradientVector(pos.x, pos.y, placed.fx, placed.fy, true);
          // Green check
          ctx.fillStyle = '#4caf50';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(pos.x, pos.y, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }
      } else {
        // Draw active sampling point
        const pulse = Math.sin(Date.now() / 500) * 0.3 + 0.7;

        // Outer glow
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(100, 181, 246, ${pulse * 0.3})`;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(pos.x, pos.y, 20, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Inner dot
        ctx.fillStyle = '#64b5f6';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(pos.x, pos.y, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(pos.x, pos.y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Label
        ctx.fillStyle = '#e8eaf6';
        ctx.font = 'bold 14px sans-serif';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText(pt.label, pos.x, pos.y - 18);

        // Show partial derivatives as hint
        ctx.fillStyle = '#90caf9';
        ctx.font = '12px "Cambria Math", serif';
        ctx.fillText(`∂f/∂x=${pt.fx}, ∂f/∂y=${pt.fy}`, pos.x, pos.y + 30);
        ctx.fillText(`∇f = (${pt.fx}, ${pt.fy})`, pos.x, pos.y + 46);
      }
    });
  }

  function drawGradientVector(cx, cy, fx, fy, completed) {
    const scale = 18;
    const endX = cx + fx * scale;
    const endY = cy - fy * scale; // flip y because canvas y is inverted

    const color = completed ? '#4caf50' : '#2196f3';
    const width = completed ? 3 : 2.5;

    // Arrow shaft
    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.lineWidth = width;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
    ctx.lineTo(endX, endY);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Arrow head
    const angle = Math.atan2(endY - cy, endX - cx);
    const headLen = 10;
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(endX, endY);
    ctx.lineTo(endX - headLen * Math.cos(angle - 0.4), endY - headLen * Math.sin(angle - 0.4));
    ctx.lineTo(endX - headLen * Math.cos(angle + 0.4), endY - headLen * Math.sin(angle + 0.4));
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    if (completed) {
      // Glow effect
      ctx.shadowColor = color;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
      ctx.strokeStyle = color;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
      ctx.lineTo(endX, endY);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    }
  }

  function drawPlacedVectors() {
    // Already handled in drawSamplePoints
  }

  // ============ GAME LOGIC ============
  function initLevel() {
    if (currentLevel > LEVELS.length) {
      showAllComplete();
      return;
    }

    levelData = LEVELS[currentLevel - 1];
    levelData.points = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(levelData.points));
    levelData.distractors = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(levelData.distractors));
    
    samplePoints = levelData.points.map((pt, i) => ({
      ...pt,
      index: i,
      completed: false
    }));

    completedPoints = 0;
    totalPointsInLevel = levelData.points.length;
    levelScore = 0;
    levelStartTime = Date.now();
    levelTimer = 0;
    placedVectors = [];
    streak = 0;
    gracePeriod = true;
    graceTimer = Date.now();

    // Update HUD
    document.getElementById('hud-level').textContent = currentLevel;
    document.getElementById('hud-score').textContent = totalScore;
    document.getElementById('hud-progress').textContent = `0/${totalPointsInLevel}`;

    // Update hint
    document.getElementById('hint-formula').textContent = `∇f = (∂f/∂x, ∂f/∂y)`;
    document.getElementById('hint-desc').textContent = levelData.description;

    // Generate candidates
    generateCandidates();

    // Reset timer bar
    document.getElementById('timer-bar').style.width = '100%';
    document.getElementById('timer-bar').style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg, #4caf50, #8bc34a)';

    // Hide level complete
    document.getElementById('level-complete').classList.remove('show');
  }

  function generateCandidates() {
    const container = document.getElementById('candidates');
    container.innerHTML = '';

    // Get the next incomplete point
    let activePointIdx = -1;
    for (let i = 0; i < samplePoints.length; i++) {
      if (!samplePoints[i].completed) {
        activePointIdx = i;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (activePointIdx === -1) return;

    const activePoint = samplePoints[activePointIdx];

    // Build candidate pool
    let pool = [];

    // Correct answer
    pool.push({
      type: 'correct',
      fx: activePoint.fx,
      fy: activePoint.fy,
      display: `(${activePoint.fx}, ${activePoint.fy})`,
      label: '向量',
      pointIndex: activePointIdx
    });

    // Add distractors
    levelData.distractors.forEach(d => {
      if (d.type === 'scalar') {
        pool.push({
          type: 'scalar',
          display: d.display,
          label: '标量'
        });
      } else if (d.type === 'wrong') {
        pool.push({
          type: 'wrong',
          fx: d.fx,
          fy: d.fy,
          display: d.label,
          label: '向量'
        });
      }
    });

    // Shuffle
    pool = shuffle(pool);

    // Limit to reasonable number
    pool = pool.slice(0, 6);

    candidates = pool;

    // Render cards
    pool.forEach((c, i) => {
      const card = document.createElement('div');
      card.className = `candidate-card ${c.type === 'scalar' ? 'scalar-card' : 'vector-card'}`;
      card.dataset.index = i;
      card.dataset.cType = c.type;

      const typeTag = document.createElement('div');
      typeTag.className = 'card-type';
      typeTag.textContent = c.label;

      const content = document.createElement('div');
      content.className = 'card-content';
      content.textContent = c.display;

      card.appendChild(typeTag);
      card.appendChild(content);

      // Touch/mouse events for dragging
      card.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => onDragStart(e, c, card));
      card.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => onTouchStart(e, c, card), { passive: false });

      container.appendChild(card);
    });
  }

  // ============ DRAG AND DROP ============
  let dragCard = null;
  let dragData = null;
  let ghostEl = null;
  let ghostCanvas = null;

  function onDragStart(e, data, cardEl) {
    if (paused || !gameActive) return;
    e.preventDefault();

    dragging = data;
    dragCard = cardEl;

    const rect = cardEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    dragOffsetX = e.clientX - rect.left;
    dragOffsetY = e.clientY - rect.top;

    // Create ghost
    createGhost(data, rect.width, rect.height);
    ghostEl.style.left = (e.clientX - dragOffsetX) + 'px';
    ghostEl.style.top = (e.clientY - dragOffsetY) + 'px';
    ghostEl.style.display = 'block';

    cardEl.style.opacity = '0.3';

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', onDragMove);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', onDragEnd);
  }

  function onTouchStart(e, data, cardEl) {
    if (paused || !gameActive) return;
    e.preventDefault();

    const touch = e.touches[0];
    dragging = data;
    dragCard = cardEl;

    const rect = cardEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    dragOffsetX = touch.clientX - rect.left;
    dragOffsetY = touch.clientY - rect.top;

    createGhost(data, rect.width, rect.height);
    ghostEl.style.left = (touch.clientX - dragOffsetX) + 'px';
    ghostEl.style.top = (touch.clientY - dragOffsetY) + 'px';
    ghostEl.style.display = 'block';

    cardEl.style.opacity = '0.3';

    document.addEventListener('touchmove', onTouchMove, { passive: false });
    document.addEventListener('touchend', onTouchEnd);
  }

  function createGhost(data, w, h) {
    if (ghostEl) ghostEl.remove();
    ghostEl = document.createElement('div');
    ghostEl.style.cssText = `
      position: fixed;
      width: ${w}px;
      height: ${h}px;
      z-index: 1000;
      pointer-events: none;
      display: none;
    `;

    if (data.type === 'scalar') {
      ghostEl.innerHTML = `<div style="width:100%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,152,0,0.8),rgba(255,152,0,0.5));border:2px solid #ff9800;border-radius:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:16px;font-weight:bold;color:#fff;">${data.display}</div>`;
    } else {
      ghostEl.innerHTML = `<div style="width:100%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(33,150,243,0.8),rgba(33,150,243,0.5));border:2px solid #2196f3;border-radius:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:16px;font-weight:bold;color:#fff;">${data.display}</div>`;
    }

    document.body.appendChild(ghostEl);
  }

  function onDragMove(e) {
    if (!dragging || !ghostEl) return;
    ghostEl.style.left = (e.clientX - dragOffsetX) + 'px';
    ghostEl.style.top = (e.clientY - dragOffsetY) + 'px';
  }

  function onTouchMove(e) {
    if (!dragging || !ghostEl) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const touch = e.touches[0];
    ghostEl.style.left = (touch.clientX - dragOffsetX) + 'px';
    ghostEl.style.top = (touch.clientY - dragOffsetY) + 'px';
  }

  function onDragEnd(e) {
    cleanupDrag();
    checkDrop(e.clientX, e.clientY);
  }

  function onTouchEnd(e) {
    cleanupDrag();
    const touch = e.changedTouches[0];
    checkDrop(touch.clientX, touch.clientY);
  }

  function cleanupDrag() {
    if (ghostEl) {
      ghostEl.style.display = 'none';
      ghostEl.remove();
      ghostEl = null;
    }
    if (dragCard) {
      dragCard.style.opacity = '1';
      dragCard = null;
    }
    dragging = null;
    document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onDragMove);
    document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onDragEnd);
    document.removeEventListener('touchmove', onTouchMove);
    document.removeEventListener('touchend', onTouchEnd);
  }

  function checkDrop(clientX, clientY) {
    if (!dragging || !gameActive || paused) return;

    // Check if dropped near an incomplete sample point
    const canvasRect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const dropX = (clientX - canvasRect.left) / canvasRect.width;
    const dropY = (clientY - canvasRect.top) / canvasRect.height;

    let droppedPoint = null;
    for (let i = 0; i < samplePoints.length; i++) {
      if (samplePoints[i].completed) continue;
      const dx = dropX - samplePoints[i].x;
      const dy = dropY - samplePoints[i].y;
      if (Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy) < 0.08) {
        droppedPoint = i;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (droppedPoint === null) {
      // Dropped outside any point - return to tray
      return;
    }

    const pt = samplePoints[droppedPoint];

    // Check if it's a scalar
    if (dragging.type === 'scalar') {
      showFeedback('warning', '⚠️', '标量不能代表方向！', 
        `梯度 ∇f 是一个<strong>向量</strong>，有大小也有方向。<br>标量只有大小，无法指示方向。<br><br>正确梯度应为: ∇f = (${pt.fx}, ${pt.fy})`);
      streak = 0;
      return;
    }

    // Check if correct
    if (dragging.type === 'correct' && dragging.pointIndex === droppedPoint) {
      // Correct!
      pt.completed = true;
      completedPoints++;
      streak++;
      if (streak > bestStreak) bestStreak = streak;

      placedVectors.push({
        pointIndex: droppedPoint,
        fx: pt.fx,
        fy: pt.fy
      });

      // Score
      const timeBonus = Math.max(0, 5 - Math.floor(levelTimer / 10));
      const streakBonus = streak >= 3 ? 3 : 0;
      const points = 10 + timeBonus + streakBonus;
      levelScore += points;
      totalScore += points;

      // Update HUD
      document.getElementById('hud-score').textContent = totalScore;
      document.getElementById('hud-progress').textContent = `${completedPoints}/${totalPointsInLevel}`;

      // Particles!
      spawnParticles(
        samplePoints[droppedPoint].x * canvas.width + canvasRect.left,
        samplePoints[droppedPoint].y * canvas.height + canvasRect.top,
        '#4caf50'
      );

      showFeedback('success', '✅', '正确！', 
        `梯度 ∇f = (${pt.fx}, ${pt.fy})<br>这是一个向量，方向垂直于等高线，指向函数增长最快的方向。` + 
        (streakBonus > 0 ? `<br>🔥 连续正确×${streak}，额外+${streakBonus}分！` : ''));

      // Remove used card
      if (dragCard) dragCard.style.visibility = 'hidden';

      // Regenerate candidates for next point
      setTimeout(() => {
        generateCandidates();
        checkAchievements();
      }, 800);

      // Check level complete
      if (completedPoints >= totalPointsInLevel) {
        setTimeout(() => completeLevel(), 1200);
      }

    } else if (dragging.type === 'wrong') {
      // Wrong vector
      showFeedback('error', '❌', '方向不对！',
        `该点的梯度应为 ∇f = (${pt.fx}, ${pt.fy})<br>你选择的向量方向不正确。<br><br>💡 提示：梯度方向垂直于等高线，指向函数增长最快的方向。`);
      streak = 0;
    }
  }

  // ============ FEEDBACK ============
  let feedbackTimeout = null;
  function showFeedback(type, icon, title, message) {
    const popup = document.getElementById('feedback-popup');
    popup.className = type;
    document.getElementById('fb-icon').textContent = icon;
    document.getElementById('fb-title').textContent = title;
    document.getElementById('fb-message').innerHTML = message;

    popup.classList.add('show');

    if (feedbackTimeout) clearTimeout(feedbackTimeout);
    feedbackTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      popup.classList.remove('show');
    }, 2500);
  }

  // ============ PARTICLES ============
  function spawnParticles(x, y, color) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
      const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 4;
      particles.push({
        x, y,
        vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
        vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
        life: 1,
        decay: 0.015 + Math.random() * 0.02,
        size: 3 + Math.random() * 5,
        color
      });
    }
  }

  function updateParticles() {
    pCtx.clearRect(0, 0, pCanvas.width, pCanvas.height);

    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      p.vy += 0.05; // gravity
      p.life -= p.decay;

      if (p.life <= 0) {
        particles.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }

      pCtx.globalAlpha = p.life;
      pCtx.fillStyle = p.color;
      pCtx.beginPath();
      pCtx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * p.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      pCtx.fill();
    }
    pCtx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  // ============ LEVEL COMPLETION ============
  function completeLevel() {
    const timeTaken = levelTimer;
    const stars = timeTaken < 20 ? 3 : timeTaken < 35 ? 2 : 1;
    const starStr = '⭐'.repeat(stars) + '☆'.repeat(3 - stars);

    document.getElementById('lc-title').textContent = `🎉 第${currentLevel}关完成！`;
    document.getElementById('lc-stars').textContent = starStr;
    document.getElementById('lc-score').textContent = `本关得分: ${levelScore} | 总分: ${totalScore}`;
    document.getElementById('lc-time').textContent = `用时: ${Math.floor(timeTaken)}秒`;

    if (currentLevel >= LEVELS.length) {
      document.getElementById('lc-next-btn').textContent = '🏆 查看成就';
    } else {
      document.getElementById('lc-next-btn').textContent = '下一关 ➜';
    }

    document.getElementById('level-complete').classList.add('show');

    checkAchievements();
  }

  function showAllComplete() {
    document.getElementById('lc-title').textContent = '🏆 全部通关！';
    document.getElementById('lc-stars').textContent = '⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐';
    document.getElementById('lc-score').textContent = `最终总分: ${totalScore}`;
    document.getElementById('lc-time').textContent = `最佳连续: ${bestStreak}次`;
    document.getElementById('lc-next-btn').textContent = '🔄 重新开始';
    document.getElementById('level-complete').classList.add('show');
  }

  // ============ ACHIEVEMENTS ============
  function checkAchievements() {
    ACHIEVEMENTS.forEach(ach => {
      if (!achievedSet.has(ach.id) && ach.check()) {
        achievedSet.add(ach.id);
        showAchievement(ach);
      }
    });
  }

  function showAchievement(ach) {
    const popup = document.getElementById('achievement-popup');
    document.getElementById('ach-title').textContent = ach.name;
    document.getElementById('ach-desc').textContent = ach.desc;
    popup.classList.add('show');
    setTimeout(() => popup.classList.remove('show'), 3000);
  }

  // ============ GAME LOOP ============
  function gameLoop() {
    if (!gameActive) return;

    if (!paused) {
      // Update timer
      levelTimer = (Date.now() - levelStartTime) / 1000;
      const timeLimit = levelData ? levelData.timeLimit : 60;
      const timeRatio = Math.max(0, 1 - levelTimer / timeLimit);
      const timerBar = document.getElementById('timer-bar');
      timerBar.style.width = (timeRatio * 100) + '%';

      if (timeRatio > 0.5) {
        timerBar.style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg, #4caf50, #8bc34a)';
      } else if (timeRatio > 0.25) {
        timerBar.style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg, #ff9800, #ffc107)';
      } else {
        timerBar.style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg, #f44336, #ff5722)';
      }

      // Grace period
      if (gracePeriod && Date.now() - graceTimer > 3000) {
        gracePeriod = false;
      }

      // Draw
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      drawSurface();
      drawSamplePoints();

      // Particles
      updateParticles();
    }

    animFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
  }

  // ============ GAME CONTROLS ============
  window.startGame = function() {
    document.getElementById('start-screen').classList.add('hidden');
    gameActive = true;
    currentLevel = 1;
    totalScore = 0;
    bestStreak = 0;
    streak = 0;
    paused = false;
    achievedSet.clear();
    resizeCanvas();
    initLevel();
    gameLoop();
  };

  window.nextLevel = function() {
    document.getElementById('level-complete').classList.remove('show');
    currentLevel++;
    if (currentLevel > LEVELS.length) {
      // Restart from beginning
      currentLevel = 1;
      totalScore = 0;
    }
    initLevel();
  };

  window.togglePause = function() {
    paused = !paused;
    const overlay = document.getElementById('pause-overlay');
    if (paused) {
      overlay.classList.add('show');
    } else {
      overlay.classList.remove('show');
      // Reset start time to account for pause duration
      levelStartTime = Date.now() - levelTimer * 1000;
    }
  };

  window.restartGame = function() {
    document.getElementById('pause-overlay').classList.remove('show');
    paused = false;
    currentLevel = 1;
    totalScore = 0;
    bestStreak = 0;
    streak = 0;
    initLevel();
  };

  // Save/Load progress
  function saveProgress() {
    const data = {
      totalScore,
      currentLevel,
      bestStreak,
      achievements: [...achievedSet]
    };
    localStorage.setItem('gradientGameProgress', JSON.stringify(data));
  }

  function loadProgress() {
    try {
      const data = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('gradientGameProgress'));
      if (data) {
        return data;
      }
    } catch(e) {}
    return null;
  }

  // Periodically save
  setInterval(() => {
    if (gameActive) saveProgress();
  }, 5000);

  // Handle resize
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    resizeCanvas();
  });

  // Initialize
  resizeCanvas();

  // Draw initial surface
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  drawSurface();

}); // end DOMContentLoaded
</script>
</body>
</html>

widgetConfig.description: 通过拖拽拼图游戏修复'梯度只是一个数'的误解

actions.text: 刚才我们从偏导分量合成出了梯度向量，现在来玩个拼图游戏，看大家是不是也容易掉进'梯度只是一个数'的陷阱里。

actions.content: 点击开始，进入第一个关卡。

actions.text: 屏幕上会给你一组偏导数值，旁边摆着好几个候选项——有标量，也有方向各异的向量。你要做的，就是把那个由分量正确合成的梯度向量，拖到曲面对应的采样点上。

actions.content: 模拟第一关布局：给定 f_x=-2.0, f_y=1.5，选项中有正确向量也有标量干扰项。

actions.text: 仔细看，有个选项就只是一个数字 2.5。大毛、思思，别偷懒把它拖过去了——数字本身是没有方向的，它根本代表不了梯度。

actions.content: 警告：标量选项，无法表示方向。

actions.text: 选对向量，它会稳稳指向局部上升最快的方位；手滑拖了个标量上去，系统就会提醒你：标量无法代表方向。这就是今天挑战的核心——把'梯度是向量'刻进直觉里。

      cursor: pointer;

      width: 20px; height: 20px;
      background: #6366f1;
      border-radius: 50%;
      cursor: pointer;
      border: 2px solid #818cf8;
    }

    button {
      padding: 10px 16px;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: #2a2a3a;
      color: #ddd;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 13px;
      min-width: 44px;
      min-height: 44px;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    button:hover { background: #3a3a4a; }
    button:active { transform: scale(0.95); }
    button.primary { background: #6366f1; color: #fff; }
    button.primary:hover { background: #5558e8; }

    .zoom-btns {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .zoom-btns button {
      width: 44px; height: 44px;
      font-size: 22px; font-weight: bold;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      padding: 0;
    }

    #info {
      position: absolute;
      top: 16px; left: 16px;
      background: rgba(15, 15, 25, 0.88);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      padding: 14px 18px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      max-width: 320px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      color: #ccc;
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    #info h2 {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: #fbbf24;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    #info .formula {
      background: rgba(99,102,241,0.15);
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;
      font-size: 14px;
      color: #e0e0ff;
      margin: 6px 0;
      display: inline-block;
    }
    #info .data-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 2px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    }
    #info .data-label { color: #888; }
    #info .data-value { color: #fbbf24; font-weight: bold; font-family: monospace; }

    .legend {
      position: absolute;
      top: 16px; right: 16px;
      background: rgba(15, 15, 25, 0.88);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      padding: 12px 16px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      color: #ccc;
      font-size: 12px;
    }
    .legend-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin: 4px 0;
    }
    .legend-color {
      width: 24px; height: 4px;
      border-radius: 2px;
    }

    #drag-hint {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 80px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      background: rgba(99,102,241,0.85);
      color: #fff;
      padding: 8px 20px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      font-size: 13px;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: opacity 0.5s;
    }

    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      #info { display: none; }
      .legend { display: none; }
      #controls { padding: 10px 8px 18px; gap: 8px; }
      #drag-hint { bottom: 75px; font-size: 12px; padding: 6px 14px; }
    }
  </style>
