<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const katexOptions = {
        delimiters: [
            {left: '\\[', right: '\\]', display: true},
            {left: '\\(', right: '\\)', display: false},
            {left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true},
            {left: '$', right: '$', display: false}
        ],
        throwOnError: false,
        strict: false,
        trust: true
    };

    let renderTimeout;
    function safeRender() {
        if (renderTimeout) clearTimeout(renderTimeout);
        renderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);
        }, 100);
    }

    renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        let shouldRender = false;
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            if (mutation.target &&
                mutation.target.className &&
                typeof mutation.target.className === 'string' &&
                mutation.target.className.includes('katex')) {
                return;
            }
            shouldRender = true;
        });

        if (shouldRender) {
            safeRender();
        }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true
    });

    setInterval(() => {
        const text = document.body.innerText;
        if (text.includes('\\(') || text.includes('$$')) {
            safeRender();
        }
    }, 2000);
});

  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';

    // === Mathematical functions ===
    function f(x, y) {
      return -0.15 * x * x - 0.12 * y * y + 3;
    }

    function gradient(x, y) {
      return { dx: -0.3 * x, dy: -0.24 * y };
    }

    function gradientMagnitude(x, y) {
      const g = gradient(x, y);
      return Math.sqrt(g.dx * g.dx + g.dy * g.dy);
    }

    // === WebGL check ===
    function checkWebGL() {
      try {
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        return !!(window.WebGLRenderingContext &&
          (canvas.getContext('webgl') || canvas.getContext('experimental-webgl')));
      } catch(e) { return false; }
    }

    // === Main initialization ===
    async function initScene() {
      try {
        if (!checkWebGL()) throw new Error('浏览器不支持 WebGL');

        const container = document.getElementById('canvas-container');
        const width = container.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
        const height = container.clientHeight || window.innerHeight;
        if (width === 0 || height === 0) throw new Error('容器尺寸为零');

        // Scene
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x0a0a1a);
        scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x0a0a1a, 0.012);

        // Camera
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(55, width / height, 0.1, 200);
        camera.position.set(8, 7, 8);

        // Renderer
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(width, height);
        renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
        renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
        renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
        container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Controls
        const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
        controls.enableDamping = true;
        controls.dampingFactor = 0.06;
        controls.minDistance = 4;
        controls.maxDistance = 30;
        controls.target.set(0, 1, 0);

        // === Lighting ===
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.5);
        scene.add(ambientLight);

        const hemiLight = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0x87ceeb, 0x362d1b, 0.5);
        scene.add(hemiLight);

        const dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.2);
        dirLight.position.set(8, 15, 8);
        dirLight.castShadow = true;
        dirLight.shadow.mapSize.set(1024, 1024);
        dirLight.shadow.camera.near = 0.5;
        dirLight.shadow.camera.far = 50;
        dirLight.shadow.camera.left = -10;
        dirLight.shadow.camera.right = 10;
        dirLight.shadow.camera.top = 10;
        dirLight.shadow.camera.bottom = -10;
        scene.add(dirLight);

        const fillLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x4488ff, 0.4);
        fillLight.position.set(-5, 3, -5);
        scene.add(fillLight);

        // === State ===
        const objects = {};
        let arrowScaleFactor = 1.5;
        let gridArrowVisible = true;
        let isDragging = false;
        let gridDensity = 9;

        // === Terrain surface ===
        function createTerrain() {
          const size = 12;
          const segments = 80;
          const geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(size, size, segments, segments);
          geometry.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);

          const positions = geometry.attributes.position;
          const colors = new Float32Array(positions.count * 3);

          const minHeight = f(6, 6);
          const maxHeight = f(0, 0);

          for (let i = 0; i < positions.count; i++) {
            const x = positions.getX(i);
            const y = positions.getZ(i);
            const h = f(x, y);
            positions.setY(i, h);

            // Color by height: blue-green for low, yellow-orange for high
            const t = maxHeight !== minHeight ? (h - minHeight) / (maxHeight - minHeight) : 0.5;
            const r = 0.1 + 0.85 * t;
            const g = 0.3 + 0.5 * t;
            const b = 0.6 - 0.4 * t;
            colors[i * 3] = r;
            colors[i * 3 + 1] = g;
            colors[i * 3 + 2] = b;
          }

          geometry.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
          geometry.computeVertexNormals();

          const material = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
            vertexColors: true,
            flatShading: false,
            shininess: 30,
            specular: 0x222222,
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.92,
            side: THREE.DoubleSide
          });

          const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
          mesh.receiveShadow = true;
          mesh.name = 'surface';
          scene.add(mesh);
          objects.surface = [mesh];

          return mesh;
        }

        const terrain = createTerrain();

        // === Contour lines ===
        function createContourLines() {
          const group = new THREE.Group();
          group.name = 'contours';
          const contourLevels = [0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5];
          const range = 6;
          const resolution = 0.05;

          for (const level of contourLevels) {
            const points = [];
            for (let x = -range; x <= range; x += resolution) {
              for (let y = -range; y <= range; y += resolution) {
                const h = f(x, y);
                if (Math.abs(h - level) < 0.08) {
                  points.push(new THREE.Vector3(x, level + 0.02, y));
                }
              }
            }

            if (points.length > 0) {
              const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(points);
              const material = new THREE.PointsMaterial({
                color: 0xffffff,
                size: 0.04,
                transparent: true,
                opacity: 0.35
              });
              const pointsMesh = new THREE.Points(geometry, material);
              group.add(pointsMesh);
            }
          }

          scene.add(group);
          objects.contours = [group];
          return group;
        }

        const contours = createContourLines();

        // === Grid floor ===
        function createGrid() {
          const gridHelper = new THREE.GridHelper(14, 20, 0x222244, 0x111133);
          gridHelper.position.y = -0.05;
          scene.add(gridHelper);

          // Axes
          const axesHelper = new THREE.AxesHelper(7);
          axesHelper.position.y = -0.04;
          scene.add(axesHelper);

          // Axis labels as sprites
          function makeLabel(text, position) {
            const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            canvas.width = 64; canvas.height = 32;
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
            ctx.font = 'bold 24px sans-serif';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText(text, 32, 24);
            const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
            const spriteMat = new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: texture, transparent: true });
            const sprite = new THREE.Sprite(spriteMat);
            sprite.position.copy(position);
            sprite.scale.set(0.6, 0.3, 1);
            scene.add(sprite);
          }
          makeLabel('x', new THREE.Vector3(7.5, 0.1, 0));
          makeLabel('y', new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.1, 7.5));
          makeLabel('z', new THREE.Vector3(0, 7.5, 0));
        }

        createGrid();

        // === Gradient arrow helper ===
        function createArrow(dir, origin, length, color) {
          const group = new THREE.Group();

          if (length < 0.001) return group;

          const arrowLength = length;
          const shaftRadius = 0.04;
          const headLength = arrowLength * 0.3;
          const headRadius = 0.1;

          // Shaft
          const shaftGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(shaftRadius, shaftRadius, Math.max(arrowLength - headLength, 0.01), 8);
          const shaftMat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ color: color, emissive: color, emissiveIntensity: 0.3 });
          const shaft = new THREE.Mesh(shaftGeo, shaftMat);
          shaft.position.y = (Math.max(arrowLength - headLength, 0.01)) / 2;
          group.add(shaft);

          // Head
          const headGeo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(headRadius, headLength, 8);
          const headMat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ color: color, emissive: color, emissiveIntensity: 0.4 });
          const head = new THREE.Mesh(headGeo, headMat);
          head.position.y = arrowLength;
          group.add(head);

          // Orient
          const up = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);
          const dirNorm = dir.clone().normalize();
          if (dirNorm.length() < 0.0001) return group;

          const quaternion = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(up, dirNorm);
          group.quaternion.copy(quaternion);
          group.position.copy(origin);

          return group;
        }

        // === Sampling point (draggable) ===
        const samplingPoint = new THREE.Mesh(
          new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.15, 24, 24),
          new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
            color: 0xff3333,
            emissive: 0xff0000,
            emissiveIntensity: 0.5,
            shininess: 80
          })
        );
        samplingPoint.castShadow = true;
        samplingPoint.name = 'sampling_point';
        scene.add(samplingPoint);
        objects.sampling_point = [samplingPoint];

        // Gradient arrow for sampling point
        let sampleGradientArrow = new THREE.Group();
        sampleGradientArrow.name = 'gradient_arrow';
        scene.add(sampleGradientArrow);
        objects.gradient_arrow = [sampleGradientArrow];

        // === Grid gradient arrows ===
        let gridArrowsGroup = new THREE.Group();
        gridArrowsGroup.name = 'grid_arrows';
        scene.add(gridArrowsGroup);
        objects.grid_arrows = [gridArrowsGroup];

        function updateSampleArrow() {
          while (sampleGradientArrow.children.length > 0) {
            sampleGradientArrow.remove(sampleGradientArrow.children[0]);
          }

          const x = samplingPoint.position.x;
          const z = samplingPoint.position.z;
          const h = f(x, z);
          const g = gradient(x, z);
          const mag = gradientMagnitude(x, z);

          if (mag > 0.001) {
            const scaledLen = Math.min(mag * arrowScaleFactor, 4);
            const dir = new THREE.Vector3(g.dx, 0, g.dy).normalize();
            const arrow = createArrow(dir, new THREE.Vector3(x, h + 0.05, z), scaledLen, 0xff6633);
            sampleGradientArrow.add(arrow);
          }

          // Update info panel
          document.getElementById('data-pos').textContent = `(${x.toFixed(2)}, ${z.toFixed(2)})`;
          document.getElementById('data-grad').textContent = `(${g.dx.toFixed(3)}, ${g.dy.toFixed(3)})`;
          document.getElementById('data-mag').textContent = mag.toFixed(3);
          document.getElementById('data-height').textContent = h.toFixed(3);
        }

        function buildGridArrows() {
          while (gridArrowsGroup.children.length > 0) {
            gridArrowsGroup.remove(gridArrowsGroup.children[0]);
          }

          const step = 12 / gridDensity;
          for (let i = 0; i <= gridDensity; i++) {
            for (let j = 0; j <= gridDensity; j++) {
              const x = -6 + i * step;
              const z = -6 + j * step;
              const h = f(x, z);
              const g = gradient(x, z);
              const mag = gradientMagnitude(x, z);

              if (mag > 0.01) {
                const len = Math.min(mag * arrowScaleFactor * 0.6, 2.5);
                const dir = new THREE.Vector3(g.dx, 0, g.dy).normalize();
                const arrow = createArrow(dir, new THREE.Vector3(x, h + 0.05, z), len, 0x66aaff);
                gridArrowsGroup.add(arrow);
              }
            }
          }
        }

        // Initial placement
        samplingPoint.position.set(2, f(2, 0), 0);
        updateSampleArrow();
        buildGridArrows();

        // === Drag interaction ===
        const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
        const mouse = new THREE.Vector2();
        const dragPlane = new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), 0);
        const intersectPoint = new THREE.Vector3();

        function getSurfacePoint(clientX, clientY) {
          const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
          mouse.x = ((clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
          mouse.y = -((clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;

          raycaster.setFromCamera(mouse, camera);

          // Intersect with terrain
          const intersects = raycaster.intersectObject(terrain);
          if (intersects.length > 0) {
            return intersects[0].point;
          }

          // Fallback: intersect with a ground plane
          raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(dragPlane, intersectPoint);
          if (intersectPoint) {
            const x = Math.max(-5.5, Math.min(5.5, intersectPoint.x));
            const z = Math.max(-5.5, Math.min(5.5, intersectPoint.z));
            return new THREE.Vector3(x, f(x, z), z);
          }
          return null;
        }

        renderer.domElement.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
          const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
          mouse.x = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
          mouse.y = -((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
          raycaster.setFromCamera(mouse, camera);

          const intersects = raycaster.intersectObject(samplingPoint);
          if (intersects.length > 0) {
            isDragging = true;
            controls.enabled = false;
            renderer.domElement.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
          }
        });

        renderer.domElement.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
          if (!isDragging) return;
          const point = getSurfacePoint(e.clientX, e.clientY);
          if (point) {
            samplingPoint.position.set(point.x, point.y, point.z);
            updateSampleArrow();
          }
        });

        renderer.domElement.addEventListener('pointerup', () => {
          isDragging = false;
          controls.enabled = true;
          renderer.domElement.style.cursor = 'default';
        });

        renderer.domElement.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => {
          isDragging = false;
          controls.enabled = true;
          renderer.domElement.style.cursor = 'default';
        });

        // === UI Controls ===
        document.getElementById('arrow-scale').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
          arrowScaleFactor = parseFloat(e.target.value);
          updateSampleArrow();
          buildGridArrows();
        });

        document.getElementById('grid-density').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
          gridDensity = parseInt(e.target.value);
          buildGridArrows();
        });

        document.getElementById('zoom-in-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
          const dir = new THREE.Vector3();
          camera.getWorldDirection(dir);
          camera.position.addScaledVector(dir, 3);
        });

        document.getElementById('zoom-out-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
          const dir = new THREE.Vector3();
          camera.getWorldDirection(dir);
          camera.position.addScaledVector(dir, -3);
        });

        document.getElementById('reset-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
          camera.position.set(8, 7, 8);
          controls.target.set(0, 1, 0);
          samplingPoint.position.set(2, f(2, 0), 0);
          updateSampleArrow();
        });

        document.getElementById('toggle-arrows-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
          gridArrowVisible = !gridArrowVisible;
          gridArrowsGroup.visible = gridArrowVisible;
        });

        // Hide hint after 5 seconds
        setTimeout(() => {
          const hint = document.getElementById('drag-hint');
          if (hint) hint.style.opacity = '0';
          setTimeout(() => { if (hint) hint.remove(); }, 600);
        }, 5000);

        // === postMessage listener ===
        window.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
          const { action, payload } = event.data || {};

          switch (action) {
            case 'SET_WIDGET_STATE': {
              if (payload.cameraPosition) {
                camera.position.set(payload.cameraPosition[0], payload.cameraPosition[1], payload.cameraPosition[2]);
              }
              if (payload.cameraTarget) {
                controls.target.set(payload.cameraTarget[0], payload.cameraTarget[1], payload.cameraTarget[2]);
              }
              if (payload.pointPosition) {
                const px = payload.pointPosition[0];
                const pz = payload.pointPosition[1];
                samplingPoint.position.set(px, f(px, pz), pz);
                updateSampleArrow();
              }
              if (payload.arrowScale !== undefined) {
                arrowScaleFactor = payload.arrowScale;
                document.getElementById('arrow-scale').value = arrowScaleFactor;
                updateSampleArrow();
                buildGridArrows();
              }
              break;
            }

            case 'HIGHLIGHT_ELEMENT': {
              const { elementId, highlight } = payload;
              if (elementId === 'sampling_point' && objects.sampling_point) {
                objects.sampling_point.forEach(mesh => {
                  mesh.material.emissive.set(highlight ? 0xffff00 : 0xff0000);
                  mesh.material.emissiveIntensity = highlight ? 0.8 : 0.5;
                });
              }
              if (elementId === 'gradient_arrow' && objects.gradient_arrow) {
                objects.gradient_arrow.forEach(g => {
                  g.children.forEach(child => {
                    if (child.material) {
                      child.material.emissiveIntensity = highlight ? 0.8 : 0.3;
                    }
                  });
                });
              }
              if (elementId === 'surface' && objects.surface) {
                objects.surface.forEach(mesh => {
                  mesh.material.opacity = highlight ? 1.0 : 0.92;
                });
              }
              break;
            }

            case 'ANNOTATE_ELEMENT': {
              const { elementId, text } = payload;
              // Could add floating labels; for now log
              console.log(`Annotation on ${elementId}: ${text}`);
              break;
            }
          }
        });

        // === Animation loop ===
        let time = 0;
        function animate() {
          requestAnimationFrame(animate);
          time += 0.016;
          controls.update();
          renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }
        animate();

        // === Resize ===
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
          const w = container.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
          const h = container.clientHeight || window.innerHeight;
          camera.aspect = w / h;
          camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
          renderer.setSize(w, h);
        });

        // Done loading
        document.getElementById('loading').style.display = 'none';

      } catch (error) {
        console.error('场景初始化失败:', error);
        document.getElementById('loading').innerHTML =
          `<div style="text-align:center;color:#ff6b6b;">
            <div style="font-size:24px;margin-bottom:16px;">⚠️</div>
            3D场景加载失败<br>
            <small style="color:#888;">${error.message}</small><br>
            <button onclick="location.reload()" style="margin-top:16px;padding:10px 24px;background:#6366f1;color:white;border:none;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;">重试</button>
          </div>`;
      }
    }

    initScene();
  </script>

actions.text: 刚才我们在挑战里反复确认了：梯度是向量，不是标量。现在我们把视角从平面抬到空间，看看在真实的三维地形上，这个向量到底长什么样。

actions.content: 这是一个三维地形曲面，你可以拖拽旋转视角。

actions.text: 画面上有一个采样点和一条红色箭头，那就是该点的梯度向量。阿杰刚才说喜欢从3D视角获得直观理解——来，先试试用鼠标旋转地形，从侧面观察一下这个箭头和地面的关系。

actions.content: 旋转观察：梯度向量始终垂直于通过该点的等高线，且指向上坡方向。

actions.text: 好，现在让我们把采样点拖到不同位置。先把它放在山腰一个缓坡上，看梯度箭头——比较短，对吧？然后慢慢往陡坡移。

actions.content: 将采样点移至坡度较大的区域，便于对比梯度向量的大小变化。

actions.text: 看到没有？越陡的地方，红色箭头越长。这个长度正是梯度的大小——它告诉我们沿着这个方向走，每一步会上升多快。思思，这和之前方向导数的概念一脉相承：梯度指向的那个方向，方向导数恰好达到最大值。

actions.content: 你还可以用这里的控件微调采样点的坐标，精确观察梯度方向始终对准局部最陡的上坡线。

actions.text: 刚才我们重点探讨了梯度向量的性质，现在将它延伸一步。今天要聚焦的核心概念是：方向导数。它要回答的问题是——如果我们不沿梯度方向走，而是朝一个任意方向移动，函数值的变化率是多少？
我们先明确一下学习目标。学完这一部分后，你应该能比较沿不同方向移动时，函数值变化的快慢。比如爬山时，往东北方向走和往西南方向走，上升速度有什么不同？
核心思想其实可以用一句话概括：方向导数就是梯度在给定方向上的投影分量。记住这个几何直觉，它能帮你避免很多常见错误。
用公式表达就是：沿单位向量u的方向导数，等于梯度向量与u的点积。这正好是梯度在u方向上的投影长度。
但很多同学在这里会产生两个典型误解。我们提前把它们揪出来，免得它们干扰你对后续拖动实验的理解。
第一个误解是：只要沿某个方向走，函数值一定上升。这不对——如果方向与梯度夹角大于90度，点积为负，方向导数就是负的，意味着函数值反而在下降。
第二个误解是：方向导数就是梯度的大小。正确的关系是：方向导数小于等于梯度的大小，只有当方向恰好与梯度同向时，才取等号。这一点在后面的实验中会非常直观地展现出来。

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const katexOptions = {
        delimiters: [
            {left: '\\[', right: '\\]', display: true},
            {left: '\\(', right: '\\)', display: false},
            {left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true},
            {left: '$', right: '$', display: false}
        ],
        throwOnError: false,
        strict: false,
        trust: true
    };

    let renderTimeout;
    function safeRender() {
        if (renderTimeout) clearTimeout(renderTimeout);
        renderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);
        }, 100);
    }

    renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        let shouldRender = false;
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            if (mutation.target &&
                mutation.target.className &&
                typeof mutation.target.className === 'string' &&
                mutation.target.className.includes('katex')) {
                return;
            }
            shouldRender = true;
        });

        if (shouldRender) {
            safeRender();
        }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true
    });

    setInterval(() => {
        const text = document.body.innerText;
        if (text.includes('\\(') || text.includes('$$')) {
            safeRender();
        }
    }, 2000);
});
</script>

<script type="application/json" id="widget-config">

<div class="app-container">
  <div class="header">
    <h1>📐 方向导数 — Directional Derivative</h1>

      <div class="hud-overlay">

        <div class="hud-panel" id="angle-panel">
          <h3>当前方向</h3>

          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="formula-display" id="formula-bar">
        <span class="formula">D<sub>u</sub>f = ∇f · u</span>
        <span style="color:#64748b; margin: 0 8px;">=</span>
        <span class="formula-val" id="formula-result" style="color:#4ade80;">2.83</span>
      </div>

    <div class="controls-panel" id="controls">
      <div class="btn-row">

      <div class="control-group">

          <span>🧭 方向角度 θ</span>
          <span class="value-display" id="direction_angle-display">45°</span>

               min="0" max="360" value="45" step="1" aria-label="方向角度">

        <div class="control-label">

        <div class="presets-row" style="margin-top:4px;">
          <button class="preset-btn active" data-func="0" onclick="setFunction(0)">x² + y²</button>
          <button class="preset-btn" data-func="1" onclick="setFunction(1)">x² - y²</button>
          <button class="preset-btn" data-func="2" onclick="setFunction(2)">xy</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="control-group">
        <div class="control-label">
          <span>📍 采样点位置</span>
          <span class="value-display" id="point-display">(1.0, 1.0)</span>
        </div>
        <div class="presets-row">
          <button class="preset-btn active" data-point="0" onclick="setPoint(0)">(1, 1)</button>
          <button class="preset-btn" data-point="1" onclick="setPoint(1)">(2, 1)</button>

<script>
// ============ MATH FUNCTIONS ============
const functions = [
  { name: 'x² + y²', f: (x,y) => x*x + y*y, grad: (x,y) => [2*x, 2*y] },
  { name: 'x² - y²', f: (x,y) => x*x - y*y, grad: (x,y) => [2*x, -2*y] },
  { name: 'xy',        f: (x,y) => x*y,      grad: (x,y) => [y, x] }
];
const points = [
  { x: 1, y: 1, label: '(1, 1)' },
  { x: 2, y: 1, label: '(2, 1)' },
  { x: 1, y: 2, label: '(1, 2)' }
];

let currentFuncIndex = 0;
let currentPointIndex = 0;

function setFunction(idx) {
  currentFuncIndex = idx;
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-func]').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelector(`[data-func="${idx}"]`).classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('func-display').textContent = functions[idx].name;
  computeAndDraw();
}

function setPoint(idx) {
  currentPointIndex = idx;
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-point]').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelector(`[data-point="${idx}"]`).classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('point-display').textContent = points[idx].label;
  computeAndDraw();
}

// ============ STATE ============
let state = {
  running: false,
  ended: false,
  angle: 45,
  animAngle: 45,
  targetAngle: 45,
  animating: false,
  autoRotate: false,
  autoRotateSpeed: 0.5,
  trail: [],
  time: 0,
  flashTimer: 0
};

// ============ CANVAS SETUP ============
const canvas = document.getElementById('mainCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const dialCanvas = document.getElementById('dialCanvas');
const dialCtx = dialCanvas.getContext('2d');

function resizeCanvas() {
  const wrapper = canvas.parentElement;
  const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  canvas.width = wrapper.clientWidth * dpr;
  canvas.height = wrapper.clientHeight * dpr;
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  computeAndDraw();
}

window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);

// ============ DIAL ============
let dialDragging = false;

function getDialAngle(e) {
  const rect = dialCanvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const cx = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
  const cy = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
  const clientX = e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientX : e.clientX;
  const clientY = e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientY : e.clientY;
  let angle = Math.atan2(clientY - cy, clientX - cx) * 180 / Math.PI;
  if (angle < 0) angle += 360;
  return angle;
}

dialCanvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => { dialDragging = true; updateDialAngle(e); });
dialCanvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { dialDragging = true; updateDialAngle(e); e.preventDefault(); }, { passive: false });
window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => { if (dialDragging) updateDialAngle(e); });
window.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => { if (dialDragging) updateDialAngle(e); }, { passive: false });
window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { dialDragging = false; });
window.addEventListener('touchend', () => { dialDragging = false; });

function updateDialAngle(e) {
  const angle = getDialAngle(e);
  state.angle = angle;
  state.animAngle = angle;
  state.targetAngle = angle;
  document.getElementById('direction_angle-slider').value = Math.round(angle);
  document.getElementById('direction_angle-display').textContent = Math.round(angle) + '°';
  document.getElementById('angle-value').textContent = Math.round(angle) + '°';
  computeAndDraw();
}

// ============ SLIDER ============
document.getElementById('direction_angle-slider').addEventListener('input', function() {
  const v = parseFloat(this.value);
  state.angle = v;
  state.animAngle = v;
  state.targetAngle = v;
  document.getElementById('direction_angle-display').textContent = Math.round(v) + '°';
  document.getElementById('angle-value').textContent = Math.round(v) + '°';
  computeAndDraw();
});

// ============ BUTTONS ============
const mainBtn = document.getElementById('mainBtn');
const resetBtn = document.getElementById('resetBtn');

mainBtn.addEventListener('click', handleMainButton);
resetBtn.addEventListener('click', resetSimulation);

function handleMainButton() {
  if (state.ended) {
    resetSimulation();
    setTimeout(() => startSimulation(), 50);
  } else if (state.running) {
    pauseSimulation();
  } else {
    startSimulation();
  }
}

function startSimulation() {
  state.running = true;
  state.ended = false;
  state.autoRotate = true;
  updateButtonUI();
}

function pauseSimulation() {
  state.running = false;
  state.autoRotate = false;
  updateButtonUI();
}

function resetSimulation() {
  state.running = false;
  state.ended = false;
  state.autoRotate = false;
  state.angle = 45;
  state.animAngle = 45;
  state.targetAngle = 45;
  state.trail = [];
  state.time = 0;
  document.getElementById('direction_angle-slider').value = 45;
  document.getElementById('direction_angle-display').textContent = '45°';
  document.getElementById('angle-value').textContent = '45°';
  computeAndDraw();
  updateButtonUI();
}

function updateButtonUI() {
  const btnText = document.getElementById('btnText');
  const btnIcon = document.getElementById('btnIcon');
  const stateInd = document.getElementById('stateIndicator');
  const stateTextEl = document.getElementById('stateText');

  stateInd.className = 'state-indicator';

  if (state.ended) {
    btnText.textContent = '重新开始';
    btnIcon.textContent = '🔄';
    stateInd.classList.add('stopped');
    stateTextEl.textContent = '结束';
  } else if (state.running) {
    btnText.textContent = '暂停';
    btnIcon.textContent = '⏸';
    stateInd.classList.add('running');
    stateTextEl.textContent = '运行中';
  } else {
    btnText.textContent = '启动';
    btnIcon.textContent = '▶';
    stateInd.classList.add('stopped');
    stateTextEl.textContent = '停止';
  }
}

// ============ PRESETS ============
function applyPreset(idx) {
  const presets = [45, 135, 225, 60];
  const angle = presets[idx];
  state.angle = angle;
  state.animAngle = angle;
  state.targetAngle = angle;
  document.getElementById('direction_angle-slider').value = angle;
  document.getElementById('direction_angle-display').textContent = Math.round(angle) + '°';
  document.getElementById('angle-value').textContent = Math.round(angle) + '°';

  document.querySelectorAll('#presetsContainer .preset-btn').forEach((b, i) => {
    b.classList.toggle('active', i === idx);
  });

  computeAndDraw();
}

// ============ KEYBOARD ============
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.code === 'Space') { e.preventDefault(); handleMainButton(); }
  if (e.code === 'KeyR') { resetSimulation(); }
});

// ============ COMPUTE & DRAW ============
function computeAndDraw() {
  const func = functions[currentFuncIndex];
  const pt = points[currentPointIndex];
  const grad = func.grad(pt.x, pt.y);
  const gradMag = Math.sqrt(grad[0]*grad[0] + grad[1]*grad[1]);
  const gradAngle = Math.atan2(grad[1], grad[0]) * 180 / Math.PI;

  const dirAngleRad = state.angle * Math.PI / 180;
  const u = [Math.cos(dirAngleRad), Math.sin(dirAngleRad)];
  const dirDeriv = grad[0] * u[0] + grad[1] * u[1];

  const dotProduct = dirDeriv / (gradMag || 1);

  // Update HUD
  const ddEl = document.getElementById('dd-value');
  ddEl.textContent = dirDeriv.toFixed(2);
  ddEl.className = 'hud-value ' + (dirDeriv > 0.01 ? 'positive' : dirDeriv < -0.01 ? 'negative' : 'zero');

  document.getElementById('formula-result').textContent = dirDeriv.toFixed(2);
  document.getElementById('formula-result').style.color = dirDeriv > 0.01 ? '#4ade80' : dirDeriv < -0.01 ? '#f87171' : '#fbbf24';

  // Update config value
  const config = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('widget-config').textContent);
  config.variables[1].default = dirDeriv;
  config.variables[2].default = dotProduct;
  document.getElementById('widget-config').textContent = JSON.stringify(config);

  drawMainCanvas(func, pt, grad, gradMag, gradAngle, u, dirDeriv, dotProduct);
  drawDial(gradAngle, state.angle, dirDeriv, gradMag);
}

function drawMainCanvas(func, pt, grad, gradMag, gradAngle, u, dirDeriv, dotProduct) {
  const w = canvas.width / (window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
  const h = canvas.height / (window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

  const cx = w / 2;
  const cy = h / 2;
  const scale = Math.min(w, h) * 0.18;
  const margin = 60;

  // Coordinate transform
  function toScreen(x, y) {
    return [cx + (x - pt.x) * scale, cy - (y - pt.y) * scale];
  }

  // Draw grid
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.15)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let gx = -3; gx <= 3; gx++) {
    for (let gy = -3; gy <= 3; gy++) {
      const [sx, sy] = toScreen(pt.x + gx, pt.y + gy);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(sx, cy);
      ctx.lineTo(sx, cy - h);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx, sy);
      ctx.lineTo(cx - w, sy);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  // Draw contour lines
  const contourLevels = [];
  const f0 = func.f(pt.x, pt.y);
  for (let i = -6; i <= 6; i++) {
    contourLevels.push(f0 + i * 0.5);
  }

  contourLevels.forEach(level => {
    if (level < 0) return;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.25)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    let started = false;
    for (let px = 0; px <= w; px += 2) {
      for (let py = 0; py <= h; py += 2) {
        const mx = pt.x + (px - cx) / scale;
        const my = pt.y - (py - cy) / scale;
        const fv = func.f(mx, my);
        if (Math.abs(fv - level) < 0.05) {
          if (!started) { ctx.moveTo(px, py); started = true; }
          else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
        }
      }
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  });

  // Draw gradient arrow (green)
  const gradLen = Math.min(gradMag * 0.15, 3);
  const gradDirX = grad[0] / (gradMag || 1);
  const gradDirY = grad[1] / (gradMag || 1);
  const [gsx, gsy] = toScreen(pt.x, pt.y);
  const [gex, gey] = toScreen(pt.x + gradDirX * gradLen, pt.y + gradDirY * gradLen);

  ctx.strokeStyle = '#4ade80';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.shadowColor = '#4ade80';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(gsx, gsy);
  ctx.lineTo(gex, gey);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  // Arrowhead for gradient
  drawArrowhead(gex, gey, Math.atan2(gey - gsy, gex - gsx), '#4ade80', 12);

  ctx.font = 'bold 12px sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#4ade80';
  ctx.fillText('∇f', gex + 8, gey - 5);

  // Draw direction arrow (orange)
  const dirLen = 2.5;
  const [dsx, dsy] = toScreen(pt.x, pt.y);
  const [dex, dey] = toScreen(pt.x + u[0] * dirLen, pt.y + u[1] * dirLen);

  ctx.strokeStyle = '#f59e0b';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.shadowColor = '#f59e0b';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(dsx, dsy);
  ctx.lineTo(dex, dey);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  drawArrowhead(dex, dey, Math.atan2(dey - dsy, dex - dsx), '#f59e0b', 12);

  ctx.font = 'bold 12px sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f59e0b';
  ctx.fillText('u', dex + 8, dey - 5);

  // Draw angle arc between gradient and direction
  const startA = -gradAngle * Math.PI / 180;
  const endA = -state.angle * Math.PI / 180;
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.5)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(gsx, gsy, 30, Math.min(startA, endA), Math.max(startA, endA));
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);

  // Angle label
  const midAngle = (startA + endA) / 2;
  ctx.font = '11px sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24';
  const labelR = 40;
  ctx.fillText('θ', gsx + Math.cos(midAngle) * labelR - 6, gsy + Math.sin(midAngle) * labelR + 4);

  // Draw point
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(gsx, gsy, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f8fafc';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#818cf8';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.font = 'bold 11px sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e2e8f0';
  ctx.fillText(`P${pt.label}`, gsx + 10, gsy - 10);

  // Draw trail if running
  if (state.trail.length > 1) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(...toScreen(state.trail[0][0], state.trail[0][1]));
    for (let i = 1; i < state.trail.length; i++) {
      ctx.lineTo(...toScreen(state.trail[i][0], state.trail[i][1]));
    }
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.6)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Draw trail points
    state.trail.forEach(([tx, ty], i) => {
      const [tsx, tsy] = toScreen(tx, ty);
      const alpha = 0.3 + 0.7 * (i / state.trail.length);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(tsx, tsy, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(249, 115, 22, ${alpha})`;
      ctx.fill();
    });
  }

  // Draw elevation bar chart (bottom right)
  drawElevationBar(w, h, dirDeriv, gradMag);

  // Dot product visualizer (bottom left)
  drawDotProductVisualizer(w, h, dotProduct, gradMag, u, grad);
}

function drawArrowhead(x, y, angle, color, size) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.rotate(angle);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(-size, -size * 0.4);
  ctx.lineTo(-size, size * 0.4);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawElevationBar(w, h, dirDeriv, gradMag) {
  const bx = w - 80;
  const by = 80;
  const bw = 40;
  const bh = 120;

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.8)';
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.4)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(bx - 5, by - 5, bw + 10, bh + 30, 6);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.stroke();

  // Bar background
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.5)';
  ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw, bh);

  // Zero line
  const zeroY = by + bh / 2;
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.5)';
  ctx.setLineDash([3, 3]);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(bx, zeroY);
  ctx.lineTo(bx + bw, zeroY);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);

  // Value bar
  const ratio = dirDeriv / gradMag;
  const barH = Math.abs(ratio) * bh / 2;
  const barY = ratio >= 0 ? zeroY - barH : zeroY;
  const barColor = ratio >= 0 ? '#4ade80' : '#f87171';

  if (state.flashTimer > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = barColor;
    ctx.shadowColor = barColor;
    ctx.shadowBlur = 12 * state.flashTimer;
  } else {
    ctx.fillStyle = barColor;
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  }

  ctx.fillRect(bx + 5, barY, bw - 10, barH);
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  // Labels
  ctx.font = '9px sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
  ctx.fillText('max', bx + bw + 4, by + 6);
  ctx.fillText('0', bx + bw + 4, zeroY + 3);
  ctx.fillText('min', bx + bw + 4, by + bh + 3);

  ctx.font = 'bold 10px monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = barColor;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(dirDeriv.toFixed(1), bx + bw / 2, barY + (barH > 15 ? 12 : -5));
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
}

function drawDotProductVisualizer(w, h, dotProduct, gradMag, u, grad) {
  const bx = 60;
  const by = h - 120;
  const bw = 160;
  const bh = 80;

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.8)';
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.4)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(bx - 5, by - 15, bw + 10, bh + 20, 6);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.stroke();

  // Title
  ctx.font = '10px sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#94a3b8';
  ctx.fillText('∇f · u = |∇f| cos θ', bx, by - 3);

  // Draw two vectors and their dot product visually
  const vcx = bx + 45;
  const vcy = by + 35;
  const vs = 25;

  // Gradient vector (green)
  const gNorm = [grad[0] / gradMag, grad[1] / gradMag];
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#4ade80';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(vcx, vcy);
  ctx.lineTo(vcx + gNorm[0] * vs, vcy - gNorm[1] * vs);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Direction vector (orange)
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#f59e0b';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(vcx, vcy);
  ctx.lineTo(vcx + u[0] * vs, vcy - u[1] * vs);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Projection (dashed)
  const projLen = dotProduct * vs / (gradMag || 1);
  if (projLen !== 0) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.5)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.setLineDash([3, 3]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(vcx, vcy);
    ctx.lineTo(vcx + gNorm[0] * projLen * (gradMag > 0 ? 1 : 0), vcy - gNorm[1] * projLen * (gradMag > 0 ? 1 : 0));
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
  }

  // Value
  ctx.font = 'bold 13px monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = dotProduct >= 0 ? '#4ade80' : '#f87171';
  ctx.fillText(`= ${(gradMag * dotProduct).toFixed(2)}`, bx + 80, by + 20);

  // cos theta
  ctx.font = '11px monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#94a3b8';
  ctx.fillText(`cos θ = ${dotProduct.toFixed(3)}`, bx + 80, by + 40);

  // Interpretation
  ctx.font = '10px sans-serif';
  let interp;
  if (dotProduct > 0.95) interp = '⬆ 最大上升';
  else if (dotProduct > 0.1) interp = '↗ 上升减缓';
  else if (dotProduct > -0.1) interp = '→ 几乎不变';
  else if (dotProduct > -0.95) interp = '↘ 下降';
  else interp = '⬇ 最大下降';
  ctx.fillStyle = dotProduct > 0 ? '#4ade80' : dotProduct < 0 ? '#f87171' : '#fbbf24';
  ctx.fillText(interp, bx + 80, by + 58);
}

function drawDial(gradAngle, currentAngle, dirDeriv, gradMag) {
  const w = 180;
  const h = 180;
  dialCtx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

  const cx = w / 2;
  const cy = h / 2;
  const r = 70;

  // Outer ring
  dialCtx.beginPath();
  dialCtx.arc(cx, cy, r + 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  dialCtx.fillStyle = 'rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.9)';
  dialCtx.fill();
  dialCtx.strokeStyle = '#475569';
  dialCtx.lineWidth = 2;
  dialCtx.stroke();

  // Degree markings
  for (let a = 0; a < 360; a += 15) {
    const rad = a * Math.PI / 180;
    const inner = a % 45 === 0 ? r - 12 : r - 6;
    dialCtx.beginPath();
    dialCtx.moveTo(cx + Math.cos(rad - Math.PI/2) * inner, cy + Math.sin(rad - Math.PI/2) * inner);
    dialCtx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(rad - Math.PI/2) * (r + 2), cy + Math.sin(rad - Math.PI/2) * (r + 2));
    dialCtx.strokeStyle = a % 45 === 0 ? '#94a3b8' : '#475569';
    dialCtx.lineWidth = a % 45 === 0 ? 2 : 1;
    dialCtx.stroke();
  }

  // Degree labels
  dialCtx.font = '9px sans-serif';
  dialCtx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
  dialCtx.textAlign = 'center';
  dialCtx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  [0, 90, 180, 270].forEach(a => {
    const rad = a * Math.PI / 180;
    dialCtx.fillText(a + '°', cx + Math.cos(rad - Math.PI/2) * (r + 18), cy + Math.sin(rad - Math.PI/2) * (r + 18));
  });

  // Gradient direction indicator (green arc)
  const gradRad = gradAngle * Math.PI / 180 - Math.PI / 2;
  dialCtx.beginPath();
  dialCtx.arc(cx, cy, r + 4, gradRad - 0.15, gradRad + 0.15);
  dialCtx.strokeStyle = '#4ade80';
  dialCtx.lineWidth = 6;
  dialCtx.stroke();

  // Gradient label
  dialCtx.font = 'bold 9px sans-serif';
  dialCtx.fillStyle = '#4ade80';
  dialCtx.fillText('∇f', cx + Math.cos(gradRad) * (r + 28), cy + Math.sin(gradRad) * (r + 28));

  // Color ring showing directional derivative value
  for (let a = 0; a < 360; a++) {
    const rad = a * Math.PI / 180;
    const dirVec = [Math.cos(rad), Math.sin(rad)];
    const func = functions[currentFuncIndex];
    const pt = points[currentPointIndex];
    const grad = func.grad(pt.x, pt.y);
    const gMag = Math.sqrt(grad[0]*grad[0] + grad[1]*grad[1]);
    const dd = (grad[0] * dirVec[0] + grad[1] * dirVec[1]) / (gMag || 1);

    let color;
    if (dd > 0.1) {
      const t = Math.min(dd, 1);
      color = `rgba(74, 222, 128, ${0.15 + t * 0.6})`;
    } else if (dd < -0.1) {
      const t = Math.min(-dd, 1);
      color = `rgba(248, 113, 113, ${0.15 + t * 0.6})`;
    } else {
      color = 'rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.2)';
    }

    dialCtx.beginPath();
    dialCtx.moveTo(cx + Math.cos(rad - Math.PI/2) * (r - 3), cy + Math.sin(rad - Math.PI/2) * (r - 3));
    dialCtx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(rad - Math.PI/2) * (r + 2), cy + Math.sin(rad - Math.PI/2) * (r + 2));
    dialCtx.strokeStyle = color;
    dialCtx.lineWidth = 3;
    dialCtx.stroke();
  }

  // Current direction pointer
  const dirRad = currentAngle * Math.PI / 180 - Math.PI / 2;
  const pointerLen = r - 20;

  // Glow
  dialCtx.shadowColor = '#f59e0b';
  dialCtx.shadowBlur = state.flashTimer > 0 ? 15 : 8;
  dialCtx.beginPath();
  dialCtx.moveTo(cx, cy);
  dialCtx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(dirRad) * pointerLen, cy + Math.sin(dirRad) * pointerLen);
  dialCtx.strokeStyle = '#f59e0b';
  dialCtx.lineWidth = 3;
  dialCtx.stroke();
  dialCtx.shadowBlur = 0;

  // Arrowhead on dial
  const ax = cx + Math.cos(dirRad) * pointerLen;
  const ay = cy + Math.sin(dirRad) * pointerLen;
  dialCtx.beginPath();
  dialCtx.arc(ax, ay, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  dialCtx.fillStyle = '#f59e0b';
  dialCtx.fill();

  // Center dot
  dialCtx.beginPath();
  dialCtx.arc(cx, cy, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  dialCtx.fillStyle = '#e2e8f0';
  dialCtx.fill();
  dialCtx.strokeStyle = '#818cf8';
  dialCtx.lineWidth = 2;
  dialCtx.stroke();

  // Value display in center
  dialCtx.font = 'bold 14px monospace';
  dialCtx.textAlign = 'center';
  dialCtx.fillStyle = dirDeriv > 0.01 ? '#4ade80' : dirDeriv < -0.01 ? '#f87171' : '#fbbf24';
  dialCtx.fillText(dirDeriv.toFixed(2), cx, cy + 25);
}

// ============ ANIMATION LOOP ============
let lastTime = 0;

function animate(timestamp) {
  const dt = Math.min((timestamp - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
  lastTime = timestamp;

  if (state.running) {
    state.time += dt;
    state.autoRotate = true;

    // Auto-rotate the direction
    const newAngle = state.angle + state.autoRotateSpeed * dt * 30;
    state.angle = newAngle % 360;
    if (state.angle < 0) state.angle += 360;

    // Update slider
    document.getElementById('direction_angle-slider').value = Math.round(state.angle);
    document.getElementById('direction_angle-display').textContent = Math.round(state.angle) + '°';
    document.getElementById('angle-value').textContent = Math.round(state.angle) + '°';

    // Add trail point
    const func = functions[currentFuncIndex];
    const pt = points[currentPointIndex];
    const dirAngleRad = state.angle * Math.PI / 180;
    const u = [Math.cos(dirAngleRad), Math.sin(dirAngleRad)];
    const grad = func.grad(pt.x, pt.y);
    const gradMag = Math.sqrt(grad[0]*grad[0] + grad[1]*grad[1]);
    const dirDeriv = grad[0] * u[0] + grad[1] * u[1];

    if (Math.abs(dirDeriv) > 0.1) {
      const step = 0.01 * (dirDeriv / (gradMag || 1));
      state.trail.push([
        pt.x + u[0] * step * 5,
        pt.y + u[1] * step * 5
      ]);
      if (state.trail.length > 50) state.trail.shift();
    }

    // Flash when near max or min
    const ratio = dirDeriv / (gradMag || 1);
    if (Math.abs(ratio) > 0.95) {
      state.flashTimer = Math.min(state.flashTimer + dt * 3, 1);
    } else {
      state.flashTimer = Math.max(state.flashTimer - dt * 2, 0);
    }

    computeAndDraw();
  } else {
    // Still draw for static display
    if (state.flashTimer > 0) {
      state.flashTimer = Math.max(state.flashTimer - dt * 3, 0);
      computeAndDraw();
    }
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}

// ============ INIT ============
resizeCanvas();
computeAndDraw();
requestAnimationFrame(animate);
</script>
</body>
</html>

widgetConfig.description: 旋转方向拨盘，观察当方向偏离梯度方向时，高度增长率（方向导数）是如何减小的。

actions.text: 刚才我们提到了一个非常重要的结论：方向导数小于等于梯度的大小，只有方向与梯度一致时才取等号。现在就用这个拨盘实验来直观验证一下。

actions.content: 将拨盘旋转到45度，即梯度方向。

actions.text: 看，当前方向与梯度完全一致，读数是2.83，这就是这个点上最大的上升率。旁边的梯度箭头应该也在闪烁。现在慢慢旋转拨盘，让角度偏离45度。

actions.content: 旋转到135度，与梯度垂直。

actions.text: 当方向与梯度垂直时，方向导数归零了。这意味着在这个方向上走，高度暂时不变，就像走在等高线上一样。

actions.content: 继续旋转到225度，完全逆着梯度方向。

actions.text: 现在读数是负2.83，最大的下降率。逆着梯度走，下降得最快。所以方向导数从正最大值到零，再到负最大值，完美地反映了我们走的方向和梯度之间的余弦关系。

actions.content: 这个实时读数面板显式展示了方向导数的变化规律。

content.html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>方向导数：关系图</title>
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
body{font-family:'Segoe UI','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;background:#0d1117;color:#e6edf3;overflow:hidden;height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
#topbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:8px 16px;background:#161b22;border-bottom:1px solid #30363d;flex-shrink:0;z-index:10}
#topbar h1{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;color:#58a6ff;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
#nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-shrink:0}
#nav button{background:#21262d;color:#c9d1d9;border:1px solid #30363d;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;transition:background .2s}
#nav button:hover:not(:disabled){background:#30363d}
#nav button:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:default}
#stepLabel{font-size:13px;color:#8b949e;min-width:80px;text-align:center}
#main{display:flex;flex:1;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
#svgWrap{flex:1;overflow:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;position:relative}
#svgWrap svg{width:100%;height:100%;max-width:1300px}
#sidebar{width:320px;background:#161b22;border-left:1px solid #30363d;overflow-y:auto;padding:0;transition:transform .3s ease,opacity .3s ease;flex-shrink:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
#sidebar.collapsed{transform:translateX(100%);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;position:absolute;right:0;top:0;bottom:0}
#sidebarHeader{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid #30363d}
#sidebarHeader h2{font-size:15px;color:#58a6ff}
#closeSidebar{background:none;border:none;color:#8b949e;font-size:18px;cursor:pointer;padding:4px}
#closeSidebar:hover{color:#e6edf3}
#sidebarContent{padding:16px;flex:1;overflow-y:auto}
#sidebarContent .detail-label{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;color:#f0f6fc;margin-bottom:4px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
#sidebarContent .detail-icon{font-size:22px}
#sidebarContent .detail-desc{font-size:14px;color:#c9d1d9;line-height:1.7;margin:12px 0;padding:12px;background:#0d1117;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #21262d}
#sidebarContent .detail-formula{font-size:15px;color:#ffa657;padding:10px 14px;background:#1c2333;border-radius:6px;margin:10px 0;text-align:center;border:1px solid #30363d;font-family:'Cambria Math','Times New Roman',serif}
#sidebarContent .misconception{background:#3d1f00;border:1px solid #7a4b00;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;margin-top:12px}
#sidebarContent .misconception .mis-title{color:#ffa657;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:6px}
#sidebarContent .misconception .mis-text{color:#e8b97a;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6}
#sidebarContent .evidence{background:#0d2818;border:1px solid #238636;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;margin-top:10px}
#sidebarContent .evidence .ev-title{color:#3fb950;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:6px}
#sidebarContent .evidence .ev-text{color:#7ee787;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6}
#openSidebar{display:none;position:fixed;right:12px;bottom:12px;background:#21262d;border:1px solid #30363d;color:#c9d1d9;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;z-index:20}
#svgWrap{position:relative}
.node-group{cursor:pointer}
.node-group .node-rect{transition:stroke .2s,filter .2s}
.node-group:not(.revealed) .node-rect{fill:#0d1117;stroke:#30363d;opacity:.5}
.node-group:not(.revealed) .node-label,.node-group:not(.revealed) .node-icon,.node-group:not(.revealed) .node-sub{opacity:.3}
.node-group.revealed .node-rect{fill:#ffffff;stroke:#58a6ff}
.node-group.revealed .node-label{fill:#0d1117}
.node-group.revealed .node-sub{fill:#1f2937}
.node-group:not(.revealed) .node-label{fill:#6e7681}
.node-group:not(.revealed) .node-sub{fill:#484f58}
.node-group:not(.revealed) .node-icon{fill:none;stroke:#484f58}
.node-group.revealed .node-icon{fill:#58a6ff;stroke:#58a6ff}
.node-group.selected .node-rect{stroke:#f0883e;stroke-width:2.5}
.edge-group{pointer-events:none}
.edge-group .edge-line{stroke:#484f58;stroke-width:2;fill:none;transition:stroke .4s,opacity .4s}
.edge-group.revealed .edge-line{stroke:#58a6ff}
.edge-group:not(.revealed) .edge-line{opacity:.15}
.edge-group .edge-arrow{fill:#484f58;transition:fill .4s,opacity .4s}
.edge-group.revealed .edge-arrow{fill:#58a6ff}
.edge-group:not(.revealed) .edge-arrow{opacity:.15}
.edge-group .edge-label-bg{fill:#0d1117;rx:4;ry:4;transition:opacity .4s}
.edge-group:not(.revealed) .edge-label-bg{opacity:.15}
.edge-group .edge-label-text{fill:#8b949e;font-size:11px;text-anchor:middle;dominant-baseline:central;transition:fill .4s,opacity .4s}
.edge-group.revealed .edge-label-text{fill:#c9d1d9}
.edge-group:not(.revealed) .edge-label-text{opacity:.15}
#revealFlash{animation:flash .6s ease}
@keyframes flash{0%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px #58a6ff)}100%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 0px transparent)}}
.misconception-badge{fill:#7a4b00;rx:4;ry:4}
.misconception-badge-text{fill:#ffa657;font-size:10px;text-anchor:middle;dominant-baseline:central;font-weight:700}
@media(max-width:768px){
  #sidebar{position:absolute;right:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:85%;max-width:340px;z-index:15}
  #openSidebar{display:block}
  #topbar h1{font-size:14px}
  #nav button{padding:5px 10px;font-size:12px}
}
</style>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const katexOptions = {
        delimiters: [
            {left: '\\[', right: '\\]', display: true},
            {left: '\\(', right: '\\)', display: false},
            {left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true},
            {left: '$', right: '$', display: false}
        ],
        throwOnError: false,
        strict: false,
        trust: true
    };

    let renderTimeout;
    function safeRender() {
        if (renderTimeout) clearTimeout(renderTimeout);
        renderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);
        }, 100);
    }

    renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        let shouldRender = false;
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            if (mutation.target &&
                mutation.target.className &&
                typeof mutation.target.className === 'string' &&
                mutation.target.className.includes('katex')) {
                return;
            }
            shouldRender = true;
        });

        if (shouldRender) {
            safeRender();
        }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true
    });

    setInterval(() => {
        const text = document.body.innerText;
        if (text.includes('\\(') || text.includes('$$')) {
            safeRender();
        }
    }, 2000);
});
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  const NODE_W=180, NODE_H=70, ARROW_OFF=10;
  const config = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('widget-config').textContent);
  const allNodes = [...config.nodes, ...config.branchNodes];
  const nodeMap = {};
  allNodes.forEach(n => nodeMap[n.id] = n);

  const svg = document.getElementById('diagram');
  const edgesLayer = document.getElementById('edgesLayer');
  const nodesLayer = document.getElementById('nodesLayer');
  const misLayer = document.getElementById('misconceptionLayer');

  let currentStep = 0;
  let selectedNode = null;

  function getEdgePath(fromId, toId){
    const f = nodeMap[fromId], t = nodeMap[toId];
    if(!f || !t) return '';
    const dx = t.x - f.x, dy = t.y - f.y;
    let sx, sy, ex, ey;

    if(Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx)){
      sx = f.x;
      sy = dy > 0 ? f.y + NODE_H/2 : f.y - NODE_H/2;
      ex = t.x;
      ey = dy > 0 ? t.y - NODE_H/2 - ARROW_OFF : t.y + NODE_H/2 + ARROW_OFF;
    } else {
      sx = dx > 0 ? f.x + NODE_W/2 : f.x - NODE_W/2;
      sy = f.y;
      ex = dx > 0 ? t.x - NODE_W/2 - ARROW_OFF : t.x + NODE_W/2 + ARROW_OFF;
      ey = t.y;
    }

    const mx = (sx+ex)/2, my = (sy+ey)/2;
    return {path: `M ${sx} ${sy} L ${ex} ${ey}`, mx, my, sx, sy, ex, ey};
  }

  function createEdges(){
    config.edgeRevealOrder.forEach((e, i) => {
      const info = getEdgePath(e.from, e.to);
      if(!info.path) return;
      const g = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','g');
      g.classList.add('edge-group');
      g.dataset.from = e.from;
      g.dataset.to = e.to;
      g.dataset.idx = i;

      const line = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','path');
      line.setAttribute('d', info.path);
      line.setAttribute('marker-end','url(#arrow)');
      line.classList.add('edge-line');
      g.appendChild(line);

      if(e.label){
        const bg = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','rect');
        const text = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','text');
        text.classList.add('edge-label-text');
        text.setAttribute('x', info.mx);
        text.setAttribute('y', info.my - 8);
        text.textContent = e.label;
        const tw = e.label.length * 7 + 12;
        bg.setAttribute('x', info.mx - tw/2);
        bg.setAttribute('y', info.my - 20);
        bg.setAttribute('width', tw);
        bg.setAttribute('height', 16);
        bg.classList.add('edge-label-bg');
        g.appendChild(bg);
        g.appendChild(text);
      }

      edgesLayer.appendChild(g);
    });
  }

  function createNodes(){
    allNodes.forEach(n => {
      const g = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','g');
      g.classList.add('node-group');
      g.dataset.id = n.id;
      g.style.pointerEvents = 'all';

      const rect = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','rect');
      rect.setAttribute('x', n.x - NODE_W/2);
      rect.setAttribute('y', n.y - NODE_H/2);
      rect.setAttribute('width', NODE_W);
      rect.setAttribute('height', NODE_H);
      rect.setAttribute('rx', 10);
      rect.setAttribute('ry', 10);
      rect.classList.add('node-rect');
      g.appendChild(rect);

      const icon = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','text');
      icon.classList.add('node-icon');
      icon.setAttribute('x', n.x - NODE_W/2 + 20);
      icon.setAttribute('y', n.y - 6);
      icon.setAttribute('text-anchor','middle');
      icon.setAttribute('dominant-baseline','central');
      icon.setAttribute('font-size','20');
      icon.textContent = n.icon;
      g.appendChild(icon);

      const label = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','text');
      label.classList.add('node-label');
      label.setAttribute('x', n.x + 8);
      label.setAttribute('y', n.y - 8);
      label.setAttribute('text-anchor','middle');
      label.setAttribute('dominant-baseline','central');
      label.setAttribute('font-size','13');
      label.setAttribute('font-weight','600');
      label.textContent = n.label;
      g.appendChild(label);

      const sub = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','text');
      sub.classList.add('node-sub');
      sub.setAttribute('x', n.x + 8);
      sub.setAttribute('y', n.y + 14);
      sub.setAttribute('text-anchor','middle');
      sub.setAttribute('dominant-baseline','central');
      sub.setAttribute('font-size','10');
      sub.setAttribute('font-family','Cambria Math, Times New Roman, serif');
      sub.textContent = n.sub;
      g.appendChild(sub);

      g.addEventListener('click', () => onNodeClick(n.id));

      nodesLayer.appendChild(g);
    });
  }

  function createMisconception(){
    const mp = config.misconceptionPos;
    const g = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','g');
    g.classList.add('misconception-badge-group');
    g.style.display = 'none';

    const bg = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','rect');
    bg.setAttribute('x', mp.x - 60);
    bg.setAttribute('y', mp.y - 18);
    bg.setAttribute('width', 120);
    bg.setAttribute('height', 36);
    bg.classList.add('misconception-badge');
    g.appendChild(bg);

    const txt = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','text');
    txt.classList.add('misconception-badge-text');
    txt.setAttribute('x', mp.x);
    txt.setAttribute('y', mp.y);
    txt.textContent = '⚠️ 并非所有方向都上升！';
    g.appendChild(txt);

    misLayer.appendChild(g);
  }

  function onNodeClick(id){
    const n = nodeMap[id];
    if(!n) return;
    const g = nodesLayer.querySelector(`[data-id="${id}"]`);
    if(!g.classList.contains('revealed')) return;

    selectedNode = id;
    document.querySelectorAll('.node-group.selected').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('selected'));
    g.classList.add('selected');

    showSidebar(n);
  }

  function showSidebar(n){
    const sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');
    const content = document.getElementById('sidebarContent');
    const title = document.getElementById('sbTitle');
    title.textContent = n.label;

    let html = `<div class="detail-label"><span class="detail-icon">${n.icon}</span>${n.label}</div>`;
    html += `<div style="font-size:12px;color:#58a6ff;font-family:'Cambria Math',serif;margin-bottom:8px">${n.sub}</div>`;
    html += `<div class="detail-desc">${n.details}</div>`;
    if(n.formula) html += `<div class="detail-formula">${n.formula}</div>`;
    if(n.misconception){
      html += `<div class="misconception"><div class="mis-title">⚠️ 常见误解</div><div class="mis-text">${n.misconception}</div></div>`;
    }
    if(n.evidence){
      html += `<div class="evidence"><div class="ev-title">🔍 可观察证据</div><div class="ev-text">${n.evidence}</div></div>`;
    }
    content.innerHTML = html;
    sb.classList.remove('collapsed');
  }

  function closeSidebar(){
    document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('collapsed');
    document.querySelectorAll('.node-group.selected').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('selected'));
    selectedNode = null;
  }

  window.closeSidebar = closeSidebar;
  window.openSidebar = function(){
    if(selectedNode){
      showSidebar(nodeMap[selectedNode]);
    }
  };

  function revealStep(step){
    const nodeId = config.revealOrder[step];
    if(!nodeId) return;
    const g = nodesLayer.querySelector(`[data-id="${nodeId}"]`);
    if(g){
      g.classList.add('revealed');
      g.id = 'revealFlash';
      setTimeout(()=>{g.removeAttribute('id');},600);
    }

    const edgeInfo = config.edgeRevealOrder[step];
    if(edgeInfo){
      const eg = edgesLayer.querySelector(`[data-from="${edgeInfo.from}"][data-to="${edgeInfo.to}"]`);
      if(eg) eg.classList.add('revealed');
    }

    if(nodeId === 'n5'){
      misLayer.querySelector('.misconception-badge-group').style.display = 'block';
    }
  }

  function hideStep(step){
    const nodeId = config.revealOrder[step];
    if(!nodeId) return;
    const g = nodesLayer.querySelector(`[data-id="${nodeId}"]`);
    if(g) g.classList.remove('revealed');

    const edgeInfo = config.edgeRevealOrder[step];
    if(edgeInfo){
      const eg = edgesLayer.querySelector(`[data-from="${edgeInfo.from}"][data-to="${edgeInfo.to}"]`);
      if(eg) eg.classList.remove('revealed');
    }

    if(nodeId === 'n5'){
      misLayer.querySelector('.misconception-badge-group').style.display = 'none';
    }
  }

  window.nextStep = function(){
    if(currentStep < config.revealOrder.length){
      revealStep(currentStep);
      currentStep++;
      updateUI();
    }
  };

  window.prevStep = function(){
    if(currentStep > 0){
      currentStep--;
      hideStep(currentStep);
      updateUI();
    }
  };

  function updateUI(){
    document.getElementById('prevBtn').disabled = currentStep === 0;
    document.getElementById('nextBtn').disabled = currentStep >= config.revealOrder.length;
    document.getElementById('stepLabel').textContent = `步骤 ${currentStep}/${config.revealOrder.length}`;
  }

  // Auto-reveal first node
  function init(){
    createEdges();
    createNodes();
    createMisconception();
    revealStep(0);
    currentStep = 1;
    updateUI();
  }

  init();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

nodes.label: 单位方向向量
nodes.details: 方向导数所考察的「方向」，必须是一个长度为 1 的向量（即 |u⃗| = 1）。这保证了我们是在比较单位长度内的变化率，而非受向量长度影响。
nodes.evidence: 你可以把 u⃗ 想象成一个指南针的指针——它只指明方向，长短被固定为 1。

nodes.label: 梯度向量
nodes.details: 梯度向量 ∇f 指向函数 f 在某点处增长最快的方向，其模 |∇f| 表示该方向上的最大变化率。梯度是多元函数偏导数组成的向量。
nodes.evidence: 梯度始终垂直于过该点的等高线（等值面），沿着梯度方向走，函数值上升最快。

nodes.label: 内积运算
nodes.details: 方向导数的核心计算：将梯度向量与单位方向向量进行内积（点乘）。内积运算综合了两个向量的大小和它们之间的夹角。
nodes.evidence: 由于 |u⃗| = 1，内积简化为 |∇f|·cosθ，其中 θ 是梯度与 u⃗ 的夹角。这说明方向导数完全由梯度和夹角决定！

nodes.label: 方向导数值
nodes.details: 方向导数的值 = 梯度在该方向上的投影。它表示函数沿指定单位方向 u⃗ 的变化率。正数表示上升，负数表示下降，零表示不变。
nodes.evidence: 这个值可正可负可零——关键在于 cosθ 的符号，即梯度与考察方向之间的夹角关系。

nodes.label: 判定：上升/下降/不变
nodes.sub: 由 cosθ 的符号决定
nodes.details: 根据方向导数值的正负号，判断函数沿该方向是上升、下降还是不变。这是理解方向导数物理意义的核心步骤。
nodes.misconception: ⚠️ 常见误解：「方向导数总是正的——函数总在某个方向上升」。事实：当方向与梯度夹角 > 90° 时，方向导数为负，函数值下降！并非所有方向都上升。
nodes.evidence: 展开此节点即可验证：当 θ ∈ (90°, 180°] 时 cosθ < 0，方向导数为负——函数值沿该方向下降。这是理解多元函数变化行为的关键。

actions.text: 好，刚刚我们通过拖动实验，直观感受了方向导数随夹角的变化。现在，我们用一个关系图，把方向导数的逻辑结构彻底理清。

actions.content: 首先出现的是单位方向向量。

actions.text: 首先，我们考察一个方向，就需要一个单位方向向量，记作u向量。它只指明方向，长度被固定为1。

actions.content: 接着出现梯度向量。

actions.text: 同时，在某一点上，函数自身有一个梯度向量，代表该点变化率最大的方向和大小。

actions.content: 然后出现核心的内积运算节点。

actions.text: 这两个向量，通过内积运算结合在一起，就得到了沿该方向的变化率。这正是我们刚做的拖动实验的数学表达。

actions.content: 接着出现方向导数值。

actions.text: 内积的结果，就是方向导数的值。关键在于，因为u向量是单位向量，它的值就等于梯度的大小乘以它们夹角的余弦。

actions.content: 最后，我们看判定节点，并展开它。

actions.text: 所以，方向导数的正负完全由cosθ决定。现在，让我们展开这个判定节点，来看看一个特别容易出错的地方。

actions.content: 注意！这里就是我们刚才实验证实的：当夹角大于90度时，方向导数为负，函数值下降。

actions.text: 你看，当我们的方向与梯度夹角超过90度，cosθ为负，方向导数就是负数，函数值下降。并非所有方向都上升！这是理解多元函数变化的关键。

scenes.title: 方向导数：误解修复挑战

content.html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
<title>方向导数：误解修复挑战 - 梯度山丘冒险</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  body {
    background: #0a0e27;
    font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif;
    overflow: hidden;
    touch-action: none;
    user-select: none;
    color: #fff;
  }
  #game-container {
    position: relative;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }
  #gameCanvas {
    display: block;
    background: #1a1e3a;
    border-radius: 8px;
  }
  #hud {
    position: absolute;
    top: 10px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    display: flex;
    gap: 15px;
    align-items: center;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
    padding: 8px 18px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    font-size: 14px;
    z-index: 10;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .hud-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 5px;
  }
  .hud-label { color: #aaa; font-size: 12px; }
  .hud-value { font-weight: bold; font-size: 16px; }
  .hud-value.height { color: #f39c12; }
  .hud-value.score { color: #2ecc71; }
  .hud-value.timer { color: #e74c3c; }
  .hud-value.level { color: #3498db; }

  #objective-bar {
    position: absolute;
    top: 55px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
    padding: 6px 20px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: bold;
    z-index: 10;
    text-align: center;
    border: 2px solid;
    transition: border-color 0.3s;
  }
  #objective-bar.descend { border-color: #3498db; color: #3498db; }
  #objective-bar.ascend { border-color: #e74c3c; color: #e74c3c; }
  #objective-bar.contour { border-color: #f1c40f; color: #f1c40f; }

  #height-gauge {
    position: absolute;
    right: 15px;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    width: 30px;
    height: 200px;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    border-radius: 15px;
    border: 2px solid #555;
    z-index: 10;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  #height-fill {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    width: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(to top, #3498db, #e74c3c);
    border-radius: 0 0 13px 13px;
    transition: height 0.1s;
  }
  #height-marker {
    position: absolute;
    left: -5px;
    width: 40px;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #fff;
    transition: top 0.1s;
  }
  #height-label {
    position: absolute;
    right: 50px;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #aaa;
    writing-mode: vertical-rl;
    z-index: 10;
  }

  #controls {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 15px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    z-index: 10;
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    align-items: center;
  }
  .ctrl-btn {
    width: 56px;
    height: 56px;
    border-radius: 14px;
    border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 22px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  }
  .ctrl-btn:active {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    transform: scale(0.92);
  }
  .ctrl-btn.active {
    background: rgba(52,152,219,0.5);
    border-color: #3498db;
  }
  #speed-control {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 80px;
    right: 15px;
    z-index: 10;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
  }
  #speed-control label {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #aaa;
  }
  #speed-slider {
    width: 60px;
    height: 8px;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    background: #333;
    border-radius: 4px;
    outline: none;
  }
  #speed-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    width: 22px;
    height: 22px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #3498db;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  #start-screen, #level-screen, #gameover-screen, #pause-screen {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: rgba(10,14,39,0.95);
    z-index: 100;
    padding: 20px;
  }
  .hidden { display: none !important; }
  .screen-title {
    font-size: 28px;
    font-weight: bold;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .screen-subtitle {
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #aaa;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    text-align: center;
    max-width: 500px;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
  .screen-info {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 15px 20px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    max-width: 450px;
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.8;
    color: #ccc;
  }
  .screen-info strong { color: #3498db; }
  .screen-info em { color: #f39c12; font-style: normal; }
  .game-btn {
    padding: 14px 40px;
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: bold;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 12px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.2s;
    margin: 5px;
    font-family: inherit;
  }
  .game-btn.primary {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3498db, #2980b9);
    color: #fff;
  }
  .game-btn.primary:hover { transform: scale(1.05); }
  .game-btn.secondary {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    color: #fff;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
  }
  .game-btn.secondary:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }

  .formula {
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
    padding: 8px 14px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #f1c40f;
    margin: 10px 0;
    text-align: center;
  }

  #achievement-popup {
    position: absolute;
    top: 80px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-100px);
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f39c12, #e67e22);
    padding: 12px 25px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    font-weight: bold;
    font-size: 15px;
    z-index: 50;
    transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  #achievement-popup.show {
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
  }

  #gradient-info {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 80px;
    left: 15px;
    z-index: 10;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
    padding: 8px 12px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
  #gradient-info .angle-val {
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: bold;
  }
  #gradient-info .angle-desc {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #aaa;
  }

  .particle {
    position: absolute;
    pointer-events: none;
    border-radius: 50%;
    z-index: 5;
  }

  @media (max-width: 600px) {
    #hud { font-size: 12px; padding: 6px 12px; gap: 10px; }
    .hud-value { font-size: 14px; }
    .screen-title { font-size: 22px; }
    .screen-subtitle { font-size: 14px; }
    .ctrl-btn { width: 50px; height: 50px; font-size: 20px; }
    #height-gauge { width: 24px; height: 150px; right: 8px; }
    #gradient-info { display: none; }
  }
</style>

        const text = document.body.innerText;
        if (text.includes('\\(') || text.includes('$$')) {
            safeRender();
        }
    }, 2000);
});
</script>

      func: function(x,y) { return Math.sin(x) * Math.cos(y); },

      objective: 'descend',
      targetDelta: -0.6,
