      info: "📍 你在波浪曲面 f(x,y)=sin(x)·cos(y) 的波峰<br>🎯 <strong>任务：下降到山谷！</strong><br>💡 在波峰处梯度为零，稍微偏离后梯度指引最陡上升<br>⬇️ 先选择任意方向离开波峰，然后跟踪梯度反方向",
      hint: "先从波峰移开，然后跟随梯度反方向"
    },
    {
      name: "关卡 6：终极挑战 - 混合任务",
      func: function(x,y) { return x*x*x - 3*x*y*y; },
      gradFunc: function(x,y) { return { gx: 3*x*x - 3*y*y, gy: -6*x*y }; },
      bounds: { minX: -2.5, maxX: 2.5, minY: -2.5, maxY: 2.5 },
      startPos: { x: 1.5, y: 1.0 },
      objective: 'descend',
      targetDelta: -2.0,
      timeLimit: 45,
      info: "📍 你在猴子鞍 f(x,y)=x³-3xy² 上<br>🎯 <strong>任务：下降到指定高度！</strong><br>💡 这个地形有三个"山谷"方向<br>⬇️ 仔细观察梯度箭头，找到下降的方向",
      hint: "尝试不同方向，观察高度变化"
    }
  ];

  // Resize canvas
  function resizeCanvas() {
    const container = document.getElementById('game-container');
    const w = container.clientWidth;
    const h = container.clientHeight;
    const size = Math.min(w, h) * 0.85;
    canvas.width = size;
    canvas.height = size;
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);
  resizeCanvas();

  // Terrain functions
  function evaluateTerrain(x, y) {
    return terrainFunc(x, y);
  }

  function getGradient(x, y) {
    return gradientFunc(x, y);
  }

  function heightToColor(h) {
    const t = (h - heightMin) / (heightMax - heightMin + 0.001);
    // Blue (low) -> Green -> Yellow -> Red (high)
    let r, g, b;
    if (t < 0.25) {
      r = 0; g = Math.floor(t * 4 * 180); b = 200 + Math.floor(t * 4 * 55);
    } else if (t < 0.5) {
      const s = (t - 0.25) * 4;
      r = Math.floor(s * 100); g = 180 + Math.floor(s * 75); b = Math.floor((1-s) * 255);
    } else if (t < 0.75) {
      const s = (t - 0.5) * 4;
      r = 100 + Math.floor(s * 155); g = 255 - Math.floor(s * 100); b = 0;
    } else {
      const s = (t - 0.75) * 4;
      r = 255; g = Math.floor((1-s) * 155); b = 0;
    }
    return `rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;
  }

  // Draw terrain
  function drawTerrain() {
    const size = canvas.width;
    const b = terrainBounds;
    const pixelStep = 4; // resolution

    // Create offscreen buffer for terrain
    const imgData = ctx.createImageData(size, size);
    const data = imgData.data;

    for (let py = 0; py < size; py += pixelStep) {
      for (let px = 0; px < size; px += pixelStep) {
        const x = b.minX + (px / size) * (b.maxX - b.minX);
        const y = b.minY + (py / size) * (b.maxY - b.minY);
        const h = evaluateTerrain(x, y);
        const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (h - heightMin) / (heightMax - heightMin + 0.001)));

        let r, g, b_col;
        if (t < 0.25) {
          r = 30; g = Math.floor(t * 4 * 150) + 50; b_col = 100 + Math.floor(t * 4 * 100);
        } else if (t < 0.5) {
          const s = (t - 0.25) * 4;
          r = Math.floor(s * 80) + 30; g = 200; b_col = Math.floor((1-s) * 200) + 50;
        } else if (t < 0.75) {
          const s = (t - 0.5) * 4;
          r = 110 + Math.floor(s * 145); g = 200 - Math.floor(s * 80); b_col = Math.floor((1-s) * 150);
        } else {
          const s = (t - 0.75) * 4;
          r = 255; g = 120 - Math.floor(s * 80); b_col = Math.floor((1-s) * 150);
        }

        for (let dy = 0; dy < pixelStep && py + dy < size; dy++) {
          for (let dx = 0; dx < pixelStep && px + dx < size; dx++) {
            const idx = ((py + dy) * size + (px + dx)) * 4;
            data[idx] = r;
            data[idx + 1] = g;
            data[idx + 2] = b_col;
            data[idx + 3] = 255;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    ctx.putImageData(imgData, 0, 0);

    // Draw contour lines
    drawContourLines();
  }

  function drawContourLines() {
    const size = canvas.width;
    const b = terrainBounds;
    const range = heightMax - heightMin;
    const numContours = 8;
    const contourStep = range / numContours;

    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;

    for (let c = 0; c < numContours; c++) {
      const targetH = heightMin + (c + 0.5) * contourStep;
      // Marching squares simplified - just sample and interpolate
      const step = 3;
      for (let py = 0; py < size - step; py += step) {
        for (let px = 0; px < size - step; px += step) {
          const x1 = b.minX + (px / size) * (b.maxX - b.minX);
          const y1 = b.minY + (py / size) * (b.maxY - b.minY);
          const x2 = b.minX + ((px + step) / size) * (b.maxX - b.minX);
          const y2 = b.minY + ((py + step) / size) * (b.maxY - b.minY);

          const h1 = evaluateTerrain(x1, y1);
          const h2 = evaluateTerrain(x2, y1);
          const h3 = evaluateTerrain(x1, y2);

          // Check edges for crossing
          if ((h1 - targetH) * (h2 - targetH) < 0) {
            const t = (targetH - h1) / (h2 - h1 + 0.0001);
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(px + t * step, py);
            ctx.lineTo(px + t * step, py + step);
            ctx.stroke();
          }
          if ((h1 - targetH) * (h3 - targetH) < 0) {
            const t = (targetH - h1) / (h3 - h1 + 0.0001);
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(px, py + t * step);
            ctx.lineTo(px + step, py + t * step);
            ctx.stroke();
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Draw gradient arrow
  function drawGradientArrow() {
    const size = canvas.width;
    const b = terrainBounds;
    const gx = canvas.width / 2;
    const gy = canvas.height / 2;

    const grad = getGradient(player.x, player.y);
    const gradMag = Math.sqrt(grad.gx * grad.gx + grad.gy * grad.gy);

    if (gradMag < 0.01) return; // Near critical point

    const scale = Math.min(50, gradMag * 15);
    const dx = (grad.gx / gradMag) * scale;
    const dy = -(grad.gy / gradMag) * scale; // Flip y for canvas

    // Gradient direction arrow (steepest ascent)
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#e74c3c';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.shadowColor = '#e74c3c';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(gx, gy);
    ctx.lineTo(gx + dx, gy + dy);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Arrowhead
    const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
    const headLen = 10;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(gx + dx, gy + dy);
    ctx.lineTo(gx + dx - headLen * Math.cos(angle - 0.4), gy + dy - headLen * Math.sin(angle - 0.4));
    ctx.moveTo(gx + dx, gy + dy);
    ctx.lineTo(gx + dx - headLen * Math.cos(angle + 0.4), gy + dy - headLen * Math.sin(angle + 0.4));
    ctx.stroke();

    // Label
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
    ctx.font = 'bold 11px sans-serif';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    ctx.fillText('∇f (最陡上升)', gx + dx * 0.5 - 25, gy + dy * 0.5 - 10);
    ctx.restore();

    // Negative gradient arrow (steepest descent)
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(52,152,219,0.6)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(gx, gy);
    ctx.lineTo(gx - dx * 0.7, gy - dy * 0.7);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(52,152,219,0.8)';
    ctx.font = '10px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('下降方向', gx - dx * 0.7 * 0.5 - 15, gy - dy * 0.7 * 0.5 - 8);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // Draw player
  function drawPlayer() {
    const size = canvas.width;
    const b = terrainBounds;
    const px = (player.x - b.minX) / (b.maxX - b.minX) * size;
    const py = (player.y - b.minY) / (b.maxY - b.minY) * size;

    // Trail
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < playerTrail.length; i++) {
      const tx = (playerTrail[i].x - b.minX) / (b.maxX - b.minX) * size;
      const ty = (playerTrail[i].y - b.minY) / (b.maxY - b.minY) * size;
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(tx, ty);
      else ctx.lineTo(tx, ty);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    // Player circle
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = '#fff';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(px, py, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Inner circle
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3498db';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(px, py, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Direction indicator
    if (player.speed > 0.001) {
      const dirLen = 18;
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#f1c40f';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(px, py);
      ctx.lineTo(px + Math.cos(player.angle) * dirLen, py - Math.sin(player.angle) * dirLen);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // Draw target zone
  function drawTargetZone() {
    if (objective !== 'contour') return;
    const size = canvas.width;
    const b = terrainBounds;

    // Show target height ring
    const targetH = targetHeight;
    const step = 2;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(241,196,15,0.6)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.setLineDash([6, 4]);

    for (let py = 0; py < size; py += step) {
      for (let px = 0; px < size; px += step) {
        const x = b.minX + (px / size) * (b.maxX - b.minX);
        const y = b.minY + (py / size) * (b.maxY - b.minY);
        const h = evaluateTerrain(x, y);
        if (Math.abs(h - targetH) < 0.3) {
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(241,196,15,0.15)';
          ctx.fillRect(px, py, step, step);
        }
      }
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // Update HUD
  function updateHUD() {
    const h = evaluateTerrain(player.x, player.y);
    player.height = h;
    document.getElementById('hud-height').textContent = h.toFixed(2);
    document.getElementById('hud-score').textContent = score;
    document.getElementById('hud-level').textContent = currentLevel + 1;

    // Height gauge
    const t = (h - heightMin) / (heightMax - heightMin + 0.001);
    const pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, t * 100));
    document.getElementById('height-fill').style.height = pct + '%';

    // Gradient info
    const grad = getGradient(player.x, player.y);
    const gradMag = Math.sqrt(grad.gx * grad.gx + grad.gy * grad.gy);
    document.getElementById('gradient-val').textContent = `(${grad.gx.toFixed(1)}, ${grad.gy.toFixed(1)})`;

    if (player.speed > 0.001 && gradMag > 0.01) {
      const dotProd = grad.gx * Math.cos(player.angle) + grad.gy * Math.sin(player.angle);
      const angleDeg = Math.acos(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, dotProd / (gradMag + 0.001)))) * 180 / Math.PI;
      document.getElementById('angle-val').textContent = angleDeg.toFixed(1) + '°';

      if (angleDeg < 90) {
        document.getElementById('angle-desc').textContent = '锐角 → 上升 ↑';
        document.getElementById('angle-desc').style.color = '#e74c3c';
      } else if (angleDeg > 90 && angleDeg < 180) {
        document.getElementById('angle-desc').textContent = '钝角 → 下降 ↓';
        document.getElementById('angle-desc').style.color = '#3498db';
      } else {
        document.getElementById('angle-desc').textContent = '垂直 → 等高 →';
        document.getElementById('angle-desc').style.color = '#f1c40f';
      }
    } else {
      document.getElementById('angle-val').textContent = '—';
      document.getElementById('angle-desc').textContent = '按方向键开始移动';
      document.getElementById('angle-desc').style.color = '#aaa';
    }
  }

  // Particles
  function spawnParticles(x, y, color, count) {
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      particles.push({
        x: x,
        y: y,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4,
        vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4,
        life: 1,
        color: color,
        size: Math.random() * 4 + 2
      });
    }
  }

  function updateParticles() {
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      p.life -= 0.02;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    particles.forEach(p => {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    });
  }

  // Check objective
  let startHeight = 0;
  function checkObjective() {
    if (achieved || gracePeriod) return;

    const h = player.height;
    const level = levels[currentLevel];

    if (objective === 'descend') {
      if (h <= startHeight + level.targetDelta) {
        levelComplete();
      }
      // Fail: went up too much
      if (h > startHeight + Math.abs(level.targetDelta) * 0.5) {
        levelFail('你选择了错误的方向！高度在上升，不是下降。', '与梯度成锐角的方向会导致上升。选择与梯度成钝角的方向！');
      }
    } else if (objective === 'ascend') {
      if (h >= startHeight + level.targetDelta) {
        levelComplete();
      }
      if (h < startHeight - Math.abs(level.targetDelta) * 0.5) {
        levelFail('你在下降！需要沿梯度方向（锐角）移动。', '方向导数 f\'(p,u) = ∇f·u > 0 时高度上升。');
      }
    } else if (objective === 'contour') {
      const diff = Math.abs(h - targetHeight);
      if (diff < level.heightTolerance) {
        level.stepsTaken++;
        if (level.stepsTaken >= level.stepsNeeded) {
          levelComplete();
        }
      } else if (diff > level.heightTolerance * 3) {
        levelFail('你偏离了等高线！', '沿梯度垂直方向移动才能保持高度不变。');
      }
    }

    // Out of bounds
    const b = terrainBounds;
    if (player.x < b.minX || player.x > b.maxX || player.y < b.minY || player.y > b.maxY) {
      levelFail('你走出了地形边界！', '注意观察地形，保持在可通行区域内。');
    }
  }

  // Level complete
  function levelComplete() {
    if (achieved) return;
    achieved = true;
    gameActive = false;
    clearInterval(timerInterval);

    const elapsed = (Date.now() - levelStartTime) / 1000;
    let levelScore = 10;

    // Speed bonus
    if (elapsed < 10) {
      levelScore += 15;
      unlockAchievement('speed_demon');
    } else if (elapsed < 20) {
      levelScore += 5;
    }

    score += levelScore;
    totalScore += levelScore;

    // Particles
    const size = canvas.width;
    spawnParticles(size/2, size/2, '#2ecc71', 30);
    spawnParticles(size/2, size/2, '#f1c40f', 20);

    // Check no-fail streak
    if (!noFailStreak) noFailStreak = true;

    // Achievement checks
    if (objective === 'descend') unlockAchievement('first_descend');
    if (objective === 'contour') unlockAchievement('contour_master');

    // Show success
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (currentLevel < levels.length - 1) {
        currentLevel++;
        showLevelScreen();
      } else {
        unlockAchievement('all_levels');
        if (noFailStreak) unlockAchievement('no_fail');
        showGameOver(true);
      }
    }, 1500);

    // Flash success
    const objBar = document.getElementById('objective-bar');
    objBar.textContent = '✅ 任务完成！+' + levelScore + '分';
    objBar.style.borderColor = '#2ecc71';
    objBar.style.color = '#2ecc71';
  }

  // Level fail
  function levelFail(reason, explanation) {
    if (gracePeriod) return;
    achieved = true;
    gameActive = false;
    clearInterval(timerInterval);

    const size = canvas.width;
    spawnParticles(size/2, size/2, '#e74c3c', 20);

    noFailStreak = false;

    setTimeout(() => {
      document.getElementById('go-title').textContent = '❌ 任务失败';
      document.getElementById('go-reason').textContent = reason;
      document.getElementById('go-info').innerHTML =
        '<strong>💡 知识点：</strong><br>' + explanation + '<br><br>' +
        '<div class="formula">f\'(p, u) = ∇f · u = |∇f||u|cosθ</div><br>' +
        'cosθ > 0 (锐角) → 上升<br>' +
        'cosθ < 0 (钝角) → 下降<br>' +
        'cosθ = 0 (垂直) → 等高';
      document.getElementById('gameover-screen').classList.remove('hidden');
    }, 800);

    const objBar = document.getElementById('objective-bar');
    objBar.textContent = '❌ 方向错误！';
    objBar.style.borderColor = '#e74c3c';
    objBar.style.color = '#e74c3c';
  }

  // Achievements
  function unlockAchievement(id) {
    if (unlockedAchievements.has(id)) return;
    unlockedAchievements.add(id);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('dirDeriv_achievements', JSON.stringify([...unlockedAchievements]));
    } catch(e) {}

    const config = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('widget-config').textContent);
    const ach = config.achievements.find(a => a.id === id);
    if (ach) {
      const popup = document.getElementById('achievement-popup');
      popup.textContent = `${ach.icon} ${ach.name} - ${ach.desc}`;
      popup.classList.add('show');
      setTimeout(() => popup.classList.remove('show'), 3000);
    }
  }

  // Input handling
  let keysDown = {};
  let mobileDir = null;

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' || e.key === 'p' || e.key === 'P') {
      if (gameActive) pauseGame();
      else if (gamePaused) resumeGame();
      return;
    }
    keysDown[e.key] = true;
    e.preventDefault();
  });

  document.addEventListener('keyup', function(e) {
    keysDown[e.key] = false;
  });

  // Mobile controls
  function setupMobileControls() {
    const dirs = ['up', 'down', 'left', 'right'];
    dirs.forEach(dir => {
      const btn = document.getElementById('btn-' + dir);
      btn.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        mobileDir = dir;
        btn.classList.add('active');
      });
      btn.addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        mobileDir = null;
        btn.classList.remove('active');
      });
      btn.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
        mobileDir = dir;
        btn.classList.add('active');
      });
      btn.addEventListener('mouseup', function(e) {
        mobileDir = null;
        btn.classList.remove('active');
      });
      btn.addEventListener('mouseleave', function(e) {
        mobileDir = null;
        btn.classList.remove('active');
      });
    });
  }

  function getInputDirection() {
    let dx = 0, dy = 0;

    if (keysDown['ArrowUp'] || keysDown['w'] || keysDown['W']) dy = 1;
    if (keysDown['ArrowDown'] || keysDown['s'] || keysDown['S']) dy = -1;
    if (keysDown['ArrowLeft'] || keysDown['a'] || keysDown['A']) dx = -1;
    if (keysDown['ArrowRight'] || keysDown['d'] || keysDown['D']) dx = 1;

    if (mobileDir === 'up') dy = 1;
    if (mobileDir === 'down') dy = -1;
    if (mobileDir === 'left') dx = -1;
    if (mobileDir === 'right') dx = 1;

    return { dx, dy };
  }

  // Game loop
  function gameLoop() {
    if (!gameActive || gamePaused) return;

    resizeCanvas();

    // Get input
    const input = getInputDirection();
    const speedSlider = document.getElementById('speed-slider');
    const speedMult = speedSlider ? speedSlider.value / 5 : 1;

    if (input.dx !== 0 || input.dy !== 0) {
      const angle = Math.atan2(input.dy, input.dx);
      player.angle = angle;
      player.speed = 0.025 * speedMult;
    } else {
      player.speed *= 0.9; // Decelerate
    }

    // Move player
    if (player.speed > 0.001) {
      const newX = player.x + Math.cos(player.angle) * player.speed;
      const newY = player.y + Math.sin(player.angle) * player.speed;

      // Check bounds
      const b = terrainBounds;
      if (newX >= b.minX && newX <= b.maxX && newY >= b.minY && newY <= b.maxY) {
        playerTrail.push({ x: player.x, y: player.y });
        if (playerTrail.length > 50) playerTrail.shift();
        player.x = newX;
        player.y = newY;
      }
    }

    // Check objective every few frames
    if (Math.random() < 0.1) {
      checkObjective();
    }

    // Draw
    drawTerrain();
    drawTargetZone();
    drawGradientArrow();
    drawPlayer();
    updateParticles();
    drawParticles();
    updateHUD();

    animFrame = requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
  }

  // Show level screen
  function showLevelScreen() {
    gameActive = false;
    cancelAnimationFrame(animFrame);
    clearInterval(timerInterval);

    const level = levels[currentLevel];
    document.getElementById('level-title').textContent = level.name;
    document.getElementById('level-info').innerHTML = level.info + '<br><br>💡 提示：' + level.hint;
    document.getElementById('level-screen').classList.remove('hidden');

    // Setup terrain
    terrainFunc = level.func;
    gradientFunc = level.gradFunc;
    terrainBounds = level.bounds;
    objective = level.objective;
    startHeight = evaluateTerrain(level.startPos.x, level.startPos.y);
    targetHeight = objective === 'contour' ? startHeight : null;

    // Calculate height range
    heightMin = Infinity;
    heightMax = -Infinity;
    for (let x = terrainBounds.minX; x <= terrainBounds.maxX; x += 0.2) {
      for (let y = terrainBounds.minY; y <= terrainBounds.maxY; y += 0.2) {
        const h = evaluateTerrain(x, y);
        if (h < heightMin) heightMin = h;
        if (h > heightMax) heightMax = h;
      }
    }

    // Objective bar
    const objBar = document.getElementById('objective-bar');
    objBar.classList.remove('hidden');
    objBar.className = objective;
    if (objective === 'descend') {
      objBar.innerHTML = '🎯 任务：<strong>下降！</strong> 选择与梯度<span style="color:#e74c3c">相反</span>的方向';
    } else if (objective === 'ascend') {
      objBar.innerHTML = '🎯 任务：<strong>攀登！</strong> 选择与梯度<span style="color:#e74c3c">相同</span>的方向';
    } else {
      objBar.innerHTML = '🎯 任务：<strong>保持等高！</strong> 选择与梯度<span style="color:#f1c40f">垂直</span>的方向';
    }

    document.getElementById('hud').classList.remove('hidden');
    document.getElementById('height-gauge').classList.remove('hidden');
    document.getElementById('height-label').classList.remove('hidden');
    document.getElementById('gradient-info').classList.remove('hidden');
    document.getElementById('speed-control').classList.remove('hidden');
    document.getElementById('controls').classList.remove('hidden');
  }

  // Start level
  function startLevel() {
    const level = levels[currentLevel];
    document.getElementById('level-screen').classList.add('hidden');

    player.x = level.startPos.x;
    player.y = level.startPos.y;
    player.speed = 0;
    player.angle = 0;
    playerTrail = [];
    particles = [];
    achieved = false;
    gracePeriod = true;
    score = 0;
    timer = level.timeLimit;

    document.getElementById('hud-timer').textContent = timer;

    // Grace period
    clearTimeout(graceTimer);
    graceTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      gracePeriod = false;
    }, 3000);

    levelStartTime = Date.now();
    gameActive = true;
    gamePaused = false;

    // Timer
    clearInterval(timerInterval);
    timerInterval = setInterval(() => {
      if (!gameActive || gamePaused) return;
      timer--;
      document.getElementById('hud-timer').textContent = timer;
      if (timer <= 0) {
        levelFail('时间到了！', '你没有在规定时间内完成目标。注意观察梯度方向，快速做出判断。');
      }
    }, 1000);

    animFrame = requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
  }

  // Pause
  function pauseGame() {
    if (!gameActive) return;
    gamePaused = true;
    cancelAnimationFrame(animFrame);
    document.getElementById('pause-screen').classList.remove('hidden');
  }

  function resumeGame() {
    gamePaused = false;
    document.getElementById('pause-screen').classList.add('hidden');
    animFrame = requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
  }

  // Retry
  function retryLevel() {
    document.getElementById('gameover-screen').classList.add('hidden');
    startLevel();
  }

  // Back to menu
  function backToMenu() {
    gameActive = false;
    gamePaused = false;
    achieved = false;
    cancelAnimationFrame(animFrame);
    clearInterval(timerInterval);
    clearTimeout(graceTimer);

    document.getElementById('gameover-screen').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('pause-screen').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('level-screen').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('hud').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('objective-bar').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('height-gauge').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('height-label').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('gradient-info').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('speed-control').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('controls').classList.add('hidden');

    currentLevel = 0;
    totalScore = 0;
    noFailStreak = false;

    document.getElementById('start-screen').classList.remove('hidden');
  }

  // Game over (all levels complete)
  function showGameOver(success) {
    document.getElementById('gameover-screen').classList.remove('hidden');
    document.getElementById('go-title').textContent = '🏆 全部通关！';
    document.getElementById('go-reason').textContent = '你掌握了方向导数的精髓！';
    document.getElementById('go-info').innerHTML =
      '<strong>📊 最终得分：</strong>' + totalScore + '<br><br>' +
      '<strong>🎓 核心概念回顾：</strong><br>' +
      '<div class="formula">f\'(p, u) = ∇f · u = |∇f||u|cosθ</div><br>' +
      '• θ < 90° (锐角) → cosθ > 0 → <strong style="color:#e74c3c">上升</strong><br>' +
      '• θ > 90° (钝角) → cosθ < 0 → <strong style="color:#3498db">下降</strong><br>' +
      '• θ = 90° (垂直) → cosθ = 0 → <strong style="color:#f1c40f">等高</strong><br><br>' +
      '🎯 方向导数的本质：衡量函数沿特定方向的变化率。梯度给出最陡上升方向，其反方向是最陡下降方向，垂直方向是等高方向。';

    // Update buttons
    const buttons = document.getElementById('gameover-screen').querySelectorAll('.game-btn');
    buttons[0].textContent = '🔄 重新开始';
    buttons[0].onclick = function() { backToMenu(); };
    buttons[1].onclick = function() { backToMenu(); };
  }

  // Global functions for onclick
  window.startGame = function() {
    document.getElementById('start-screen').classList.add('hidden');
    currentLevel = 0;
    totalScore = 0;
    noFailStreak = false;
    showLevelScreen();
  };

  window.startLevel = startLevel;
  window.retryLevel = retryLevel;
  window.backToMenu = backToMenu;
  window.resumeGame = resumeGame;
  window.pauseGame = pauseGame;

  setupMobileControls();

  // Draw initial terrain preview
  terrainFunc = levels[0].func;
  gradientFunc = levels[0].gradFunc;
  terrainBounds = levels[0].bounds;
  heightMin = 0;
  heightMax = 12;

  // Draw a nice background on canvas
  function drawPreview() {
    resizeCanvas();
    drawTerrain();
  }
  drawPreview();
  window.addEventListener('resize', drawPreview);
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

actions.content: 从这里开始你的挑战。

actions.text: 在这个梯度山丘上，每一关都会有一个任务要求，比如'必须下降'或者'保持高度'。你需要用方向键，实时调整自己的行进角度。记住，不是有方向就能上升，关键要看你和梯度的夹角。

content.html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>方向导数：空间视角</title>
  <style>
    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #0a0a1a;
      font-family: 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;
    }
    #canvas-container { width: 100%; height: 100%; position: relative; }
    canvas { display: block; }

    #loading {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
      background: #0a0a1a;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: #aaa;
      font-size: 16px;
      z-index: 1000;
    }
    #loading .spinner {
      width: 40px; height: 40px;
      border: 3px solid #333;
      border-top-color: #6366f1;
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: spin 1s linear infinite;
      margin: 0 auto 16px;
    }
    @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

    #controls {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      background: rgba(15, 15, 28, 0.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      padding: 14px 16px 22px;
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: flex-end;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    }

    .control-group {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
      min-width: 120px;
    }

    label {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #aaa;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

    input[type="range"] {
      width: 100%;
      height: 6px;
      -webkit-appearance: none;
      background: #333;
      border-radius: 3px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
      -webkit-appearance: none;
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      background: #6366f1;
      border-radius: 50%;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    button {
      padding: 10px 16px;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: #2a2a3e;
      color: white;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 13px;
      min-width: 44px;
      min-height: 44px;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    button:hover { background: #3a3a5e; }
    button:active { transform: scale(0.95); }
    button.primary { background: #6366f1; }
    button.primary:hover { background: #5558e8; }

    .zoom-btns {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .zoom-btns button {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: bold;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 0;
    }

    #info-panel {
      position: absolute;
      top: 16px;
      left: 16px;
      background: rgba(15, 15, 28, 0.88);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      padding: 16px 18px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      max-width: 320px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      z-index: 10;
    }

    #info-panel h2 {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: #fbbf24;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    #info-panel .subtitle {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #888;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    #info-panel .formula {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: #e0e0e0;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      padding: 8px 10px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      margin: 8px 0;
      font-family: 'Cambria Math', 'Times New Roman', serif;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    #info-panel .slope-display {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-top: 8px;
    }

    #info-panel .slope-value {
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: bold;
      font-family: 'Cambria Math', serif;
    }

    #info-panel .slope-label {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #aaa;
    }

    .legend {
      margin-top: 8px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .legend-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #bbb;
    }

    .legend-dot {
      width: 10px;
      height: 10px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    #slope-bar-container {
      position: absolute;
      top: 16px;
      right: 16px;
      background: rgba(15, 15, 28, 0.88);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      padding: 14px 16px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      z-index: 10;
      width: 160px;
    }

    #slope-bar-container h3 {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #aaa;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

    #slope-bar-track {
      width: 100%;
      height: 16px;
      background: #222;
      border-radius: 8px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    #slope-bar-fill {
      height: 100%;
      width: 50%;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ef4444, #fbbf24, #22c55e);
      border-radius: 8px;
      transition: transform 0.3s ease;
    }

    #slope-bar-center {
      position: absolute;
      left: 50%;
      top: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      width: 2px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
      transform: translateX(-50%);
    }

    #slope-bar-indicator {
      position: absolute;
      top: -6px;
      width: 14px;
      height: 28px;
      background: #6366f1;
      border-radius: 4px;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      transition: left 0.3s ease;
      box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(99,102,241,0.6);
    }

    .bar-labels {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-top: 4px;
      font-size: 10px;
      color: #666;
    }

    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      #info-panel { display: none; }
      #slope-bar-container { display: none; }
      #controls { padding: 10px 8px 20px; gap: 8px; }
      .control-group { min-width: 100px; }
    }

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const katexOptions = {
        delimiters: [
            {left: '\\[', right: '\\]', display: true},
            {left: '\\(', right: '\\)', display: false},
            {left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true},
            {left: '$', right: '$', display: false}
        ],
        throwOnError: false,
        strict: false,
        trust: true
    };

    let renderTimeout;
    function safeRender() {
        if (renderTimeout) clearTimeout(renderTimeout);
        renderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);
        }, 100);
    }

    renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        let shouldRender = false;
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            if (mutation.target &&
                mutation.target.className &&
                typeof mutation.target.className === 'string' &&
                mutation.target.className.includes('katex')) {
                return;
            }
            shouldRender = true;
        });

        if (shouldRender) {
            safeRender();
        }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true
    });

    setInterval(() => {
        const text = document.body.innerText;
        if (text.includes('\\(') || text.includes('$$')) {
            safeRender();
        }
    }, 2000);
});
</script>

  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';

    function checkWebGL() {
      try {
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        return !!(window.WebGLRenderingContext &&
          (canvas.getContext('webgl') || canvas.getContext('experimental-webgl')));
      } catch(e) { return false; }
    }

    async function initScene() {
      try {
        if (!checkWebGL()) throw new Error('浏览器不支持 WebGL');

        const container = document.getElementById('canvas-container');
        const width = container.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
        const height = container.clientHeight || window.innerHeight;
        if (width === 0 || height === 0) throw new Error('容器尺寸为0');

        // Scene
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x0a0a1a);
        scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0x0a0a1a, 20, 40);

        // Camera
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(50, width / height, 0.1, 200);
        camera.position.set(5, 6, 8);

        // Renderer
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(width, height);
        renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
        renderer.shadowMap.enabled = false;
        container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // OrbitControls
        const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
        controls.enableDamping = true;
        controls.dampingFactor = 0.08;
        controls.target.set(0, 0, 0);

        // Lighting
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.5);
        scene.add(ambientLight);

        const hemiLight = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0x444444, 0.6);
        scene.add(hemiLight);

        const dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.2);
        dirLight.position.set(8, 12, 6);
        scene.add(dirLight);

        const dirLight2 = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x8888ff, 0.4);
        dirLight2.position.set(-5, 3, -8);
        scene.add(dirLight2);

        // Math functions
        function f(x, y) { return x * x - y * y; }
        function gradientF(x, y) { return { x: 2 * x, y: -2 * y }; }

        // Observation point
        const px = 1.2;
        const py = 0.6;
        const pz = f(px, py);
        const pointPos = new THREE.Vector3(px, pz, py);

        // Objects dictionary
        const objects = {};

        // --- Surface: z = x² - y² ---
        const surfaceSegments = 80;
        const surfaceSize = 4;
        const surfaceGeom = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(surfaceSize, surfaceSize, surfaceSegments, surfaceSegments);
        const posAttr = surfaceGeom.attributes.position;
        for (let i = 0; i < posAttr.count; i++) {
          const x = posAttr.getX(i);
          const z = posAttr.getZ(i);
          const y = f(x, z);
          posAttr.setY(i, y);
        }
        surfaceGeom.computeVertexNormals();

        // Color vertices based on height
        const colors = new Float32Array(posAttr.count * 3);
        const minHeight = -surfaceSize * surfaceSize / 4;
        const maxHeight = surfaceSize * surfaceSize / 4;
        for (let i = 0; i < posAttr.count; i++) {
          const y = posAttr.getY(i);
          const t = (y - minHeight) / (maxHeight - minHeight);
          const color = new THREE.Color();
          if (t < 0.5) {
            color.setHSL(0.6 - t * 0.4, 0.8, 0.25 + t * 0.3);
          } else {
            color.setHSL(0.4 - (t - 0.5) * 0.6, 0.7, 0.4 + (t - 0.5) * 0.2);
          }
          colors[i * 3] = color.r;
          colors[i * 3 + 1] = color.g;
          colors[i * 3 + 2] = color.b;
        }
        surfaceGeom.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors, 3));

        const surfaceMat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
          vertexColors: true,
          side: THREE.DoubleSide,
          transparent: true,
          opacity: 0.85,
          shininess: 30,
          specular: 0x222244
        });
        const surface = new THREE.Mesh(surfaceGeom, surfaceMat);
        surface.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
        scene.add(surface);
        objects.surface = surface;

        // Grid on surface
        const gridHelper = new THREE.GridHelper(surfaceSize, 20, 0x333355, 0x222244);
        gridHelper.position.y = -surfaceSize * surfaceSize / 4 - 0.5;
        scene.add(gridHelper);

        // Axes helper (small)
        const axesLen = 5;
        const axesHelper = new THREE.AxesHelper(axesLen);
        axesHelper.position.set(-surfaceSize/2 - 0.1, 0, -surfaceSize/2 - 0.1);
        // Actually let's center axes at origin but small
        axesHelper.position.set(0, -surfaceSize * surfaceSize / 4 - 0.5, 0);
        scene.add(axesHelper);

        // --- Observation point marker ---
        const pointGeom = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.08, 16, 16);
        const pointMat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, emissive: 0xffffff, emissiveIntensity: 0.5 });
        const pointMarker = new THREE.Mesh(pointGeom, pointMat);
        pointMarker.position.copy(pointPos);
        scene.add(pointMarker);
        objects.point = pointMarker;

        // Glow ring around point
        const ringGeom = new THREE.RingGeometry(0.12, 0.18, 32);
        const ringMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xfbbf24, side: THREE.DoubleSide, transparent: true, opacity: 0.7 });
        const ring = new THREE.Mesh(ringGeom, ringMat);
        ring.position.copy(pointPos);
        ring.position.y -= 0.01;
        ring.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
        scene.add(ring);
        objects.ring = ring;

        // --- Vertical plane slice ---
        let currentAngle = 0;
        const planeGroup = new THREE.Group();
        scene.add(planeGroup);
        objects.plane = planeGroup;

        function createVerticalPlane(angle) {
          // Clear old
          while (planeGroup.children.length > 0) {
            const child = planeGroup.children[0];
            if (child.geometry) child.geometry.dispose();
            if (child.material) child.material.dispose();
            planeGroup.remove(child);
          }

          const dirX = Math.cos(angle);
          const dirY = Math.sin(angle);

          // Plane extends along direction and vertically
          const planeHalfLen = 4;
          const planeHalfHeight = 3;

          const planeGeom = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(planeHalfLen * 2, planeHalfHeight * 2, 1, 1);
          // Orient the plane to be perpendicular to the direction vector in xz plane
          const planeMat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
            color: 0xfbbf24,
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.18,
            side: THREE.DoubleSide,
            depthWrite: false
          });
          const planeMesh = new THREE.Mesh(planeGeom, planeMat);
          planeMesh.position.set(px, pz, py);
          planeMesh.rotation.y = -angle + Math.PI / 2;
          planeMesh.rotation.x = 0;
          planeMesh.position.y = 0; // center
          // Actually we need the plane centered at the point height
          planeMesh.position.set(0, pz, 0);
          // The plane is in the y-up orientation, rotated around y axis
          // We want it to pass through (px, pz, py) in world space
          // Actually let me restructure this
          planeMesh.position.set(px, pz, py);
          planeMesh.rotation.y = angle;
          // The plane is vertical (along Y axis in local coords which maps to Z in world)
          // We need it to be a vertical plane in the world's Y direction

          // Let me redo: create a plane that is vertical (extends along world Y)
          // The plane normal is perpendicular to direction in XZ plane
          const vertices = new Float32Array([
            // Four corners of a vertical plane
            px - dirX * planeHalfLen, -planeHalfHeight, py - dirY * planeHalfLen,
            px + dirX * planeHalfLen, -planeHalfHeight, py + dirY * planeHalfLen,
            px + dirX * planeHalfLen, planeHalfHeight, py + dirY * planeHalfLen,
            px - dirX * planeHalfLen, planeHalfHeight, py - dirY * planeHalfLen,
          ]);

          const normals = new Float32Array([
            dirY, 0, -dirX,
            dirY, 0, -dirX,
            dirY, 0, -dirX,
            dirY, 0, -dirX,
          ]);

          const indices = new Uint16Array([0, 1, 2, 0, 2, 3]);

          const geom = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
          geom.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(vertices, 3));
          geom.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.BufferAttribute(normals, 3));
          geom.setIndex(new THREE.BufferAttribute(indices, 1));

          const mat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
            color: 0xfbbf24,
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.2,
            side: THREE.DoubleSide,
            depthWrite: false
          });
          const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, mat);
          planeGroup.add(mesh);

          // Intersection curve
          // Parametric: x = px + t*cos(angle), z = py + t*sin(angle), y = f(x, z)
          const curvePoints = [];
          const curveLineMat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0xfbbf24, linewidth: 2 });
          const numCurvePts = 120;
          for (let i = 0; i <= numCurvePts; i++) {
            const t = (i / numCurvePts - 0.5) * planeHalfLen * 2;
            const cx = px + t * dirX;
            const cz = py + t * dirY;
            const cy = f(cx, cz);
            if (cy > -planeHalfHeight - 1 && cy < planeHalfHeight + 1) {
              curvePoints.push(new THREE.Vector3(cx, cy, cz));
            }
          }

          if (curvePoints.length > 1) {
            const curveGeom = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(curvePoints);
            const curveLine = new THREE.Line(curveGeom, curveLineMat);
            planeGroup.add(curveLine);
            objects.intersectionCurve = curveLine;
          }
        }

        // --- Tangent line ---
        const tangentGroup = new THREE.Group();
        scene.add(tangentGroup);
        objects.tangent = tangentGroup;

        function updateTangentLine(angle) {
          while (tangentGroup.children.length > 0) {
            const c = tangentGroup.children[0];
            if (c.geometry) c.geometry.dispose();
            if (c.material) c.material.dispose();
            tangentGroup.remove(c);
          }

          const dirX = Math.cos(angle);
          const dirY = Math.sin(angle);
          const grad = gradientF(px, py);
          const dirDeriv = grad.x * dirX + grad.y * dirY;

          // Tangent direction: (dirX, dirDeriv, dirY)
          const tanDir = new THREE.Vector3(dirX, dirDeriv, dirY).normalize();
          const tanLen = 1.5;

          const startPt = pointPos.clone().addScaledVector(tanDir, -tanLen);
          const endPt = pointPos.clone().addScaledVector(tanDir, tanLen);

          const tanGeom = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints([startPt, endPt]);
          const tanMat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0xef4444, linewidth: 3 });
          const tanLine = new THREE.Line(tanGeom, tanMat);
          tangentGroup.add(tanLine);

          // Arrow head
          const arrowHelper = new THREE.ArrowHelper(
            tanDir, pointPos, tanLen * 1.2, 0xef4444, 0.2, 0.1
          );
          tangentGroup.add(arrowHelper);

          // Slope triangle visualization
          const triSize = 0.4;
          const triBase = new THREE.Vector3(px, pz, py);
          const triEndX = new THREE.Vector3(px + triSize * dirX, pz, py + triSize * dirY);
          const triEndY = new THREE.Vector3(px + triSize * dirX, pz + triSize * dirDeriv, py + triSize * dirY);

          const triGeom = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints([triBase, triEndX, triEndY]);
          const triMat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0xff6666 });
          const triLine = new THREE.Line(triGeom, triMat);
          tangentGroup.add(triLine);

          return dirDeriv;
        }

        // --- Gradient arrow ---
        const gradientGroup = new THREE.Group();
        scene.add(gradientGroup);
        objects.gradient = gradientGroup;
        let showGradient = true;

        function updateGradientArrow() {
          while (gradientGroup.children.length > 0) {
            const c = gradientGroup.children[0];
            if (c.geometry) c.geometry.dispose();
            if (c.material) c.material.dispose();
            gradientGroup.remove(c);
          }

          if (!showGradient) return;

          const grad = gradientF(px, py);
          const gradMag = Math.sqrt(grad.x * grad.x + grad.y * grad.y);
          if (gradMag < 0.001) return;

          const gradDir = new THREE.Vector3(grad.x / gradMag, 0, grad.y / gradMag);
          const gradLen = 1.5;

          const arrow = new THREE.ArrowHelper(gradDir, pointPos, gradLen, 0x22c55e, 0.25, 0.12);
          gradientGroup.add(arrow);

          // Gradient label (using sprite)
          const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
          canvas.width = 128;
          canvas.height = 48;
          const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
          ctx.fillStyle = '#22c55e';
          ctx.font = 'bold 24px sans-serif';
          ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText('∇f', 64, 32);
          const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
          const spriteMat = new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: texture, transparent: true });
          const sprite = new THREE.Sprite(spriteMat);
          sprite.position.copy(pointPos).add(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.5, 0));
          sprite.scale.set(0.8, 0.3, 1);
          gradientGroup.add(sprite);
        }

        // --- Coordinate system labels ---
        function addAxisLabel(axis, label, pos) {
          const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
          canvas.width = 64;
          canvas.height = 32;
          const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
          ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
          ctx.font = 'bold 20px serif';
          ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText(label, 32, 24);
          const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
          const spriteMat = new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: texture, transparent: true });
          const sprite = new THREE.Sprite(spriteMat);
          sprite.position.copy(pos);
          sprite.scale.set(0.4, 0.2, 1);
          scene.add(sprite);
        }

        addAxisLabel('x', 'x', new THREE.Vector3(2.5, -surfaceSize * surfaceSize / 4 - 0.6, -2.5));
        addAxisLabel('y', 'y', new THREE.Vector3(0.3, 2, 0));
        addAxisLabel('z', 'z', new THREE.Vector3(-2.5, -surfaceSize * surfaceSize / 4 - 0.6, 2.5));

        // --- Initial setup ---
        createVerticalPlane(0);
        const slope = updateTangentLine(0);
        updateGradientArrow();
        updateSlopeDisplay(slope, currentAngle);

        // --- UI Elements ---
        const slopeValueEl = document.getElementById('slope-value');
        const angleDisplayEl = document.getElementById('angle-display');
        const angleDisplayControlEl = document.getElementById('angle-display-control');
        const angleSlider = document.getElementById('angle-slider');
        const slopeBarIndicator = document.getElementById('slope-bar-indicator');

        function updateSlopeDisplay(slopeVal, angle) {
          const absSlope = Math.abs(slopeVal);
          const maxSlope = Math.sqrt(4 * px * px + 4 * py * py); // |∇f|
          const normalizedSlope = slopeVal / maxSlope; // -1 to 1

          // Update value display
          slopeValueEl.textContent = slopeVal.toFixed(3);
          if (slopeVal > 0.01) {
            slopeValueEl.style.color = '#22c55e';
          } else if (slopeVal < -0.01) {
            slopeValueEl.style.color = '#ef4444';
          } else {
            slopeValueEl.style.color = '#fbbf24';
          }

          const deg = Math.round(angle * 180 / Math.PI);
          angleDisplayEl.textContent = `角度: ${deg}°`;
          angleDisplayControlEl.textContent = `${deg}°`;

          // Update slope bar
          const barPos = 50 + normalizedSlope * 48; // 2% to 98%
          slopeBarIndicator.style.left = barPos + '%';
        }

        // Angle slider
        angleSlider.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
          const deg = parseInt(e.target.value);
          currentAngle = deg * Math.PI / 180;
          createVerticalPlane(currentAngle);
          const slope = updateTangentLine(currentAngle);
          updateSlopeDisplay(slope, currentAngle);
        });

        // Toggle gradient
        document.getElementById('toggle-grad-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
          showGradient = !showGradient;
          updateGradientArrow();
          const btn = document.getElementById('toggle-grad-btn');
          btn.textContent = showGradient ? '隐藏梯度' : '显示梯度';
        });

        // Zoom buttons
        document.getElementById('zoom-in-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
          const dir = new THREE.Vector3();
          camera.getWorldDirection(dir);
          camera.position.addScaledVector(dir, 2);
        });

        document.getElementById('zoom-out-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
          const dir = new THREE.Vector3();
          camera.getWorldDirection(dir);
          camera.position.addScaledVector(dir, -2);
        });

        // Reset
        document.getElementById('reset-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
          camera.position.set(5, 6, 8);
          controls.target.set(px, pz, py);
          angleSlider.value = 0;
          currentAngle = 0;
          createVerticalPlane(0);
          const slope = updateTangentLine(0);
          updateSlopeDisplay(slope, 0);
        });

        // Resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
          const w = container.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
          const h = container.clientHeight || window.innerHeight;
          camera.aspect = w / h;
          camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
          renderer.setSize(w, h);
        });

        // Animation loop
        let animating = true;
        let autoRotate = false;
        function animate() {
          requestAnimationFrame(animate);

          if (autoRotate && animating) {
            currentAngle += 0.005;
            if (currentAngle > Math.PI * 2) currentAngle -= Math.PI * 2;
            angleSlider.value = Math.round(currentAngle * 180 / Math.PI) % 360;
            createVerticalPlane(currentAngle);
            const slope = updateTangentLine(currentAngle);
            updateSlopeDisplay(slope, currentAngle);
          }

          // Animate ring
          const time = Date.now() * 0.002;
          ring.scale.setScalar(1 + 0.15 * Math.sin(time));
          ring.material.opacity = 0.4 + 0.3 * Math.sin(time);

          controls.update();
          renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }
        animate();

        // postMessage listener
        window.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
          if (!event.data || !event.data.action) return;
          const { action, payload } = event.data;

          switch (action) {
            case 'SET_WIDGET_STATE': {
              if (payload.cameraPosition) {
                camera.position.set(...payload.cameraPosition);
              }
              if (payload.cameraTarget) {
                controls.target.set(...payload.cameraTarget);
              }
              if (payload.angle !== undefined) {
                const deg = payload.angle;
                currentAngle = deg * Math.PI / 180;
                angleSlider.value = deg;
                createVerticalPlane(currentAngle);
                const slope = updateTangentLine(currentAngle);
                updateSlopeDisplay(slope, currentAngle);
              }
              if (payload.showGradient !== undefined) {
                showGradient = payload.showGradient;
                updateGradientArrow();
              }
              break;
            }

            case 'HIGHLIGHT_ELEMENT': {
              const { elementId, highlight } = payload;
              if (elementId === 'surface' && objects.surface) {
                objects.surface.material.emissive.set(highlight ? 0x222244 : 0x000000);
                objects.surface.material.opacity = highlight ? 1.0 : 0.85;
              }
              if (elementId === 'plane' && objects.plane) {
                objects.plane.children.forEach(child => {
                  if (child.material && child.material.opacity !== undefined) {
                    child.material.opacity = highlight ? 0.45 : 0.2;
                  }
                });
              }
              if (elementId === 'tangent' && objects.tangent) {
                objects.tangent.children.forEach(child => {
                  if (child.material) {
                    if (child.material.linewidth) {
                      child.material.linewidth = highlight ? 5 : 3;
                    }
                    if (child.material.opacity !== undefined) {
                      child.material.opacity = highlight ? 1.0 : 0.8;
                    }
                  }
                });
              }
              break;
            }

            case 'ANNOTATE_ELEMENT': {
              const { elementId, text } = payload;
              // Could add annotation markers here
              console.log('Annotate:', elementId, text);
              break;
            }

            case 'TOGGLE_ANIMATION': {
              animating = payload.enabled;
              break;
            }

            case 'SET_AUTO_ROTATE': {
              autoRotate = payload.enabled;
              break;
            }
          }
        });

        // Hide loading
        document.getElementById('loading').style.display = 'none';

      } catch (error) {
        console.error('场景初始化失败:', error);
        document.getElementById('loading').innerHTML =
          `<div style="text-align:center;color:#ff6b6b;">
            <div style="font-size:24px;margin-bottom:16px;">⚠️</div>
            3D场景加载失败<br>
            <small style="color:#888;">${error.message}</small><br>
            <button onclick="location.reload()" style="margin-top:16px;padding:8px 16px;background:#6366f1;color:white;border:none;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;">重试</button>
          </div>`;
      }
    }

    initScene();
  </script>

questions.question: 在“梯度向量：拖动实验”中，如果函数 f(x,y) 在某点的偏导数 f_x = 3，f_y = -4，则该点的梯度向量为？
questions.analysis: 梯度向量定义为 (f_x, f_y)。直接将给定的偏导数分量组合即可得到 (3, -4)。选项A颠倒了符号，选项C忽略了负号，选项D两个分量符号都颠倒了。

questions.question: 下列关于梯度向量的说法，哪些是正确的？（多选）

options.label: 梯度向量的方向指向函数增长最快的方向
梯度向量的大小代表最大方向导数的值
梯度向量的方向就是函数下降最快的方向
在一点处，沿不同方向走，函数的变化率可能不同

questions.analysis: 选项A和B是梯度向量的基本性质。选项D描述了方向导数的含义，也是正确的。选项C错误，因为梯度指向上升最快方向，其反方向才是下降最快。

questions.question: 在“方向导数：拖动实验”中，当你拖动的方向与梯度方向的夹角从0度逐渐增大到90度时，方向导数的数值会如何变化？

options.label: 从最大值逐渐减小到0
从0逐渐增大到最大值
保持不变
从最大值逐渐减小到一个负数

questions.analysis: 方向导数 = 梯度的大小 乘以 二者夹角的余弦值。当夹角从0度到90度变化时，余弦值从1减小到0。所以方向导数从正向最大值（等于梯度模）逐渐减小到0。此时变化率为0，意味着沿该方向走，函数值高度暂时不变。

questions.question: 如果你站在山腰的某个位置，若要保持你的海拔高度不变行走，你应该选择哪个方向？（提示：即方向导数为0的方向）

options.label: 沿梯度方向直线上山
沿梯度反方向直线下山
沿与梯度方向垂直的方向绕山走
以任意方向走都可以

questions.analysis: 要使得高度变化率为0，即方向导数为0，需满足方向向量与梯度向量垂直（夹角90度），因为余弦90度=0。沿着该垂直方向移动，就走在了一条高度不变的路径上。这条路径在数学上对应着函数的等高线或等值线。

questions.question: 结合上面的思考，请用自己的话解释：给定一个点，如何找到能让函数值增加和减少的路径？并说明这些路径与等高线之间有什么关系？
questions.commentPrompt: 评分标准：（1）明确指出增加路径是沿梯度方向或偏向梯度的方向，减少路径是沿负梯度方向或偏向负梯度的方向 - 40%。（2）明确指出保持不变的路径（等高线）是与梯度垂直的方向 - 30%。（3）能将路径、梯度方向和等高线三者联系起来，语言清晰，体现空间想象 - 30%。
questions.analysis: 从一点出发，沿梯度方向走，函数值增加最快，这是上山路径；沿负梯度方向走，函数值减少最快，这是下山路径。而保持不变的路径，即等高线，其切线方向处处与梯度方向垂直。这就像走在山坡上，梯度指向上坡最陡的方向，与之垂直的方向就是绕着山坡的平路。

actions.text: 刚才我们在拖动实验里，亲眼看到了梯度向量的合成，也感受了方向改变时方向导数的变化，还碰到了一个很有意思的现象：把切面转到某个角度，切线变水平了。现在，让我们用几道小题来检验一下这些概念是否真的内化成了你自己的理解。

actions.text: 祝贺大家完成了形成性测验！现在，我们正式踏入本课非常核心且美妙的一个部分：梯度与等高线垂直。这短短几个字，揭示了多元微积分中一个极其重要的几何秘密。我们先明确一下这一页的学习目标。
目标很明确：大家要能用地形图的视角，去解释为什么梯度这个向量，总是和穿过该点的等高线保持垂直关系。这是一个需要将代数公式与几何直觉结合起来的时刻。
这个属性的核心在于：梯度指向的是函数值增长最快的方向。想象你站在一座山上，最快登顶的路径绝不是绕着山腰的水平方向走，而是直接往最陡的上坡方向走。而等高线，恰恰标记了所有高度不变、增长为零的方向。
从数学上看，这个关系被优雅地总结为这个公式：梯度向量与等高线的切向量点积为零。这意味着它们是正交的。我们马上会通过一个拖动实验，直观地验证这一点。
所以我们的结论可以概括为：梯度指向最快上升方向，而等高线恰恰代表了所有零增长方向。一个向上，一个水平，自然垂直。这个图景清晰了吗？接下来，我们将通过一个可拖动的交互实验，让你亲手感受这种垂直关系在任何地方都成立。

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const katexOptions = {
        delimiters: [
            {left: '\\[', right: '\\]', display: true},
            {left: '\\(', right: '\\)', display: false},
            {left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true},
            {left: '$', right: '$', display: false}
        ],
        throwOnError: false,
        strict: false,
        trust: true
    };

    let renderTimeout;
    function safeRender() {
        if (renderTimeout) clearTimeout(renderTimeout);
        renderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);
        }, 100);
    }

    renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        let shouldRender = false;
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            if (mutation.target &&
                mutation.target.className &&
                typeof mutation.target.className === 'string' &&
                mutation.target.className.includes('katex')) {
                return;
            }
            shouldRender = true;
        });

        if (shouldRender) {
            safeRender();
        }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true
    });

    setInterval(() => {
        const text = document.body.innerText;
        if (text.includes('\\(') || text.includes('$$')) {
            safeRender();
        }
    }, 2000);
});
</script>
