<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

// State
let state = {
  running: false,
  ended: false,
  paused: false,
  pointX: 0.5,
  pointY: -0.3,
  funcType: 0,
  contourDensity: 12,
  arrowScale: 1.0,
  colorDepth: 10,
  autoMove: false,
  autoAngle: 0,
  dragging: false,
  time: 0
};

const funcNames = ['正弦组合', '高斯双峰', '马鞍面', '波纹'];
const funcDescs = [
  'f(x,y) = sin(2x)·cos(2y)',
  'f(x,y) = e^(-(x-1)²-(y-1)²) + e^(-(x+1)²-(y+1)²)',
  'f(x,y) = x² - y²',
  'f(x,y) = sin(3x)·sin(3y)'
];

// Function definitions
function f(x, y, type) {
  switch(type) {
    case 0: return Math.sin(2 * x) * Math.cos(2 * y);
    case 1: return Math.exp(-((x-1)**2 + (y-1)**2)) + Math.exp(-((x+1)**2 + (y+1)**2));
    case 2: return x * x - y * y;
    case 3: return Math.sin(3 * x) * Math.sin(3 * y);
    default: return Math.sin(2 * x) * Math.cos(2 * y);
  }
}

// Numerical gradient
function grad(x, y, type) {
  const h = 0.001;
  const gx = (f(x + h, y, type) - f(x - h, y, type)) / (2 * h);
  const gy = (f(x, y + h, type) - f(x, y - h, type)) / (2 * h);
  return { gx, gy };
}

// Domain bounds
const DOMAIN = { xMin: -2.5, xMax: 2.5, yMin: -2.5, yMax: 2.5 };

// Resize canvas
function resizeCanvas() {
  const rect = canvas.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();
  const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  canvas.width = rect.width * dpr;
  canvas.height = rect.height * dpr;
  canvas.style.width = rect.width + 'px';
  canvas.style.height = rect.height + 'px';
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  draw();
}

window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);

// Map math coordinates to canvas
function toCanvas(x, y) {
  const w = canvas.clientWidth;
  const h = canvas.clientHeight;
  const margin = 30;
  const drawW = w - 2 * margin;
  const drawH = h - 2 * margin;
  const cx = margin + (x - DOMAIN.xMin) / (DOMAIN.xMax - DOMAIN.xMin) * drawW;
  const cy = margin + (DOMAIN.yMax - y) / (DOMAIN.yMax - DOMAIN.yMin) * drawH;
  return { x: cx, y: cy };
}

function fromCanvas(cx, cy) {
  const w = canvas.clientWidth;
  const h = canvas.clientHeight;
  const margin = 30;
  const drawW = w - 2 * margin;
  const drawH = h - 2 * margin;
  const x = DOMAIN.xMin + (cx - margin) / drawW * (DOMAIN.xMax - DOMAIN.xMin);
  const y = DOMAIN.yMax - (cy - margin) / drawH * (DOMAIN.yMax - DOMAIN.yMin);
  return { x, y };
}

// Color mapping
function getColor(val, minVal, maxVal, depth) {
  const t = (val - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal + 0.0001);
  const level = Math.floor(t * depth);
  const frac = t * depth - level;

  const colors = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= depth; i++) {
    const p = i / depth;
    // Cool to warm colormap
    let r, g, b;
    if (p < 0.25) {
      const s = p / 0.25;
      r = 30; g = 60 + s * 100; b = 180 - s * 60;
    } else if (p < 0.5) {
      const s = (p - 0.25) / 0.25;
      r = 30 + s * 100; g = 160 + s * 80; b = 120 - s * 100;
    } else if (p < 0.75) {
      const s = (p - 0.5) / 0.25;
      r = 130 + s * 100; g = 240 - s * 100; b = 20 + s * 40;
    } else {
      const s = (p - 0.75) / 0.25;
      r = 230; g = 140 - s * 100; b = 60 + s * 100;
    }
    colors.push(`rgb(${Math.round(r)},${Math.round(g)},${Math.round(b)})`);
  }

  const idx = Math.min(level, depth - 1);
  return colors[idx];
}

// Draw heatmap background
function drawHeatmap() {
  const w = canvas.clientWidth;
  const h = canvas.clientHeight;
  const margin = 30;
  const drawW = w - 2 * margin;
  const drawH = h - 2 * margin;

  // Sample on a grid
  const res = 3; // pixels per cell
  const cols = Math.ceil(drawW / res);
  const rows = Math.ceil(drawH / res);

  // Find min/max for this function type
  let minVal = Infinity, maxVal = -Infinity;
  const steps = 40;
  for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
    for (let j = 0; j <= steps; j++) {
      const x = DOMAIN.xMin + i / steps * (DOMAIN.xMax - DOMAIN.xMin);
      const y = DOMAIN.yMin + j / steps * (DOMAIN.yMax - DOMAIN.yMin);
      const v = f(x, y, state.funcType);
      if (v < minVal) minVal = v;
      if (v > maxVal) maxVal = v;
    }
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < cols; i++) {
    for (let j = 0; j < rows; j++) {
      const px = margin + i * res;
      const py = margin + j * res;
      const math = fromCanvas(px, py);
      const val = f(math.x, math.y, state.funcType);
      ctx.fillStyle = getColor(val, minVal, maxVal, state.colorDepth);
      ctx.fillRect(px, py, res + 1, res + 1);
    }
  }

  return { minVal, maxVal };
}

// Draw contour lines using marching approach
function drawContours(minVal, maxVal) {
  const density = state.contourDensity;
  const levels = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= density; i++) {
    levels.push(minVal + i / density * (maxVal - minVal));
  }

  const w = canvas.clientWidth;
  const h = canvas.clientHeight;
  const margin = 30;

  // Simple contour drawing: for each pixel row, find zero crossings
  const step = 1;
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;

  for (let level of levels) {
    // Draw horizontal contours
    for (let py = margin; py < h - margin; py += step) {
      let prevVal = null, prevCx = null;
      for (let px = margin; px <= w - margin; px += step) {
        const math = fromCanvas(px, py);
        const val = f(math.x, math.y, state.funcType) - level;
        if (prevVal !== null && val * prevVal < 0) {
          // Zero crossing
          const t = Math.abs(prevVal) / (Math.abs(prevVal) + Math.abs(val));
          const crossX = prevCx + t * step;
          const crossY = py;
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)';
          ctx.fillRect(crossX - 0.5, crossY - 0.5, 1.5, 1.5);
        }
        prevVal = val;
        prevCx = px;
      }
    }
    // Draw vertical contours
    for (let px = margin; px < w - margin; px += step) {
      let prevVal = null, prevCy = null;
      for (let py = margin; py <= h - margin; py += step) {
        const math = fromCanvas(px, py);
        const val = f(math.x, math.y, state.funcType) - level;
        if (prevVal !== null && val * prevVal < 0) {
          const t = Math.abs(prevVal) / (Math.abs(prevVal) + Math.abs(val));
          const crossX = px;
          const crossY = prevCy + t * step;
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)';
          ctx.fillRect(crossX - 0.5, crossY - 0.5, 1.5, 1.5);
        }
        prevVal = val;
        prevCy = py;
      }
    }
  }
}

// Draw grid
function drawGrid() {
  const w = canvas.clientWidth;
  const h = canvas.clientHeight;
  const margin = 30;

  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(148,163,184,0.15)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;

  for (let x = Math.ceil(DOMAIN.xMin); x <= Math.floor(DOMAIN.xMax); x++) {
    const p = toCanvas(x, DOMAIN.yMin);
    const p2 = toCanvas(x, DOMAIN.yMax);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
    ctx.lineTo(p2.x, p2.y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (let y = Math.ceil(DOMAIN.yMin); y <= Math.floor(DOMAIN.yMax); y++) {
    const p = toCanvas(DOMAIN.xMin, y);
    const p2 = toCanvas(DOMAIN.xMax, y);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
    ctx.lineTo(p2.x, p2.y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

// Draw axis labels
function drawAxisLabels() {
  const w = canvas.clientWidth;
  const margin = 30;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(148,163,184,0.6)';
  ctx.font = '11px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';

  for (let x = Math.ceil(DOMAIN.xMin); x <= Math.floor(DOMAIN.xMax); x++) {
    const p = toCanvas(x, DOMAIN.yMin);
    const labelY = Math.min(p.y + 16, canvas.clientHeight - 5);
    ctx.fillText(x.toString(), p.x, labelY);
  }

  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  for (let y = Math.ceil(DOMAIN.yMin); y <= Math.floor(DOMAIN.yMax); y++) {
    const p = toCanvas(DOMAIN.xMin, y);
    const labelX = Math.max(p.x - 5, 15);
    ctx.fillText(y.toString(), labelX, p.y + 4);
  }

  // Axis labels
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(148,163,184,0.5)';
  ctx.font = '12px sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('x', w / 2, canvas.clientHeight - 6);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(12, h / 2);
  ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
  ctx.fillText('y', 0, 0);
  ctx.restore();
}

// Draw arrow
function drawArrow(x1, y1, x2, y2, color, label, lineWidth) {
  const headLen = 12;
  const angle = Math.atan2(y2 - y1, x2 - x1);

  ctx.strokeStyle = color;
  ctx.lineWidth = lineWidth || 3;
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
  ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Arrow head
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x2, y2);
  ctx.lineTo(x2 - headLen * Math.cos(angle - 0.4), y2 - headLen * Math.sin(angle - 0.4));
  ctx.lineTo(x2 - headLen * Math.cos(angle + 0.4), y2 - headLen * Math.sin(angle + 0.4));
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  if (label) {
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.font = 'bold 13px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    const midX = (x1 + x2) / 2 + Math.cos(angle + Math.PI / 2) * 16;
    const midY = (y1 + y2) / 2 + Math.sin(angle + Math.PI / 2) * 16;
    ctx.fillText(label, midX, midY);
  }
}

// Draw tangent line
function drawTangent(px, py, tx, ty, length) {
  const len = Math.sqrt(tx * tx + ty * ty) || 1;
  const normTx = tx / len;
  const normTy = ty / len;

  const x1 = px - normTx * length;
  const y1 = py - normTy * length;
  const x2 = px + normTx * length;
  const y2 = py + normTy * length;

  ctx.strokeStyle = '#4ade80';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
  ctx.setLineDash([6, 4]);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
  ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);

  // Label
  ctx.fillStyle = '#4ade80';
  ctx.font = 'bold 12px sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('T (切线)', x2 + 6, y2 - 6);
}

// Draw right angle marker
function drawRightAngleMarker(px, py, gx, gy, tx, ty) {
  const gLen = Math.sqrt(gx * gx + gy * gy) || 1;
  const tLen = Math.sqrt(tx * tx + ty * ty) || 1;
  const size = 14;

  const ngx = gx / gLen;
  const ngy = gy / gLen;
  const mtx = tx / tLen;
  const mty = ty / tLen;

  // Point along gradient
  const a1x = px + ngx * size;
  const a1y = py + ngy * size;
  // Point along tangent
  const a2x = px + mtx * size;
  const a2y = py + mty * size;
  // Corner
  const a3x = a1x + mtx * size;
  const a3y = a1y + mty * size;

  ctx.strokeStyle = '#fbbf24';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(a1x, a1y);
  ctx.lineTo(a3x, a3y);
  ctx.lineTo(a2x, a2y);
  ctx.stroke();
}

// Draw the point
function drawPoint(px, py) {
  // Outer glow
  const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(px, py, 0, px, py, 18);
  gradient.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(239,68,68,0.6)');
  gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(239,68,68,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(px, py, 18, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Point
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ef4444';
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(px, py, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.stroke();
}

// Compute angle between gradient and tangent
function computeAngle(gx, gy, tx, ty) {
  const dot = gx * tx + gy * ty;
  const magG = Math.sqrt(gx * gx + gy * gy);
  const magT = Math.sqrt(tx * tx + ty * ty);
  if (magG < 1e-6 || magT < 1e-6) return 90;
  const cosA = Math.abs(dot / (magG * magT));
  return Math.acos(Math.min(1, Math.max(-1, cosA))) * 180 / Math.PI;
}

// Main draw function
function draw() {
  const w = canvas.clientWidth;
  const h = canvas.clientHeight;
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

  // Background
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

  // Heatmap
  const { minVal, maxVal } = drawHeatmap();

  // Grid
  drawGrid();

  // Contours
  drawContours(minVal, maxVal);

  // Axis labels
  drawAxisLabels();

  // Compute gradient at point
  const g = grad(state.pointX, state.pointY, state.funcType);
  const gx = g.gx;
  const gy = g.gy;
  const gradMag = Math.sqrt(gx * gx + gy * gy);

  // Tangent direction: perpendicular to gradient
  let tx = -gy;
  let ty = gx;
  const tanMag = Math.sqrt(tx * tx + ty * ty);
  if (tanMag > 0) {
    tx /= tanMag;
    ty /= tanMag;
  }

  // Angle
  const angle = computeAngle(gx, gy, tx, ty);

  // Draw point
  const p = toCanvas(state.pointX, state.pointY);
  drawPoint(p.x, p.y);

  // Draw tangent line
  if (gradMag > 0.001) {
    drawTangent(p.x, p.y, tx, ty, 60);

    // Draw gradient vector
    const arrowLen = state.arrowScale * 50;
    const endX = p.x + (gx / gradMag) * arrowLen;
    const endY = p.y - (gy / gradMag) * arrowLen; // flipped y for canvas
    drawArrow(p.x, p.y, endX, endY, '#f472b6', '∇f', 3);

    // Right angle marker
    drawRightAngleMarker(p.x, p.y, gx, -gy, tx, ty);
  }

  // Draw domain border
  const tl = toCanvas(DOMAIN.xMin, DOMAIN.yMax);
  const br = toCanvas(DOMAIN.xMax, DOMAIN.yMin);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(148,163,184,0.3)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.strokeRect(tl.x, tl.y, br.x - tl.x, br.y - tl.y);

  // Update displays
  updateDisplays(gx, gy, gradMag, tx, ty, angle);
}

function updateDisplays(gx, gy, gradMag, tx, ty, angle) {
  document.getElementById('pos-display').textContent =
    `(${state.pointX.toFixed(2)}, ${state.pointY.toFixed(2)})`;
  document.getElementById('fval-display').textContent =
    f(state.pointX, state.pointY, state.funcType).toFixed(3);
  document.getElementById('grad-display').textContent =
    `(${gx.toFixed(3)}, ${gy.toFixed(3)})`;
  document.getElementById('gradmag-display').textContent = gradMag.toFixed(3);
  document.getElementById('tan-display').textContent =
    `(${tx.toFixed(3)}, ${ty.toFixed(3)})`;

  const angleEl = document.getElementById('angle-display');
  angleEl.textContent = angle.toFixed(1) + '°';
  if (angle > 88 && angle < 92) {
    angleEl.classList.add('perpendicular');
    angleEl.style.color = '#4ade80';
  } else {
    angleEl.classList.remove('perpendicular');
    angleEl.style.color = '#e2e8f0';
  }

  // Overlay
  document.getElementById('overlay-angle').textContent = angle.toFixed(1) + '°';
  if (angle > 88 && angle < 92) {
    document.getElementById('overlay-angle').style.color = '#4ade80';
  } else {
    document.getElementById('overlay-angle').style.color = '#e2e8f0';
  }
  document.getElementById('overlay-pos').textContent =
    `(${state.pointX.toFixed(2)}, ${state.pointY.toFixed(2)})`;
}

// Dragging
function getCanvasPos(e) {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const clientX = e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientX : e.clientX;
  const clientY = e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientY : e.clientY;
  return { x: clientX - rect.left, y: clientY - rect.top };
}

canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', startDrag);
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', startDrag, { passive: false });
window.addEventListener('mousemove', doDrag);
window.addEventListener('touchmove', doDrag, { passive: false });
window.addEventListener('mouseup', endDrag);
window.addEventListener('touchend', endDrag);

function startDrag(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  const pos = getCanvasPos(e);
  const math = fromCanvas(pos.x, pos.y);

  // Check if near the point
  const p = toCanvas(state.pointX, state.pointY);
  const dist = Math.sqrt((pos.x - p.x) ** 2 + (pos.y - p.y) ** 2);
  if (dist < 30 || state.dragging) {
    state.dragging = true;
    state.pointX = clamp(math.x, DOMAIN.xMin + 0.2, DOMAIN.xMax - 0.2);
    state.pointY = clamp(math.y, DOMAIN.yMin + 0.2, DOMAIN.yMax - 0.2);
    draw();
  }
}

function doDrag(e) {
  if (!state.dragging) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  const pos = getCanvasPos(e);
  const math = fromCanvas(pos.x, pos.y);
  state.pointX = clamp(math.x, DOMAIN.xMin + 0.1, DOMAIN.xMax - 0.1);
  state.pointY = clamp(math.y, DOMAIN.yMin + 0.1, DOMAIN.yMax - 0.1);
  draw();
}

function endDrag() {
  state.dragging = false;
}

function clamp(v, min, max) { return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, v)); }

// Sliders
document.querySelectorAll('input[data-var]').forEach(slider => {
  slider.addEventListener('input', function() {
    const varName = this.dataset.var;
    const val = parseFloat(this.value);

    switch(varName) {
      case 'funcType':
        state.funcType = Math.round(val);
        document.getElementById('funcType-display').textContent = funcNames[state.funcType];
        break;
      case 'density':
        state.contourDensity = Math.round(val);
        document.getElementById('density-display').textContent = val;
        break;
      case 'arrowScale':
        state.arrowScale = val;
        document.getElementById('arrowScale-display').textContent = val.toFixed(1) + '×';
        break;
      case 'colorDepth':
        state.colorDepth = Math.round(val);
        document.getElementById('colorDepth-display').textContent = val;
        break;
    }
    draw();
  });
});

// Button logic
function handleMainButton() {
  if (state.ended) {
    resetSimulation();
    return;
  }
  if (state.running) {
    pauseSimulation();
  } else {
    startSimulation();
  }
}

function startSimulation() {
  state.running = true;
  state.paused = false;
  state.ended = false;
  state.autoMove = true;
  updateButton('暂停', 'paused');
  animate();
}

function pauseSimulation() {
  state.running = false;
  state.paused = true;
  state.autoMove = false;
  updateButton('继续', 'idle');
}

function resetSimulation() {
  state.running = false;
  state.ended = false;
  state.paused = false;
  state.autoMove = false;
  state.pointX = 0.5;
  state.pointY = -0.3;
  state.autoAngle = 0;
  state.time = 0;

  // Reset sliders to defaults
  document.getElementById('funcType-slider').value = 0;
  document.getElementById('funcType-display').textContent = funcNames[0];
  document.getElementById('density-slider').value = 12;
  document.getElementById('density-display').textContent = '12';
  document.getElementById('arrowScale-slider').value = 1.0;
  document.getElementById('arrowScale-display').textContent = '1.0×';
  document.getElementById('colorDepth-slider').value = 10;
  document.getElementById('colorDepth-display').textContent = '10';

  state.funcType = 0;
  state.contourDensity = 12;
  state.arrowScale = 1.0;
  state.colorDepth = 10;

  updateButton('启动演示', 'idle');
  draw();
}

function updateButton(text, dotState) {
  document.getElementById('main-btn-text').textContent = text;
  const dot = document.getElementById('state-dot');
  dot.className = 'state-indicator ' + (dotState || 'idle');
}

// Auto animation (point moves along a circular path)
function animate() {
  if (!state.running) return;

  state.time += 0.015;
  // Move point in a circular/elliptical path
  const cx = (DOMAIN.xMax + DOMAIN.xMin) / 2;
  const cy = (DOMAIN.yMax + DOMAIN.yMin) / 2;
  const rx = 1.5;
  const ry = 1.3;

  state.pointX = cx + rx * Math.cos(state.time * 0.8);
  state.pointY = cy + ry * Math.sin(state.time * 0.8);

  state.pointX = clamp(state.pointX, DOMAIN.xMin + 0.2, DOMAIN.xMax - 0.2);
  state.pointY = clamp(state.pointY, DOMAIN.yMin + 0.2, DOMAIN.yMax - 0.2);

  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}

// Presets
function applyPreset(index) {
  state.running = false;
  state.ended = false;
  state.paused = false;
  state.autoMove = false;

  switch(index) {
    case 0: // 鞍点附近
      state.funcType = 2;
      state.pointX = 0.5;
      state.pointY = 0.3;
      break;
    case 1: // 峰值附近
      state.funcType = 1;
      state.pointX = 0.8;
      state.pointY = 0.8;
      break;
    case 2: // 谷底附近
      state.funcType = 0;
      state.pointX = -0.5;
      state.pointY = 0.8;
      break;
    case 3: // 任意点
      state.funcType = 3;
      state.pointX = 1.0;
      state.pointY = -0.5;
      break;
  }

  // Update slider display
  document.getElementById('funcType-slider').value = state.funcType;
  document.getElementById('funcType-display').textContent = funcNames[state.funcType];

  updateButton('启动演示', 'idle');
  draw();
}

// Keyboard shortcuts
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.code === 'Space') {
    e.preventDefault();
    handleMainButton();
  } else if (e.code === 'KeyR') {
    e.preventDefault();
    resetSimulation();
  }
});

// Toggle controls on mobile
function toggleControls() {
  document.getElementById('controls').classList.toggle('collapsed');
}

// postMessage listener
window.addEventListener('message', function(event) {
  const { type, target, state: widgetState, content } = event.data;

  switch (type) {
    case 'SET_WIDGET_STATE':
      if (widgetState) {
        Object.entries(widgetState).forEach(([key, value]) => {
          const slider = document.getElementById(key + '-slider') || document.querySelector('[data-var="' + key + '"]');
          if (slider) {
            slider.value = value;
            slider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
          }
        });
      }
      break;

    case 'HIGHLIGHT_ELEMENT':
      const highlightEl = document.querySelector(target);
      if (highlightEl) {
        highlightEl.style.outline = '3px solid rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.8)';
        highlightEl.style.outlineOffset = '4px';
        highlightEl.style.animation = 'pulse-highlight 2s infinite';
        setTimeout(() => {
          highlightEl.style.outline = '';
          highlightEl.style.animation = '';
        }, 3000);
      }
      break;

    case 'ANNOTATE_ELEMENT':
      const annotateEl = document.querySelector(target);
      if (annotateEl && content) {
        const rect = annotateEl.getBoundingClientRect();
        const tooltip = document.createElement('div');
        tooltip.className = 'teacher-annotation';
        tooltip.style.cssText = 'position:fixed; top:' + (rect.top - 40) + 'px; left:' + rect.left + 'px; background:rgba(139,92,246,0.95); color:white; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:8px; font-size:14px; z-index:1000; animation:fadeIn 0.3s;';
        tooltip.textContent = content;
        document.body.appendChild(tooltip);
        setTimeout(() => tooltip.remove(), 4000);
      }
      break;

    case 'REVEAL_ELEMENT':
      const revealEl = document.querySelector(target);
      if (revealEl) {
        revealEl.style.display = '';
        revealEl.style.opacity = '1';
      }
      break;
  }
});

// Add animation CSS
const style = document.createElement('style');
style.textContent = '@keyframes pulse-highlight { 0%, 100% { outline-color: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.8); } 50% { outline-color: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.4); } } @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }';
document.head.appendChild(style);

// Initialize
setTimeout(resizeCanvas, 50);
</script>
</body>
</html>

widgetConfig.description: 在二维等高线图上拖动采样点，观察梯度向量始终与等高线切线保持垂直（90°）

actions.text: 好的，就像我们刚才推导的那样，梯度方向是上升最快的，等高线方向是高度不变的——它们理应处处垂直。现在让我们亲手拖一拖，亲眼看看这个90度是否在每一点都成立。

actions.content: 初始化一个便于观察的中间位置。

actions.text: 页面上显示了一个标量场的等高线图，中间有一个可以拖动的采样点。先不要急着动，请先找到从该点出发的红色箭头——这就是该点的梯度向量。同时，注意穿过该点的蓝色曲线，那就是过该点的等高线。

actions.content: 看清楚读数面板显示的实时夹角数值。

actions.text: 现在，请用鼠标按住这个采样点，慢慢地在平面上拖动。请一直盯着读数面板上的“夹角”数值，观察它是否始终稳定在90度。试着把点拖到等高线弯曲很厉害的地方，或者拖到峰顶、谷底附近，看看规律会不会被打破。

actions.content: 将采样点移动到谷底附近进行对比。

actions.text: 有意思吧？哪怕在谷底，所有的等高线似乎都收拢消失了，但只要有一条等高线经过，梯度依然与它垂直。这说明梯度垂直于等高线是多元函数的一个内禀几何性质，与位置无关。如果你还想挑战一下，可以切换右侧的函数类型，看看对于不同的曲面，这种垂直关系是否依然坚挺。

scenes.title: 梯度与等高线垂直：关系图

content.html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>梯度与等高线垂直：关系图</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  body {
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;
    background: #0f172a;
    color: #e2e8f0;
    overflow: hidden;
    height: 100vh;
    width: 100vw;
  }
  .app-container {
    display: flex;
    height: 100vh;
    width: 100vw;
  }
  .diagram-area {
    flex: 1;
    position: relative;
    overflow: auto;
    min-width: 0;
  }
  #diagram-svg {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    display: block;
  }
  .sidebar {
    width: 340px;
    min-width: 340px;
    background: #1e293b;
    border-left: 1px solid #334155;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const katexOptions = {
        delimiters: [
            {left: '\\[', right: '\\]', display: true},
            {left: '\\(', right: '\\)', display: false},
            {left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true},
            {left: '$', right: '$', display: false}
        ],
        throwOnError: false,
        strict: false,
        trust: true
    };

    let renderTimeout;
    function safeRender() {
        if (renderTimeout) clearTimeout(renderTimeout);
        renderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);
        }, 100);
    }

    renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        let shouldRender = false;
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            if (mutation.target &&
                mutation.target.className &&
                typeof mutation.target.className === 'string' &&
                mutation.target.className.includes('katex')) {
                return;
            }
            shouldRender = true;
        });

        if (shouldRender) {
            safeRender();
        }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true
    });

    setInterval(() => {
        const text = document.body.innerText;
        if (text.includes('\\(') || text.includes('$$')) {
            safeRender();
        }
    }, 2000);
});
</script>

<script type="application/json" id="widget-config">
{
  "title": "梯度与等高线垂直：关系图",
  "nodes": [
    {
      "id": "n1",
      "label": "函数定义",
      "icon": "📝",
      "details": "考虑二元函数 z = f(x, y)，其图像是一个三维曲面。曲面上每一点的高度由 f(x, y) 给出。等高线是曲面上高度相同的点的投影集合。",
      "formula": "z = f(x, y)"
    },
    {
      "id": "n2",
      "label": "等高线",
      "icon": "🗺️",
      "details": "等高线：曲面上所有满足 f(x, y) = c（常数）的点在 xy 平面上的投影。沿等高线移动时，函数值保持不变，即高度不变。",
      "formula": "f(x, y) = c（常数）"
    },
    {
      "id": "n3",
      "label": "切线方向",
      "icon": "➡️",
      "details": "在等高线上任取一点 P，该点的切向量 t⃗ 指向沿等高线的方向。由于沿等高线移动高度不变，沿切线方向的「方向导数」必然为零。",
      "formula": "t⃗ = 等高线在 P 点的切向量"
    },
    {
      "id": "n4",
      "label": "方向导数 = 0",
      "icon": "🔢",
      "details": "方向导数描述函数沿某方向的变化率。沿等高线切线方向，高度不变，因此方向导数为零。这是等高线的核心性质。",
      "formula": "D<sub>t⃗</sub>f = ∇f · t⃗ = 0"
    },
    {
      "id": "n5",
      "label": "梯度方向",
      "icon": "⛰️",
      "details": "梯度 ∇f 是函数的变化率向量，指向函数增长最快的方向。在等高线图中，梯度总是指向「上坡」方向。",
      "formula": "∇f = (∂f/∂x, ∂f/∂y)"
    },
    {
      "id": "n6",
      "label": "内积 = 0",
      "icon": "✖️",
      "details": "由方向导数公式 D<sub>t⃗</sub>f = ∇f · t⃗ = 0 可知，梯度 ∇f 与切向量 t⃗ 的点积（内积）为零。这正是两个向量垂直的数学定义！",
      "formula": "∇f · t⃗ = |∇f||t⃗|cos θ = 0"
    },
    {
      "id": "n7",
      "label": "垂直结论",
      "icon": "📐",
      "details": "两个非零向量的内积为零 ⇔ 它们互相垂直。因此，梯度 ∇f 必定垂直于等高线的切向量 t⃗，即梯度垂直于等高线！这是微积分中一个优美的几何结论。",

<script>
(function() {
  const config = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('widget-config').textContent);
  const svg = document.getElementById('diagram-svg');
  const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
  const nodeDetail = document.getElementById('node-detail');
  const stepIndicator = document.getElementById('step-indicator');
  const btnPrev = document.getElementById('btn-prev');
  const btnNext = document.getElementById('btn-next');
  const sidebarToggle = document.getElementById('sidebar-toggle');
  const mobileToggle = document.getElementById('mobile-toggle');

  const NODE_W = 180, NODE_H = 70, ARROW_OFFSET = 10;
  const revealOrder = config.revealOrder;
  let currentStep = 0;

  const nodePositions = {
    n1: { x: 500, y: 60 },
    n2: { x: 500, y: 200 },
    n3: { x: 300, y: 340 },
    n5: { x: 700, y: 340 },
    n4: { x: 200, y: 480 },
    n6: { x: 500, y: 480 },
    n7: { x: 500, y: 620 }
  };

  // Misconception position (attached to n2)
  const m1Pos = { x: 730, y: 200 };

  function getEdgePoints(from, to) {
    const dx = to.x - from.x, dy = to.y - from.y;
    let sx, sy, ex, ey;

    if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx)) {
      sx = from.x;
      sy = dy > 0 ? from.y + NODE_H / 2 : from.y - NODE_H / 2;
      ex = to.x;
      ey = dy > 0 ? to.y - NODE_H / 2 - ARROW_OFFSET : to.y + NODE_H / 2 + ARROW_OFFSET;
    } else {
      sx = dx > 0 ? from.x + NODE_W / 2 : from.x - NODE_W / 2;
      sy = from.y;
      ex = dx > 0 ? to.x - NODE_W / 2 - ARROW_OFFSET : to.x + NODE_W / 2 + ARROW_OFFSET;
      ey = to.y;
    }
    return { sx, sy, ex, ey };
  }

  function edgeMid(from, to) {
    const p = getEdgePoints(from, to);
    return { x: (p.sx + p.ex) / 2, y: (p.sy + p.ey) / 2 };
  }

  function buildSVG() {
    let html = `<defs>
      <marker id="arrowhead" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="10" refY="3.5" orient="auto">
        <polygon points="0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7" fill="#60a5fa" />
      </marker>
      <marker id="arrowhead-dim" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="10" refY="3.5" orient="auto">
        <polygon points="0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7" fill="#475569" />
      </marker>
    </defs>`;

    // Edges
    config.edges.forEach((edge, i) => {
      const from = nodePositions[edge.from];
      const to = nodePositions[edge.to];
      const pts = getEdgePoints(from, to);
      const mid = edgeMid(from, to);
      const path = `M ${pts.sx} ${pts.sy} L ${pts.ex} ${pts.ey}`;

      html += `<path class="edge-line hidden-edge" id="edge-${i}" d="${path}" marker-end="url(#arrowhead-dim)" />`;

      // Edge label
      const labelOffset = mid.x < 200 ? 25 : (mid.x > 800 ? -25 : 0);
      const labelYOffset = mid.y < 100 ? -12 : (mid.y > 550 ? 18 : -8);
      html += `<text class="edge-label hidden-edge" x="${mid.x + labelOffset}" y="${mid.y + labelYOffset}">${edge.label}</text>`;
    });

    // Misconception line (dashed)
    const mFrom = nodePositions[config.misconception.attachedTo];
    const mTo = m1Pos;
    const mPts = getEdgePoints(mFrom, mTo);
    const mPath = `M ${mPts.sx} ${mPts.sy} L ${mPts.ex} ${mPts.ey}`;
    html += `<path d="${mPath}" fill="none" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="5 3" marker-end="url(#arrowhead-red)" class="hidden-edge" id="edge-m1" opacity="0.7"/>`;

    // Red arrowhead for misconception
    html += `<marker id="arrowhead-red" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="6" refX="8" refY="3" orient="auto">
      <polygon points="0 0, 8 3, 0 6" fill="#ef4444" />
    </marker>`;

    // Misconception node
    const mc = config.misconception;
    html += `<g class="node-group hidden-edge misconception-node" id="node-${mc.id}" data-node-id="${mc.id}">
      <rect class="node-bg" x="${m1Pos.x - 90}" y="${m1Pos.y - 35}" width="180" height="70" rx="10" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="6 3"/>
      <text class="node-icon" x="${m1Pos.x}" y="${m1Pos.y - 10}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="20">⚠️</text>
      <text class="node-label" x="${m1Pos.x}" y="${m1Pos.y + 12}" text-anchor="middle" fill="#fca5a5" font-size="12" font-weight="700">${mc.label}</text>
    </g>`;

    // Regular nodes
    config.nodes.forEach(node => {
      const pos = nodePositions[node.id];
      const nx = pos.x - NODE_W / 2;
      const ny = pos.y - NODE_H / 2;

      html += `<g class="node-group hidden-node" id="node-${node.id}" data-node-id="${node.id}">
        <rect class="node-bg" x="${nx}" y="${ny}" width="${NODE_W}" height="${NODE_H}" rx="12" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
        <text class="node-icon" x="${pos.x}" y="${pos.y - 8}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="22">${node.icon}</text>
        <text class="node-label" x="${pos.x}" y="${pos.y + 16}" text-anchor="middle" fill="#e2e8f0" font-size="14" font-weight="600">${node.label}</text>
      </g>`;
    });

    svg.innerHTML = html;

    // Click handlers
    svg.querySelectorAll('.node-group').forEach(g => {
      g.addEventListener('click', function() {
        const nodeId = this.getAttribute('data-node-id');
        const idx = revealOrder.indexOf(nodeId);
        if (idx !== -1 && idx < currentStep) {
          showDetail(nodeId);
        }
      });
    });
  }

  function revealNode(nodeId) {
    const el = document.getElementById(`node-${nodeId}`);
    if (!el) return;
    el.classList.remove('hidden-node');
    el.classList.add('revealed');
  }

  function revealEdge(fromId, toId) {
    const edge = config.edges.find(e => e.from === fromId && e.to === toId);
    if (!edge) return;
    const idx = config.edges.indexOf(edge);
    const el = document.getElementById(`edge-${idx}`);
    if (el) {
      el.classList.remove('hidden-edge');
      el.classList.add('revealed');
      el.setAttribute('marker-end', 'url(#arrowhead)');
    }
    // Also reveal label
    const labels = svg.querySelectorAll(`.edge-label[data-edge-idx="${idx}"]`);
    // We need a better way - let's use the order
  }

  function stepForward() {
    if (currentStep >= revealOrder.length) return;
    const nodeId = revealOrder[currentStep];
    revealNode(nodeId);

    // Reveal incoming edges
    config.edges.forEach((edge, i) => {
      if (edge.to === nodeId) {
        const fromRevealed = revealOrder.indexOf(edge.from) < currentStep;
        if (fromRevealed) {
          const edgeEl = document.getElementById(`edge-${i}`);
          if (edgeEl) {
            edgeEl.classList.remove('hidden-edge');
            edgeEl.classList.add('revealed');
            edgeEl.setAttribute('marker-end', 'url(#arrowhead)');
          }
          // Find corresponding label text
          const textEls = svg.querySelectorAll('.edge-label');
          if (textEls[i]) {
            textEls[i].classList.remove('hidden-edge');
            textEls[i].classList.add('revealed');
          }
        }
      }
    });

    // If revealing n2, also show misconception
    if (nodeId === 'n2') {
      const mEdge = document.getElementById('edge-m1');
      const mNode = document.getElementById(`node-${config.misconception.id}`);
      if (mEdge) { mEdge.classList.remove('hidden-edge'); mEdge.classList.add('revealed'); }
      if (mNode) { mNode.classList.remove('hidden-edge'); mNode.classList.add('revealed'); }
    }

    currentStep++;
    showDetail(nodeId);
    updateControls();

    // Auto open sidebar on desktop
    if (window.innerWidth > 768 && sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed')) {
      sidebar.classList.remove('collapsed');
      sidebarToggle.textContent = '▶';
    }
  }

  function stepBackward() {
    if (currentStep <= 0) return;
    currentStep--;
    const nodeId = revealOrder[currentStep];

    // Hide future nodes
    for (let i = currentStep + 1; i < revealOrder.length; i++) {
      const hid = revealOrder[i];
      const el = document.getElementById(`node-${hid}`);
      if (el) {
        el.classList.remove('revealed', 'active-node');
        el.classList.add('hidden-node');
      }
    }

    // Hide future edges
    config.edges.forEach((edge, i) => {
      const fromIdx = revealOrder.indexOf(edge.from);
      const toIdx = revealOrder.indexOf(edge.to);
      if (toIdx > currentStep) {
        const edgeEl = document.getElementById(`edge-${i}`);
        if (edgeEl) {
          edgeEl.classList.remove('revealed');
          edgeEl.classList.add('hidden-edge');
          edgeEl.setAttribute('marker-end', 'url(#arrowhead-dim)');
        }
        const textEls = svg.querySelectorAll('.edge-label');
        if (textEls[i]) {
          textEls[i].classList.remove('revealed');
          textEls[i].classList.add('hidden-edge');
        }
      }
    });

    // Hide misconception if going back before n2
    if (currentStep < revealOrder.indexOf('n2')) {
      const mEdge = document.getElementById('edge-m1');
      const mNode = document.getElementById(`node-${config.misconception.id}`);
      if (mEdge) { mEdge.classList.add('hidden-edge'); mEdge.classList.remove('revealed'); }
      if (mNode) { mNode.classList.add('hidden-edge'); mNode.classList.remove('revealed'); }
    }

    showDetail(nodeId);
    updateControls();
  }

  function showDetail(nodeId) {
    const node = config.nodes.find(n => n.id === nodeId);
    if (!node) {
      // Misconception
      if (nodeId === config.misconception.id) {
        nodeDetail.innerHTML = `
          <div class="icon">⚠️</div>
          <div class="title">常见误解</div>
          <div class="misconception-box">
            <div class="label">❌ 错误理解</div>
            <div class="text">"沿等高线走，高度变化率为 0，而非最大！"</div>
          </div>
          <div class="description" style="margin-top:12px">
            许多同学误以为沿等高线方向是"变化最快的方向"。实际上：
            <br><br>
            <strong>梯度方向</strong>（∇f）才是函数变化最快的方向。<br>
            <strong>等高线切线方向</strong>的变化率为 <strong>零</strong>，因为沿等高线移动高度不变。
          </div>`;
      }
      return;
    }

    let html = `<div class="icon">${node.icon}</div>`;
    html += `<div class="title">${node.label}</div>`;
    if (node.formula) {
      html += `<div class="formula">${node.formula}</div>`;
    }
    html += `<div class="description">${node.details}</div>`;

    // Add misconception note for n2
    if (nodeId === 'n2') {
      html += `<div class="misconception-box">
        <div class="label">⚠️ 常见误解</div>
        <div class="text">"沿等高线走，高度变化率为 0，而非最大！"</div>
      </div>`;
    }

    nodeDetail.innerHTML = html;

    // Highlight active node
    svg.querySelectorAll('.node-group').forEach(g => g.classList.remove('active-node'));
    const activeEl = document.getElementById(`node-${nodeId}`);
    if (activeEl) activeEl.classList.add('active-node');

    stepIndicator.textContent = `步骤 ${currentStep} / ${revealOrder.length}`;
  }

  function updateControls() {
    btnPrev.disabled = currentStep <= 0;
    btnNext.disabled = currentStep >= revealOrder.length;
    btnNext.textContent = currentStep >= revealOrder.length ? '✓ 完成' : '下一步 ▶';
    stepIndicator.textContent = `步骤 ${currentStep} / ${revealOrder.length}`;
  }

  // Sidebar toggle
  sidebarToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
    sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
    sidebarToggle.textContent = sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed') ? '◀' : '▶';
  });

  mobileToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
    sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
  });

  btnPrev.addEventListener('click', stepBackward);
  btnNext.addEventListener('click', stepForward);

  // Keyboard support
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); stepForward(); }
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') { e.preventDefault(); stepBackward(); }
  });

  // Initialize
  buildSVG();

  // Set initial SVG viewBox
  function resizeSVG() {
    const area = document.querySelector('.diagram-area');
    const w = Math.max(area.clientWidth, 900);
    const h = Math.max(area.clientHeight, 720);
    svg.setAttribute('viewBox', `0 0 ${w} ${h}`);
    svg.setAttribute('width', w);
    svg.setAttribute('height', h);

    // Recalculate node positions for viewBox
    const scale = Math.min(w / 1000, h / 720);
    const offsetX = (w - 1000 * scale) / 2;
    const offsetY = (h - 720 * scale) / 2;
  }

  resizeSVG();
  window.addEventListener('resize', resizeSVG);

  // Auto-reveal first node
  setTimeout(() => {
    stepForward();
  }, 300);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

widgetConfig.title: 梯度与等高线垂直：关系图

nodes.label: 函数定义
nodes.details: 考虑二元函数 z = f(x, y)，其图像是一个三维曲面。曲面上每一点的高度由 f(x, y) 给出。等高线是曲面上高度相同的点的投影集合。

nodes.label: 等高线
nodes.details: 等高线：曲面上所有满足 f(x, y) = c（常数）的点在 xy 平面上的投影。沿等高线移动时，函数值保持不变，即高度不变。

nodes.label: 切线方向
nodes.details: 在等高线上任取一点 P，该点的切向量 t⃗ 指向沿等高线的方向。由于沿等高线移动高度不变，沿切线方向的「方向导数」必然为零。
nodes.formula: t⃗ = 等高线在 P 点的切向量

nodes.label: 方向导数 = 0
nodes.details: 方向导数描述函数沿某方向的变化率。沿等高线切线方向，高度不变，因此方向导数为零。这是等高线的核心性质。

nodes.label: 梯度方向
nodes.details: 梯度 ∇f 是函数的变化率向量，指向函数增长最快的方向。在等高线图中，梯度总是指向「上坡」方向。

nodes.label: 内积 = 0
nodes.details: 由方向导数公式 D<sub>t⃗</sub>f = ∇f · t⃗ = 0 可知，梯度 ∇f 与切向量 t⃗ 的点积（内积）为零。这正是两个向量垂直的数学定义！

nodes.label: 垂直结论
nodes.details: 两个非零向量的内积为零 ⇔ 它们互相垂直。因此，梯度 ∇f 必定垂直于等高线的切向量 t⃗，即梯度垂直于等高线！这是微积分中一个优美的几何结论。

edges.label: 高度不变 → 变化率为0

misconception.label: ⚠️ 常见误解
misconception.text:
「沿等高线走，高度变化率为 0，而非最大！」
梯度方向才是变化最快的方向，等高线方向的变化率为零。

actions.text: 经过刚才的拖动实验，我们已经直观地感受到梯度与等高线之间的垂直关系。那么，为什么这个几何事实在数学上必然成立？接下来，我们用这张关系图，把背后的推导链条梳理清晰。

actions.content: 首先展示函数定义，回顾二元函数的本质。

actions.text: 一切从最基本的函数定义开始。我们考虑二元函数 z = f(x, y)，它的图像是一个三维曲面。曲面上高度相同的点，投影到 xy 平面就形成了等高线。

actions.content: 接着展示等高线节点，建立基本概念。

actions.text: 在等高线上任选一点，我们可以画出它的切线方向。请留意，沿这个切线方向移动时，函数的高度完全不变，所以此时的方向导数必定为零。这正是连接等高线与梯度的关键。

actions.content: 展示切线方向，引出方向导数为零的性质。
展示方向导数为零的公式。

actions.text: 同时，我们求出的梯度 ∇f，是函数变化最快的方向。将梯度与切线向量代入方向导数的公式：Df = ∇f · t⃗ = 0。两个向量的内积为零，这正是垂直的数学定义！

actions.content: 展示梯度方向及其公式。
展示内积为零，连接梯度与切线。

actions.text: 于是，我们自然而然地走到了逻辑链条的终点：梯度必定垂直于等高线的切线，也就垂直于等高线本身。这是微分学中一个非常优美的几何结论。

actions.content: 最终展示垂直结论，完成整个推理链条。
特别注意这个常见误解：沿等高线走，变化率是零而不是最大。梯度方向才是变化最快的方向。

actions.text: 另外，请务必留心这个常见误解。有时我们会下意识地认为，沿着等高线走也是在‘爬坡’，但实际上它根本不变，变化率为零。梯度所指的，才是真正上坡最快的方向。现在，你可以点击图中各个节点，顺着箭头的逻辑再梳理一遍。当你想清楚为什么内积为零就意味着垂直时，这个概念就再也不会混淆了。

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
<title>梯度与等高线：冲顶挑战</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  body {
    font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #e0e0e0;
    overflow: hidden;
    height: 100vh;
    width: 100vw;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
  }

  #gameContainer {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 500px;
    height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  #topBar {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f3460, #16213e);
    padding: 8px 12px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    font-size: 14px;
    border-bottom: 2px solid #e94560;
    z-index: 10;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  #topBar .stat {
    text-align: center;
    flex: 1;
  }
  #topBar .stat .label {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #8899aa;
  }
  #topBar .stat .value {
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #e94560;
  }

  #canvasWrapper {
    flex: 1;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #16213e;
  }
  #gameCanvas {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    display: block;
  }

  #controls {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f3460, #16213e);
    padding: 8px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  #directionPad {
    position: relative;
    width: 180px;
    height: 180px;
  }
  .dir-btn {
    position: absolute;
    width: 52px;
    height: 52px;
    border: 2px solid #e94560;
    background: rgba(233, 69, 96, 0.15);
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 22px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    transition: all 0.15s;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    user-select: none;
  }
  .dir-btn:active {
    background: rgba(233, 69, 96, 0.6);
    transform: scale(0.92);
  }
  .dir-btn.top-left { top: 0; left: 0; }
  .dir-btn.top { top: 0; left: 64px; }
  .dir-btn.top-right { top: 0; right: 0; }
  .dir-btn.left { top: 64px; left: 0; }
  .dir-btn.center { top: 64px; left: 64px; background: rgba(233,69,96,0.3); }
  .dir-btn.right { top: 64px; right: 0; }
  .dir-btn.bottom-left { bottom: 0; left: 0; }
  .dir-btn.bottom { bottom: 0; left: 64px; }
  .dir-btn.bottom-right { bottom: 0; right: 0; }

  #elevationBar {
    width: 90%;
    max-width: 400px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-top: 4px;
  }
  #elevationBar .bar-bg {
    flex: 1;
    height: 16px;
    background: #0a1628;
    border-radius: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid #334;
  }
  #elevationBar .bar-fill {
    height: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #2ecc71, #f1c40f, #e74c3c);
    border-radius: 8px;
    transition: width 0.3s;
    width: 0%;
  }
  #elevationBar .bar-label {
    font-size: 12px;
    white-space: nowrap;
    color: #8899aa;
  }

  #hintText {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #f1c40f;
    text-align: center;
    min-height: 18px;
    max-width: 400px;
  }

  /* Overlays */
  .overlay {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
    background: rgba(10, 15, 30, 0.92);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    z-index: 100;
    padding: 20px;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .overlay.hidden { display: none; }

  .overlay h1 {
    font-size: 24px;
    color: #e94560;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }
  .overlay h2 {
    font-size: 20px;
    color: #f1c40f;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }
  .overlay p {
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.7;
    color: #ccd;
    max-width: 360px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }
  .overlay .formula {
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #3498db;
    background: rgba(52, 152, 219, 0.1);
    padding: 8px 16px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    margin: 8px 0;
    font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;
  }
  .overlay .emoji-big {
    font-size: 48px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }

  .game-btn {
    padding: 14px 40px;
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: bold;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 30px;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin-top: 15px;
    transition: all 0.2s;
    color: #fff;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e94560, #c0392b);
    box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(233, 69, 96, 0.4);
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  }
  .game-btn:active {
    transform: scale(0.95);
  }
  .game-btn.secondary {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3498db, #2980b9);
    box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(52, 152, 219, 0.4);
    font-size: 14px;
    padding: 10px 24px;
  }

  .achievement-popup {
    position: absolute;
    top: 60px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f1c40f, #e67e22);
    color: #1a1a2e;
    padding: 10px 20px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    font-weight: bold;
    font-size: 14px;
    z-index: 200;
    animation: popIn 0.4s ease-out, popOut 0.4s ease-in 2s forwards;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(241, 196, 15, 0.5);
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  @keyframes popIn {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-50%) scale(0.5) translateY(-20px); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1) translateY(0); }
  }
  @keyframes popOut {
    from { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1); }
    to { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-50%) scale(0.5) translateY(-20px); }
  }

  .particle-container {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 50;
  }

  .speed-indicator {
    position: absolute;
    right: 10px;
    bottom: 10px;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
    padding: 6px 10px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #fff;
    z-index: 10;
  }
  .speed-indicator .arrow {
    font-size: 18px;
    display: inline-block;
    transition: transform 0.2s;
  }
  .speed-indicator .gain {
    color: #2ecc71;
    font-weight: bold;
  }
  .speed-indicator .loss {
    color: #e74c3c;
    font-weight: bold;
  }

  .legend {
    position: absolute;
    left: 8px;
    top: 8px;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.75);
    padding: 6px 10px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    font-size: 11px;
    z-index: 10;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
  .legend .dot {
    display: inline-block;
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    margin-right: 4px;
    vertical-align: middle;
  }
</style>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const katexOptions = {
        delimiters: [
            {left: '\\[', right: '\\]', display: true},
            {left: '\\(', right: '\\)', display: false},
            {left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true},
            {left: '$', right: '$', display: false}
        ],
        throwOnError: false,
        strict: false,
        trust: true
    };

    let renderTimeout;
    function safeRender() {
        if (renderTimeout) clearTimeout(renderTimeout);
        renderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);
        }, 100);
    }

    renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        let shouldRender = false;
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            if (mutation.target &&
                mutation.target.className &&
                typeof mutation.target.className === 'string' &&
                mutation.target.className.includes('katex')) {
                return;
            }
            shouldRender = true;
        });

        if (shouldRender) {
            safeRender();
        }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true
    });

    setInterval(() => {
        const text = document.body.innerText;
        if (text.includes('\\(') || text.includes('$$')) {
            safeRender();
        }
    }, 2000);
});
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {

// ============ GAME STATE ============
let canvas, ctx;
let gameActive = false;
let paused = false;
let currentLevel = 1;
let totalScore = 0;
let moveCount = 0;
let startTime = 0;
let elapsedTime = 0;
let timerInterval = null;
let playerX, playerY; // normalized 0-1 coordinates
let peakX, peakY;
let peakHeight;
let maxHeightReached = 0;
let levelMoves = [];
let hintShown = false;
let lastGain = 0;
let moveHistory = [];
let bestTimes = {};
let achievements = [];

// ============ LEVEL DEFINITIONS ============
const levels = [
  {
    name: "初识山地",
    peakX: 0.7, peakY: 0.3,
    playerStartX: 0.2, playerStartY: 0.8,
    sigmaX: 0.35, sigmaY: 0.35,
    peakHeight: 1000,
    timeLimit: 90,
    lesson: "📌 当移动方向与等高线垂直时，海拔上升最快！这就是梯度的方向。",
    hint: "尝试先向右，再向上，看看哪种组合让你爬得更快！"
  },
  {
    name: "倾斜山峰",
    peakX: 0.8, peakY: 0.2,
    playerStartX: 0.15, playerStartY: 0.75,
    sigmaX: 0.3, sigmaY: 0.25,
    peakHeight: 1200,
    timeLimit: 80,
    lesson: "📌 山峰越陡峭（等高线越密集），梯度越大，沿梯度方向上升越快。",
    hint: "观察等高线的疏密——密集的地方坡度更陡！"
  },
  {
    name: "双峰挑战",
    peakX: 0.75, peakY: 0.25,
    playerStartX: 0.15, playerStartY: 0.85,
    sigmaX: 0.25, sigmaY: 0.3,
    secondaryPeak: { x: 0.3, y: 0.3, height: 600, sx: 0.2, sy: 0.2 },
    peakHeight: 1500,
    timeLimit: 75,
    lesson: "📌 在复杂地形中，梯度始终指向该点的最陡上升方向，而非直线指向山顶。",
    hint: "不要直线冲顶！每一步都要选择当前最陡上升的方向。"
  },
  {
    name: "终极攀登",
    peakX: 0.65, peakY: 0.15,
    playerStartX: 0.35, playerStartY: 0.9,
    sigmaX: 0.2, sigmaY: 0.2,
    peakHeight: 2000,
    timeLimit: 60,
    lesson: "📌 方向导数 ∇f·d 告诉我们：只有垂直等高线（d∥∇f）时，上升效率最高！",
    hint: "注意每次移动后的高度变化数值——绿色越大越好，红色表示在下降！"
  }
];

// ============ HEIGHT FUNCTION ============
function getHeight(x, y, lvl) {
  const l = levels[lvl - 1];
  let h = l.peakHeight * Math.exp(
    -((x - l.peakX) ** 2) / (2 * l.sigmaX ** 2)
    - ((y - l.peakY) ** 2) / (2 * l.sigmaY ** 2)
  );
  if (l.secondaryPeak) {
    const sp = l.secondaryPeak;
    h += sp.height * Math.exp(
      -((x - sp.x) ** 2) / (2 * sp.sx ** 2)
      - ((y - sp.y) ** 2) / (2 * sp.sy ** 2)
    );
  }
  return h;
}

function getGradient(x, y, lvl) {
  const eps = 0.001;
  const l = levels[lvl - 1];
  const fx = (getHeight(x + eps, y, lvl) - getHeight(x - eps, y, lvl)) / (2 * eps);
  const fy = (getHeight(x, y + eps, lvl) - getHeight(x, y - eps, lvl)) / (2 * eps);
  return { fx, fy };
}

// ============ INITIALIZATION ============
function init() {
  canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
  ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  resizeCanvas();
  window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);

  // Load saved data
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('gradientGame');
    if (saved) {
      const data = JSON.parse(saved);
      bestTimes = data.bestTimes || {};
      achievements = data.achievements || [];
    }
  } catch(e) {}
}

function resizeCanvas() {
  const wrapper = document.getElementById('canvasWrapper');
  canvas.width = wrapper.clientWidth * window.devicePixelRatio;
  canvas.height = wrapper.clientHeight * window.devicePixelRatio;
  canvas.style.width = wrapper.clientWidth + 'px';
  canvas.style.height = wrapper.clientHeight + 'px';
  ctx.setTransform(window.devicePixelRatio, 0, 0, window.devicePixelRatio, 0, 0);
  if (!gameActive) drawScene();
}

// ============ GAME START ============
window.startGame = function() {
  document.getElementById('startScreen').classList.add('hidden');
  gameActive = true;
  paused = false;
  currentLevel = 1;
  totalScore = 0;
  initLevel();
};

window.restartGame = function() {
  document.getElementById('allCompleteScreen').classList.add('hidden');
  gameActive = true;
  paused = false;
  currentLevel = 1;
  totalScore = 0;
  initLevel();
};

function initLevel() {
  const l = levels[currentLevel - 1];
  playerX = l.playerStartX;
  playerY = l.playerStartY;
  moveCount = 0;
  moveHistory = [];
  hintShown = false;
  lastGain = 0;
  maxHeightReached = getHeight(playerX, playerY, currentLevel);

  startTime = Date.now();
  updateUI();

  if (timerInterval) clearInterval(timerInterval);
  timerInterval = setInterval(() => {
    if (!paused && gameActive) {
      elapsedTime = Math.floor((Date.now() - startTime) / 1000);
      document.getElementById('timerVal').textContent = elapsedTime + 's';
    }
  }, 200);

  document.getElementById('levelVal').textContent = currentLevel;
  document.getElementById('hintText').textContent = l.hint;
  document.getElementById('speedIndicator').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('gainText').innerHTML = '';

  drawScene();
  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

// ============ GAME LOOP ============
let animFrame;
function gameLoop(ts) {
  if (!gameActive) return;
  drawScene();
  animFrame = requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

// ============ MOVEMENT ============
window.movePlayer = function(dx, dy) {
  if (!gameActive || paused) return;

  const lvl = currentLevel;
  const before = getHeight(playerX, playerY, lvl);
  const grad = getGradient(playerX, playerY, lvl);

  // Normalize direction
  const len = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
  const ndx = dx / len;
  const ndy = dy / len;

  // Step size
  const step = 0.06;
  const newX = Math.max(0.05, Math.min(0.95, playerX + ndx * step));
  const newY = Math.max(0.05, Math.min(0.95, playerY + ndy * step));

  const after = getHeight(newX, newY, lvl);
  const gain = after - before;

  // Directional derivative (for display)
  const dirDeriv = grad.fx * ndx + grad.fy * ndy;
  const gradMag = Math.sqrt(grad.fx * grad.fx + grad.fy * grad.fy);

  // Angle between direction and gradient
  let angleDeg = 0;
  if (gradMag > 0.01) {
    const cosTheta = (grad.fx * ndx + grad.fy * ndy) / (gradMag * 1);
    angleDeg = Math.round(Math.acos(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, cosTheta))) * 180 / Math.PI);
  }

  // Update position
  playerX = newX;
  playerY = newY;
  moveCount++;

  // Track history
  moveHistory.push({
    x: newX, y: newY,
    gain: gain,
    angleDeg: angleDeg,
    height: after
  });

  if (after > maxHeightReached) maxHeightReached = after;

  // Scoring
  let moveScore = 0;
  if (angleDeg <= 15) {
    moveScore = 10; // Perfect - perpendicular to contour
    showSpeedFeedback(angleDeg, gain, 'perfect');
  } else if (angleDeg <= 45) {
    moveScore = 7; // Good
    showSpeedFeedback(angleDeg, gain, 'good');
  } else if (angleDeg <= 80) {
    moveScore = 3; // Okay
    showSpeedFeedback(angleDeg, gain, 'poor');
  } else if (angleDeg <= 100) {
    moveScore = 0; // Along contour
    showSpeedFeedback(angleDeg, gain, 'contour');
  } else {
    moveScore = -2; // Going down
    showSpeedFeedback(angleDeg, gain, 'down');
  }

  totalScore += Math.max(0, moveScore);

  // Update hint
  const l = levels[currentLevel - 1];
  if (angleDeg <= 15) {
    document.getElementById('hintText').textContent = '🔥 完美！方向垂直等高线，上升最快！(θ≈' + angleDeg + '°)';
  } else if (angleDeg >= 80 && angleDeg <= 100) {
    document.getElementById('hintText').textContent = '⚠️ 你在沿等高线走！海拔几乎没变，调整方向！';
  } else if (angleDeg > 100) {
    document.getElementById('hintText').textContent = '📉 你在下山！反了！选择与等高线垂直的方向！';
  } else {
    document.getElementById('hintText').textContent = '还行！角度 θ=' + angleDeg + '°，试试找更垂直的方向！';
  }

  lastGain = gain;
  updateUI();

  // Check if reached peak (within threshold)
  const peakH = l.peakHeight;
  if (after >= peakH * 0.92) {
    completeLevel();
    return;
  }

  // Check time limit
  if (elapsedTime >= l.timeLimit) {
    showTimeout();
    return;
  }
};

function showSpeedFeedback(angleDeg, gain, type) {
  const indicator = document.getElementById('speedIndicator');
  const arrow = document.getElementById('arrowIndicator');
  const text = document.getElementById('gainText');

  indicator.style.display = 'block';

  let msg = '';
  switch(type) {
    case 'perfect':
      arrow.textContent = '⬆';
      arrow.style.color = '#2ecc71';
      arrow.style.transform = 'rotate(0deg)';
      msg = '<span class="gain">海拔 +' + Math.round(Math.abs(gain)) + 'm</span>';
      msg += '<br><span style="color:#2ecc71;font-size:11px;">⊥ 等高线 — 最优！</span>';
      spawnParticles(8, '#2ecc71');
      break;
    case 'good':
      arrow.textContent = '↗';
      arrow.style.color = '#f1c40f';
      msg = '<span class="gain">海拔 +' + Math.round(Math.abs(gain)) + 'm</span>';
      msg += '<br><span style="color:#f1c40f;font-size:11px;">角度 ' + angleDeg + '° — 不错</span>';
      break;
    case 'poor':
      arrow.textContent = '↗';
      arrow.style.color = '#e67e22';
      msg = '<span style="color:#e67e22;font-weight:bold;">海拔 +' + Math.round(Math.abs(gain)) + 'm</span>';
      msg += '<br><span style="color:#e67e22;font-size:11px;">角度 ' + angleDeg + '° — 效率低</span>';
      break;
    case 'contour':
      arrow.textContent = '→';
      arrow.style.color = '#95a5a6';
      msg = '<span style="color:#95a5a6;font-weight:bold;">海拔几乎没变</span>';
      msg += '<br><span style="color:#95a5a6;font-size:11px;">∥ 等高线 — 原地踏步！</span>';
      break;
    case 'down':
      arrow.textContent = '⬇';
      arrow.style.color = '#e74c3c';
      msg = '<span class="loss">海拔 ' + gain.toFixed(0) + 'm</span>';
      msg += '<br><span style="color:#e74c3c;font-size:11px;">反方向 — 下山了！</span>';
      break;
  }
  text.innerHTML = msg;
}

function showTimeout() {
  gameActive = false;
  clearInterval(timerInterval);
  cancelAnimationFrame(animFrame);

  document.getElementById('lcTitle').textContent = '⏰ 时间到！';
  document.getElementById('lcStats').innerHTML =
    '你用了 ' + elapsedTime + ' 秒，到达海拔 ' + Math.round(maxHeightReached) + 'm<br>' +
    '目标海拔：' + levels[currentLevel-1].peakHeight + 'm<br>' +
    '得分：' + totalScore + ' 分';
  document.getElementById('lcLesson').textContent = levels[currentLevel-1].lesson;

  const l = levels[currentLevel - 1];
  document.getElementById('levelCompleteScreen').classList.remove('hidden');
}

function completeLevel() {
  gameActive = false;
  clearInterval(timerInterval);
  cancelAnimationFrame(animFrame);

  // Speed bonus
  const l = levels[currentLevel - 1];
  const timeBonus = Math.max(0, Math.round((l.timeLimit - elapsedTime) * 2));
  totalScore += timeBonus;

  // Save best time
  if (!bestTimes[currentLevel] || elapsedTime < bestTimes[currentLevel]) {
    bestTimes[currentLevel] = elapsedTime;
  }

  // Check achievements
  checkAchievements();

  // Save progress
  saveProgress();

  // Show completion
  if (currentLevel >= levels.length) {
    // All levels complete
    document.getElementById('finalStats').innerHTML =
      '总得分：' + totalScore + ' 分<br>' +
      '总用时：' + elapsedTime + ' 秒<br>' +
      '总移动：' + moveCount + ' 步';
    document.getElementById('allCompleteScreen').classList.remove('hidden');
  } else {
    document.getElementById('lcTitle').textContent = '🎉 第 ' + currentLevel + ' 关完成！';
    document.getElementById('lcStats').innerHTML =
      '用时：' + elapsedTime + ' 秒（限时 ' + l.timeLimit + ' 秒）<br>' +
      '移动：' + moveCount + ' 步<br>' +
      '得分：' + totalScore + ' 分<br>' +
      '<span style="color:#2ecc71;">速度奖励：+' + timeBonus + ' 分</span>';
    document.getElementById('lcLesson').textContent = l.lesson;
    document.getElementById('levelCompleteScreen').classList.remove('hidden');
  }

  spawnParticles(20, '#f1c40f');
}

window.nextLevel = function() {
  document.getElementById('levelCompleteScreen').classList.add('hidden');
  currentLevel++;
  gameActive = true;
  paused = false;
  initLevel();
};

window.showHint = function() {
  const l = levels[currentLevel - 1];
  document.getElementById('hintText').textContent = '💡 ' + l.hint;
  hintShown = true;
};

// ============ ACHIEVEMENTS ============
function checkAchievements() {
  const l = levels[currentLevel - 1];
  const newAchievements = [];

  // Fast climber
  if (elapsedTime <= l.timeLimit * 0.5 && !achievements.includes('fast_climber')) {
    newAchievements.push({ name: '🏃 闪电攀登者', desc: '用时不超过一半' });
    achievements.push('fast_climber');
  }

  // Efficient climber (few moves)
  if (moveCount <= 12 && !achievements.includes('efficient')) {
    newAchievements.push({ name: '🎯 精准攀登者', desc: '12步内到达山顶' });
    achievements.push('efficient');
  }

  // Max score level
  if (currentLevel >= levels.length) {
    if (!achievements.includes('master')) {
      newAchievements.push({ name: '🏆 梯度大师', desc: '通关所有关卡' });
      achievements.push('master');
    }
  }

  newAchievements.forEach(a => showAchievementPopup(a.name, a.desc));
}

function showAchievementPopup(name, desc) {
  const popup = document.createElement('div');
  popup.className = 'achievement-popup';
  popup.innerHTML = name + '<br><span style="font-size:11px;font-weight:normal;">' + desc + '</span>';
  document.getElementById('canvasWrapper').appendChild(popup);
  setTimeout(() => popup.remove(), 2500);
}

// ============ UI UPDATES ============
function updateUI() {
  const l = levels[currentLevel - 1];
  const h = getHeight(playerX, playerY, currentLevel);
  const percent = Math.min(100, Math.round((h / l.peakHeight) * 100));

  document.getElementById('elevationVal').textContent = Math.round(h) + 'm';
  document.getElementById('scoreVal').textContent = totalScore;
  document.getElementById('elevationFill').style.width = percent + '%';
  document.getElementById('elevationPercent').textContent = percent + '%';
  document.getElementById('timerVal').textContent = elapsedTime + 's';
}

// ============ DRAWING ============
function drawScene() {
  const w = canvas.width / window.devicePixelRatio;
  const h = canvas.height / window.devicePixelRatio;
  const lvl = currentLevel;
  const l = levels[lvl - 1];

  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

  // Background gradient (altitude-based)
  const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h);
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1a3a4a');
  bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0a1628');
  ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

  // Draw contour lines
  drawContourLines(w, h, l, lvl);

  // Draw gradient field arrows
  drawGradientArrows(w, h, l, lvl);

  // Draw player path
  drawPath(w, h);

  // Draw peak marker
  drawPeak(w, h, l);

  // Draw player
  drawPlayer(w, h);
}

function drawContourLines(w, h, l, lvl) {
  const numContours = 12;
  const maxH = l.peakHeight;

  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;

  for (let i = 1; i <= numContours; i++) {
    const targetH = (i / (numContours + 1)) * maxH;
    const alpha = 0.15 + 0.15 * (i / numContours);

    // Draw contour line using marching approach
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(200, 220, 255, ${alpha})`;

    // Sample grid and find contour intersections
    const resolution = 4;
    let started = false;

    for (let gx = 0; gx < w/resolution - 1; gx++) {
      for (let gy = 0; gy < h/resolution - 1; gy++) {
        const x1 = gx * resolution / w;
        const y1 = gy * resolution / h;
        const x2 = (gx + 1) * resolution / w;
        const y2 = (gy + 1) * resolution / h;

        const h1 = getHeight(x1, y1, lvl);
        const h2 = getHeight(x2, y1, lvl);
        const h3 = getHeight(x2, y2, lvl);
        const h4 = getHeight(x1, y2, lvl);

        // Check edges for crossings
        const edges = [];
        if ((h1 < targetH && h2 >= targetH) || (h1 >= targetH && h2 < targetH)) {
          const t = (targetH - h1) / (h2 - h1);
          edges.push({ px: (gx + t) * resolution, py: gy * resolution });
        }
        if ((h2 < targetH && h3 >= targetH) || (h2 >= targetH && h3 < targetH)) {
          const t = (targetH - h2) / (h3 - h2);
          edges.push({ px: (gx + 1) * resolution, py: (gy + t) * resolution });
        }
        if ((h3 < targetH && h4 >= targetH) || (h3 >= targetH && h4 < targetH)) {
          const t = (targetH - h3) / (h4 - h3);
          edges.push({ px: (gx + 1 - t) * resolution, py: (gy + 1) * resolution });
        }
        if ((h4 < targetH && h1 >= targetH) || (h4 >= targetH && h1 < targetH)) {
          const t = (targetH - h4) / (h1 - h4);
          edges.push({ px: gx * resolution, py: (gy + 1 - t) * resolution });
        }

        if (edges.length >= 2) {
          if (!started) {
            ctx.moveTo(edges[0].px, edges[0].py);
            started = true;
          }
          ctx.lineTo(edges[Math.min(1, edges.length - 1)].px, edges[Math.min(1, edges.length - 1)].py);
        }
      }
    }
    ctx.stroke();

    // Label some contours
    if (i % 3 === 0) {
      const labelH = Math.round(targetH);
      // Find a point on this contour for labeling
      for (let scanX = 0.05; scanX < 0.95; scanX += 0.02) {
        for (let scanY = 0.05; scanY < 0.95; scanY += 0.02) {
          const sh = getHeight(scanX, scanY, lvl);
          if (Math.abs(sh - targetH) < maxH * 0.03) {
            const lx = scanX * w;
            const ly = scanY * h;
            // Don't draw too close to existing labels
            ctx.font = '10px sans-serif';
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(150, 180, 220, ${alpha * 1.5})`;
            ctx.fillText(labelH + 'm', lx + 3, ly - 3);
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

function drawGradientArrows(w, h, l, lvl) {
  const spacing = 50;
  const arrowLen = 15;

  for (let gx = spacing; gx < w; gx += spacing) {
    for (let gy = spacing; gy < h; gy += spacing) {
      const nx = gx / w;
      const ny = gy / h;
      const grad = getGradient(nx, ny, lvl);
      const mag = Math.sqrt(grad.fx * grad.fx + grad.fy * grad.fy);

      if (mag < 0.5) continue;

      const alpha = Math.min(0.5, mag / 500);
      const dirX = grad.fx / mag * arrowLen;
      const dirY = -grad.fy / mag * arrowLen; // flip y for screen coords

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(52, 152, 219, ${alpha})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.moveTo(gx, gy);
      ctx.lineTo(gx + dirX, gy + dirY);
      ctx.stroke();

      // Arrowhead
      const angle = Math.atan2(dirY, dirX);
      const headLen = 4;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(gx + dirX, gy + dirY);
      ctx.lineTo(gx + dirX - headLen * Math.cos(angle - 0.5), gy + dirY - headLen * Math.sin(angle - 0.5));
      ctx.moveTo(gx + dirX, gy + dirY);
      ctx.lineTo(gx + dirX - headLen * Math.cos(angle + 0.5), gy + dirY - headLen * Math.sin(angle + 0.5));
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
}

function drawPath(w, h) {
  if (moveHistory.length < 2) return;

  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(233, 69, 96, 0.4)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.setLineDash([5, 5]);

  const startPt = moveHistory[0];
  ctx.moveTo(startPt.x * w, startPt.y * h);

  for (let i = 1; i < moveHistory.length; i++) {
    const pt = moveHistory[i];
    ctx.lineTo(pt.x * w, pt.y * h);
  }
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
}

function drawPeak(w, h, l) {
  const px = l.peakX * w;
  const py = l.peakY * h;

  // Glow
  const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(px, py, 0, px, py, 25);
  glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(241, 196, 15, 0.6)');
  glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(241, 196, 15, 0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = glow;
  ctx.fillRect(px - 30, py - 30, 60, 60);

  // Peak marker
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(px, py, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.stroke();

  // Label
  ctx.font = 'bold 11px sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('⛰️ 山顶 ' + l.peakHeight + 'm', px, py - 14);
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
}

function drawPlayer(w, h) {
  const px = playerX * w;
  const py = playerY * h;

  // Glow
  const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(px, py, 0, px, py, 20);
  glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(233, 69, 96, 0.5)');
  glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(233, 69, 96, 0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = glow;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(px, py, 20, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Player circle
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(px, py, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e94560';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
  ctx.stroke();

  // Gradient direction indicator (small arrow from player)
  const grad = getGradient(playerX, playerY, currentLevel);
  const mag = Math.sqrt(grad.fx * grad.fx + grad.fy * grad.fy);
  if (mag > 0.1) {
    const dLen = 20;
    const dx = (grad.fx / mag) * dLen;
    const dy = -(grad.fy / mag) * dLen;

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(46, 204, 113, 0.8)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.moveTo(px, py);
    ctx.lineTo(px + dx, py + dy);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Arrowhead
    const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(px + dx, py + dy);
    ctx.lineTo(px + dx - 6 * Math.cos(angle - 0.4), py + dy - 6 * Math.sin(angle - 0.4));
    ctx.moveTo(px + dx, py + dy);
    ctx.lineTo(px + dx - 6 * Math.cos(angle + 0.4), py + dy - 6 * Math.sin(angle + 0.4));
    ctx.stroke();

    // Label
    ctx.font = '10px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(46, 204, 113, 0.9)';
    ctx.fillText('∇f', px + dx + 4, py + dy - 4);
  }

  // Player emoji
  ctx.font = '14px sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('🧗', px, py + 5);
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
}

// ============ PARTICLES ============
function spawnParticles(count, color) {
  const container = document.getElementById('particleContainer');
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const p = document.createElement('div');
    const size = 4 + Math.random() * 8;
    const x = Math.random() * 100;
    const startY = 30 + Math.random() * 40;
    const dx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 200;
    const dy = -50 - Math.random() * 100;
    const dur = 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.8;

    p.style.cssText = `
      position: absolute;
      width: ${size}px;
      height: ${size}px;
      background: ${color};
      border-radius: 50%;
      left: ${x}%;
      top: ${startY}%;
      pointer-events: none;
      animation: particleFly ${dur}s ease-out forwards;
      opacity: 0.9;
    `;
    container.appendChild(p);
    setTimeout(() => p.remove(), dur * 1000);
  }

  // Add keyframes if not exists
  if (!document.getElementById('particleStyle')) {
    const style = document.createElement('style');
    style.id = 'particleStyle';
    style.textContent = `
      @keyframes particleFly {
        0% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); opacity: 0.9; }
        100% { transform: translate(var(--dx, 50px), var(--dy, -80px)) scale(0); opacity: 0; }
      }
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(style);
  }
}

// ============ PAUSE ============
window.resumeGame = function() {
  document.getElementById('pauseScreen').classList.add('hidden');
  paused = false;
};

// Add touch pause (double tap)
let lastTap = 0;
document.getElementById('canvasWrapper').addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {
  const now = Date.now();
  if (now - lastTap < 300 && gameActive) {
    if (!paused) {
      paused = true;
      document.getElementById('pauseScreen').classList.remove('hidden');
    }
  }
  lastTap = now;
});

// ============ SAVE/LOAD ============
function saveProgress() {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem('gradientGame', JSON.stringify({
      bestTimes: bestTimes,
      achievements: achievements,
      lastSaved: Date.now()
    }));
  } catch(e) {}
}

// ============ INIT ============
init();

}); // end DOMContentLoaded

// Global functions for onclick handlers
function startGame() {
  document.getElementById('startScreen').classList.add('hidden');
  window._gameActive = true;
  window._paused = false;
  window._currentLevel = 1;
  window._totalScore = 0;
  initLevel();
}

function nextLevel() {
  document.getElementById('levelCompleteScreen').classList.add('hidden');
  currentLevel++;
  gameActive = true;
  paused = false;
  initLevel();
}

function resumeGame() {
  document.getElementById('pauseScreen').classList.add('hidden');
  paused = false;
}

function restartGame() {
  document.getElementById('allCompleteScreen').classList.add('hidden');
  gameActive = true;
  paused = false;
  currentLevel = 1;
  totalScore = 0;
  initLevel();
}

function showHint() {
  const l = levels[currentLevel - 1];
  document.getElementById('hintText').textContent = '💡 ' + l.hint;
  hintShown = true;
}

function movePlayer(dx, dy) {
  if (!gameActive || paused) return;

  const lvl = currentLevel;
  const before = getHeight(playerX, playerY, lvl);
  const grad = getGradient(playerX, playerY, lvl);

  const len = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
  const ndx = dx / len;
  const ndy = dy / len;

  const step = 0.06;
  const newX = Math.max(0.05, Math.min(0.95, playerX + ndx * step));
  const newY = Math.max(0.05, Math.min(0.95, playerY + ndy * step));

  const after = getHeight(newX, newY, lvl);
  const gain = after - before;

  const dirDeriv = grad.fx * ndx + grad.fy * ndy;
  const gradMag = Math.sqrt(grad.fx * grad.fx + grad.fy * grad.fy);

  let angleDeg = 0;
  if (gradMag > 0.01) {
    const cosTheta = (grad.fx * ndx + grad.fy * ndy) / (gradMag * 1);
    angleDeg = Math.round(Math.acos(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, cosTheta))) * 180 / Math.PI);
  }

  playerX = newX;
  playerY = newY;
  moveCount++;

  moveHistory.push({
    x: newX, y: newY,
    gain: gain,
    angleDeg: angleDeg,
    height: after
  });

  if (after > maxHeightReached) maxHeightReached = after;

  let moveScore = 0;
  if (angleDeg <= 15) {
    moveScore = 10;
    showSpeedFeedback(angleDeg, gain, 'perfect');
  } else if (angleDeg <= 45) {
    moveScore = 7;
    showSpeedFeedback(angleDeg, gain, 'good');
  } else if (angleDeg <= 80) {
    moveScore = 3;
    showSpeedFeedback(angleDeg, gain, 'poor');
  } else if (angleDeg <= 100) {
    moveScore = 0;
    showSpeedFeedback(angleDeg, gain, 'contour');
  } else {
    moveScore = -2;
    showSpeedFeedback(angleDeg, gain, 'down');
  }

  totalScore += Math.max(0, moveScore);

  const l = levels[currentLevel - 1];
  if (angleDeg <= 15) {
    document.getElementById('hintText').textContent = '🔥 完美！方向垂直等高线，上升最快！(θ≈' + angleDeg + '°)';
  } else if (angleDeg >= 80 && angleDeg <= 100) {
    document.getElementById('hintText').textContent = '⚠️ 你在沿等高线走！海拔几乎没变，调整方向！';
  } else if (angleDeg > 100) {
    document.getElementById('hintText').textContent = '📉 你在下山！反了！选择与等高线垂直的方向！';
  } else {
    document.getElementById('hintText').textContent = '还行！角度 θ=' + angleDeg + '°，试试找更垂直的方向！';
  }

  lastGain = gain;
  updateUI();

  const peakH = l.peakHeight;
  if (after >= peakH * 0.92) {
    completeLevel();
    return;
  }

  if (elapsedTime >= l.timeLimit) {
    showTimeout();
    return;
  }
}
</script>
</body>
</html>

widgetConfig.description: 迷宫策略游戏：梯度与等高线垂直关系理解

actions.text: 刚才我们通过关系图理清了梯度与等高线垂直的逻辑。现在，让我们把这个理解放到一个游戏中去检验——限时冲顶挑战。

actions.content: 点击这里开始挑战

actions.text: 你的目标是以最快速度冲向山顶。屏幕上会显示等高线交织的地形，你需要用方向键选择前进角度。请思考：什么角度的路线，才能让你在最短时间内爬升最多？

actions.content: 观察第一关的等高线分布，找到梯度方向

actions.text: 在你做出选择前，我先不提示答案。但请记住上一页的结论——梯度指向变化最快的方向。现在，动手试试看。

actions.content: 第一关开始，尝试不同角度

actions.text: 注意观察反馈：当你选择的方向垂直于等高线时，角色的移动距离最大；而如果你沿着等高线走，会发现角色几乎原地踏步——因为沿等高线方向的变化率为零。

actions.content: 垂直方向得分最高，沿等高线得分为零

actions.text: 继续挑战后续关卡，每一关的地形都在变化，但原理不变。找出等高线最密集的地方，那里坡度最陡，垂直方向就是你的最优路线。

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>梯度与等高线垂直：空间视角</title>
  <style>
    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #0a0a1a;
      font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    }
    #canvas-container { width: 100%; height: 100%; position: relative; }
    canvas { display: block; }

    #loading {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
      background: #0a0a1a;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: #aaa;
      z-index: 1000;
    }
    .spinner {
      width: 40px; height: 40px;
      border: 3px solid #333;
      border-top-color: #6366f1;
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: spin 1s linear infinite;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

    #controls {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
      background: rgba(15, 15, 25, 0.9);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      padding: 16px;
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 15px;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      z-index: 100;
    }

    .control-group {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
      min-width: 120px;
    }

    label {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #fbbf24;
      font-weight: bold;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    input[type="range"] {
      width: 100%;
      height: 6px;
      -webkit-appearance: none;
      background: #333;
      border-radius: 3px;
    }

    input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
      -webkit-appearance: none;
      width: 18px; height: 18px;
      background: #6366f1;
      border-radius: 50%;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .btn-group { display: flex; gap: 8px; }

    button {
      padding: 0 16px;
      height: 44px;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: #2a2a3a;
      color: white;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 14px;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    button:hover { background: #3a3a4a; }
    button:active { transform: scale(0.95); }
    button.primary { background: #6366f1; }
    
    .zoom-btn { font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; width: 44px; }

    #info {
      position: absolute;
      top: 20px; left: 20px;
      background: rgba(10, 10, 20, 0.8);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      max-width: 320px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      color: #eee;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    #info h2 { font-size: 18px; color: #fbbf24; margin-bottom: 10px; }
    #info p { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 8px; color: #ccc; }
    .math { font-family: "Times New Roman", serif; font-style: italic; color: #fff; }

    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      #info { display: none; }
      #controls { padding: 10px 5px 25px; gap: 10px; }
      .control-group { min-width: 100px; }
    }
  </style>
